chapters.title: Chapter 801: The Duel
paragraphs: The moment the Pill Emperor asked for the start of the duel, everyone quieted down and began paying attention to what was about to happen.
Of course, Kent kept sensing many gazes directed at him from all directions.
Even Suoh couldn’t take his eyes off him.
He was too shocked to know what to say. One of the many things he wanted to achieve was to view the Grand Pill Tablet, which was said to hold many secrets about alchemy.
He had been doing all he could to get access to view it for just an hour, but Kent, someone who hadn’t even scratched the surface of pill making, had just gained access to view it.
To him, that was just unbelievable. He couldn’t wrap his mind around it.
He was neither angry nor jealous. He was merely blown away by the unbelievable thing that had just happened before his eyes.
It would spread to thousands of worlds, and everyone would know Kent’s name. Even his images would be shared if people managed to record him.
’I must become his friend at all costs.’
Kent, on the other hand, was paying close attention to the two Pill Kings. It took them just two minutes to figure out the rest of the ingredients, down to the last one.
The only thing left now was to make the pill, and that is where mastery over the flames and better pill-refining techniques come in.
Pill King Han Lu started with the minor ingredients, while Pill King Yota began with the major ingredients.

’I guess they all have their styles. But I would have gone with Pill King Yota. The moment all major ingredients are extracted, the minor ones will be a minor struggle. But I guess whatever works for them.’
Kent was paying close attention to the process, making sure he captured every last detail. Just like that, an hour passed, but the progress on both fronts was too slow.
Pill King Han Lu had managed to extract the essence of ten minor ingredients, while Pill King Yota had only managed to extract the essence of three major ingredients.

This shows that while they can easily extract essence from Tier 9 ingredients in their sleep, now, due to the requirements they must meet, they are ensuring every last essence is extracted to perfection.
They were ultimately required to come out with a Tier 12 pill using Tier 9 ingredients, so they needed all the medicinal essence from each herb in abundance.
If they were to make a mistake and lack even one herb, especially a major one, their process would have to be stopped, for they wouldn’t be able to achieve their goals.

So they were going at it slowly, and within three hours, the progress became clear. Just when Pill King Han Lu extracted the 13th minor ingredient, Pill King Yota had also completed the 6th major herb.
Then the positions switched.
Now, Pill King Yota was extracting essence from minor herbs while Pill King Han Lu started on the major ones.
’This is a race against time and perfection. Just a minor slip-up and everything will be ruined,’ Kent said inwardly, wishing he had a Pill Eye to see inside the cauldrons of the two Pill Kings.
That would have worked like magic. He would have managed to connect every hand movement and temperature control to the changes in the behavior of the ingredients in the cauldron.
Even so, he was learning a great deal from the simple hand movements.
Five hours into the process, Kent saw a miscalculation in Pill King Yota’s movement, and the next second, he lost one minor ingredient.
However, instead of panicking, he remained calm and went ahead to extract the next ingredient.
Situations like this, when one is racing against both time and perfection, panicking over a failure to handle an extraction, could cause an alchemist to suffer a great defeat due to their emotions.
After six hours, they were each nearing completion of the extraction.

’Technique-wise, I believe the one Pill King Han Lu is using is superior to Pill King Yota’s. However, the only reason Pill King Yota could keep up was because his flame control is much more impressive.
I would love to watch him extract more ingredients if I ever get the chance."
Kent was so focused on the process that he didn’t even realize he was being watched.
If he weren’t paying so much attention to the two Pill Kings, he would have noticed the gaze coming from a room somewhere in the Pagoda.

Inside a certain room on the seventh floor, a lady dressed in green was seated in an elegant green chair. Around her, the air was nourishing, almost like the plants in the forest grew from her. With green hair, green eyes, and even green lips, her beauty was undeniable.
And judging by her Peak Spirit Lord aura, it wasn’t hard to know she was no weakling. She was one of the most dangerous women on Planet Pyris.
They called her the Pill Monarch Nefeli—one of the top elders of the Pyris Pill Alliance. She is part of the top rank of the Grand Pill Pagoda.

On her chest was a Platinum Pill Badge showing she was at the peak of the Pill Monarch stage and would soon become a Pill Sovereign if she managed to pass the qualification trial that Pill Legends would witness.
Under normal circumstances, she wouldn’t have wasted her time watching a bunch of Pill Kings compete in a duel. However, she happened to have some free time on her hands.
But who would have told her she would be witnessing one of the most shocking events in her alchemy career?
A Pill Grandmaster, knowing the recipe for a Soul Mending Pill, one of the rarest soul pills in existence. That is just too much for someone at Kent’s level.
She had to reach the Pill Emperor stage before learning the recipe for the soul mending pill, yet a mere Pill Grandmaster was able to do so, and even mentioned the major ingredients.
That shocked her.
However, the reason she was paying attention wasn’t because of Kent’s shocking feat. His focus was on how Kent was meticulously watching the Pill Kings and pointing out their mistakes, one by one.
She noticed Kent caught some mistakes made by the Pill Kings.

That was something many wouldn’t notice, but since she was a Pill Monarch, she was able to spot those mistakes. Whenever she did, she noticed Kent’s subtle movements, which told her that the Pill Grandmaster sitting among the crowd was no simple person.
"Just how profound is his understanding of alchemy to be able to point out mistakes Pill Kings are making?" she muttered, not taking her eyes off him.
It reached a point where she subtly used her energy to probe for answers, but whenever she tried, it was like Kent was a void encompassing nothing that could be examined.

"Interesting. Kent, I will remember this name," she said before turning her gaze away from him. A few seconds later, Kent turned his gaze and stared in the direction of the room she was in. However, he saw nothing...

chapters.title: Chapter 802: True Impurity Removal, Condensing [Bonus]
paragraphs: After seven hours, both Pill Kings had successfully extracted the medicinal essence from the ingredients. However, the moment that was done, the real challenge began.

They now had only eleven hours to burn impurities, condense the pill, and refine it to Tier 12. All this had to be completed without making a single mistake that would compromise the impurity-burning or condensing process.
As usual, it was a race, and they had to be sure to stay just a step ahead of perfection, or else they would both lose.
Pill King Han Lu was the first to initiate the purification process.
Kent paid close attention to him, and what he saw amazed him.
Pill King Han Lu activated his classic impurity-burning technique, the Butterfly Burning Art.
It was one of his signature and most frequently used techniques. Some say it was self-created, while others claim he obtained it from the Lost Pill Immortal Tomb.
Either way, the moment he ignited the technique, his blue flame transformed into a series of smaller flames, resembling butterflies. They moved and soon enclosed the entire cauldron.
"Wow. That is beautiful," Kent couldn’t help admiring the display before him.

"Pill King Han Lu is known for his beautiful pill techniques. He doesn’t just have the skills, he has the techniques to back them up," Suoh also said, admiring the Pill King’s display. Everyone was mesmerized by the spectacle.
Meanwhile, Pill King Yota had also started his impurity removal. However, unlike Pill King Han Lu, who had the technique to show off his beautiful display, Pill King Yota was much more grounded.
He was merely using his standard techniques, but the way he controlled the flame was simply breathtaking.
Kent, who had been focused on the butterflies, was suddenly drawn toward Pill King Yota when his senses picked up something.
Looking closer, Kent could see tiny runes moving within the fire. This discovery alone told Kent all he needed to know.
’He is already at the "Transcendent" stage in flame comprehension. To be able to create this many flame runes, his understanding of flame is beyond perfect.’
Kent’s focus shifted to the way Pill King Yota was controlling the flame, and the more he watched, the more his own comprehension of flame began to deepen.
’Just watching him is giving me more understanding than I expected. Imagine him teaching me one-on-one.’
Kent was now fully absorbed in how the Pill King was working his flame.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝚠𝕖𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝕖𝚕.𝚌𝗼𝗺
Two more hours passed, leaving nine hours to go.
Kent was so deep in watching Pill King Yota that when he switched to condensing the pill, he was unaware.
However, he was soon drawn back into the process and began observing it with close attention.
The more he observed, the more Kent realized that despite having the pill records from a Pill Celestial, he still had a lot to learn on his own.

He already had the roadmap and added bonuses. Still, if he followed it without incorporating his own understanding, techniques, and unique perspectives on the path of the pill, then he would be wasting his time.

Of course, he would reach the peak alright, but it would be the same path followed by someone else. He had to have a unique take on it. He must adapt, change some things, and bring out his own understanding.
When he was given the mission to kill the God of Alchemy, one thing Kent asked Vexthra after weeks of planning was, wouldn’t he be able to kill the God of Alchemy if he became the Sword God?
Vexthra just laughed and said if that were simple, she would have long since killed the bastard.
According to her, to reach the Pill God, Kent would have to become well-known in the world of alchemy and hold some influence.
He must reach the stage of one who could challenge the current God of Alchemy, without raising suspicions.
There were several powerful alchemists with a status higher than the God of Alchemy, and if Kent wanted to come out alive after killing such a person, he had to be known and respected.
Vexthra told him that only by defeating the current Pill God would he be able to kill him. He doesn’t know how that works out, but he believes being a Pill God is more than just a title...
He asked why that was, and she told him he would learn more when he reached the Pill Immortal stage and slowly began to build his name in the world of alchemy.
So, one of the reasons he was walking the path of the pill was this.
Of course, at first, Kent only wanted to fulfill a mission given to him by his goddess. However, as he started making pills, Kent began to see a whole world out there that he could explore.
He wasn’t doing it just to complete a mission.
He was doing it now because he planned to rise to the peak and one day become someone who transcended the path of pill-making to see if there was something else out there for him.
And now, witnessing a duel between two Pill Kings, Kent was more than happy to be in attendance.
’I will be sure to embrace this path and walk it on my own terms, making sure soon my name will be spread everywhere.’
An alchemist can only hope that people in millions of worlds hear their name. That is how they spread their fame and share their brilliance.
In Kent’s case, he had to make sure everyone was aware of his existence so they wouldn’t doubt him when he challenged the Pill God and ultimately severed his head from his body.
"They might actually be able to pull this off," Suoh said, watching the two Pill Kings condense their pills. Two more hours passed, leaving them just seven hours to finish condensing and refining.
"You think they can make it?" Kent asked, wanting to hear Suoh’s perspective. Suoh was a Pill Sage, so he was more knowledgeable than Kent.

"I think so. Judging, by the way, none of them seem to burn too much impurity before condensing, if I’m not mistaken, they all want to use that old refining technique where impurities can be refined to add more potency to the pill."
"Wait. Can impurities be refined into medicinal essence?" Kent asked, learning something new.
"Indeed. Impurities aren’t always harmful. Some hang between impurity and medicinal essence. Those are more or less refinable.

Of course, we always burn them away since, in most cases, we only need the pure medicinal essence. However, in situations like this, where every essence is valuable, removing such essence and focusing solely on the pure essence wouldn’t be enough.
They have to transcend three tiers to achieve their aim, so even if they burn that much essence away, at most, they can only make a Tier 11 pill.
But even if they manage to make a Tier 12 pill, the chances of over-refining the essence, thereby reducing the purity of the pill, will be very high."
"Interesting. I think I’ll buy you a drink one of these days to pick your superior brain on quite a few things, brother Suoh."
"I’ll be happy to help."
Suoh smiled, knowing he had hit the jackpot. His plans to befriend Kent had just taken a leap.

chapters.title: Chapter 803: Refining [Bonus]
paragraphs: They are almost done with the condensing process. The next big thing, in this case, is refining. That is where a true master comes in. Suoh was pumped for the next phase of the alchemy process.
’Tower, if you can see this, then please record. I want to review it later,’ Kent said in his mind before focusing back on the duel.
He hadn’t been able to talk to the tower since he appeared in Pyris, but he was sure the Overpowered Tower was monitoring everything.

And since the next phase of the duel has to do with refining, he wants to gain as much understanding as he can siphon from what he will see. The rest would be obtained from the video if the tower were able to record it.
"Pay close attention, brother Kent. Moments like this come only once." Kent took in Suoh’s advice and focused his full attention on the duel.

Pill King Han Lu was the first to complete the condensing process. He came out with a Tier 10 pill, showing that despite condensing first before refining, he even managed to push the pill to the 10th Tier.
Of course, the moment he finished, he activated a different technique meant for refining.

"That is the classic Nine Steps Refining Technique." The flame around the cauldron of Pill King Han Lu was now green, showing he was using a much stronger or perhaps a well-suited flame for the refining process.
The entire cauldron was enclosed in pale green flame.
Hearing the name of the technique, Kent couldn’t help asking.
"Does the technique have something to do with the green flame around the cauldron?" The name of the technique suggests that it has different effects on the pill.
However, in pill making, Kent understood that every stage, or perhaps technique, requires the right flame.
One cannot achieve success with just one type of flame. If it is a soul flame awakened manually, then it must devour all kinds of flames and gain their aspects.
He himself had already received two flames from the tower before awakening his soul flame. So he knew every stage of the technique had to have a unique flame that the pill would benefit from.

Of course, if his theory were proven right, then Kent would be about to copy the Pill King, for having such a technique would not only give him a fair idea of how to refine the pill but also how to utilize the various aspects of his soul flame.

For example, the poison aspect of his soul flame cannot be used for making pills like the Qi Gathering pill. It is too toxic for such a pill. However, when it comes to making poison pills, it will be perfect for it.

In that case, having the right technique, such as the Nine Steps Refining Technique, will not only make the process much smoother but also make it more grounded and easier to refine, a rather pure form of a poison pill.
"From what I know, this technique is common; however, it is difficult to cultivate. Pill King Han Lu was one of the few who managed to cultivate all nine steps.
The reason is that to be able to cultivate it, first, you must find nine different types of flames that have some correlation to refining and purifying pills.
It is not easy to gather that many flames, and as far as I know, each flame must be at least Divine grade.

Once those are gathered, you will need to learn how to arrange them in a way that complements each other. That is where most fail, for a slight mistake would not only spoil the technique but also compromise the overall result and even affect the flames you gathered.
Once that happens, you won’t be able to learn it ever again.
Pill King Han Lu had managed to accomplish all that, and the flame he is using now is the Verdant Flame.
This flame allows him to nurture the pill and bring out the latent nutrients still hidden in the harmless impurities in the pill.
Basically, every step has a different refining effect, and by the time he gets to the ninth step, he might actually be able to pull it off."
Kent nodded, already paying close attention. However, five minutes after Pill King Han Lu started, Pill King Yota also condensed his pill, coming out with a Tier 10 pill.

So the race began, with the end goal of concocting a Tier 12 pill with a purity level of 90 or above. It was the passing mark, so they all were aiming for the highest score, and Kent could already start to see the rivalry brewing slowly.

Only three hours were left, and each had managed to bring the grade of their pill to Tier 11, but they weren’t done. They continually refined and nourished using various techniques to achieve the best results.

With only one hour left, Kent finally saw where real mastery of pill-making comes in. Both Pill Kings were just a step away from concocting a Tier 12 pill, but there was nothing else Kent could see them doing to push through to that step.
This left him wondering what would happen next.

"Moments like this are when you witness those with true mastery when it comes to alchemy. They are both in a bind, and with less than an hour left, they will either come out in a tie, or one will manage to reach the Tier 12 stage.
Even so, it is uncertain whether they will be able to maintain their purity levels. Either way, one of them will be winning today."
"Isn’t that obvious? The duel was set so that the two would compete, and only the best would win." Kent smiled and focused on the duel.
Thirty minutes before the time ran out, the two Pill Kings changed techniques, and instantly, both their pills broke into the Tier 12 stage, causing hush and gasps to spread across the sitting area.
"Now, things have become even more interesting. With the two in a bind, the chances of one coming out on top are less likely. If anything, they will be drawn," Suoh said, but Kent shook his head.
"I think Pill King Yota will win." His words contained confidence, the kind spoken with certainty.
"How sure are you? They both attained Tier 12 pill grade and managed to maintain their purity, which, judging by the smell of the pill, is 92%.
So, how sure are you he will win?"
"It is simple. Pill King Yota has more understanding of the flame than Pill King Han Lu, and that will be how he wins."

I want to review it later,’ Kent said in his mind before focusing back on the duel.
He hadn’t been able to talk to the tower since he appeared in Pyris, but he was sure the Overpowered Tower was monitoring everything.
And since the next phase of the duel has to do with refining, he wants to gain as much understanding as he can siphon from what he will see.
The rest would be obtained from the video if the tower were able to record it.
"Pay close attention, brother Kent.
Moments like this come only once." Kent took in Suoh’s advice and focused his full attention on the duel.
Pill King Han Lu was the first to complete the condensing process.
He came out with a Tier 10 pill, showing that despite condensing first before refining, he even managed to push the pill to the 10th Tier.
Of course, the moment he finished, he activated a different technique meant for refining.

"That is the classic Nine Steps Refining Technique." The flame around the cauldron of Pill King Han Lu was now green, showing he was using a much stronger or perhaps a well-suited flame for the refining process.
The entire cauldron was enclosed in pale green flame.
Hearing the name of the technique, Kent couldn’t help asking.
"Does the technique have something to do with the green flame around the cauldron?" The name of the technique suggests that it has different effects on the pill.
However, in pill making, Kent understood that every stage, or perhaps technique, requires the right flame.
One cannot achieve success with just one type of flame.
If it is a soul flame awakened manually, then it must devour all kinds of flames and gain their aspects.
He himself had already received two flames from the tower before awakening his soul flame.
So he knew every stage of the technique had to have a unique flame that the pill would benefit from.

Of course, if his theory were proven right, then Kent would be about to copy the Pill King, for having such a technique would not only give him a fair idea of how to refine the pill but also how to utilize the various aspects of his soul flame.
For example, the poison aspect of his soul flame cannot be used for making pills like the Qi Gathering pill.
It is too toxic for such a pill.
However, when it comes to making poison pills, it will be perfect for it.

In that case, having the right technique, such as the Nine Steps Refining Technique, will not only make the process much smoother but also make it more grounded and easier to refine, a rather pure form of a poison pill.
"From what I know, this technique is common; however, it is difficult to cultivate.
Pill King Han Lu was one of the few who managed to cultivate all nine steps.
The reason is that to be able to cultivate it, first, you must find nine different types of flames that have some correlation to refining and purifying pills.
It is not easy to gather that many flames, and as far as I know, each flame must be at least Divine grade.
Once those are gathered, you will need to learn how to arrange them in a way that complements each other.
That is where most fail, for a slight mistake would not only spoil the technique but also compromise the overall result and even affect the flames you gathered.
Once that happens, you won’t be able to learn it ever again.
Pill King Han Lu had managed to accomplish all that, and the flame he is using now is the Verdant Flame.
This flame allows him to nurture the pill and bring out the latent nutrients still hidden in the harmless impurities in the pill.
Basically, every step has a different refining effect, and by the time he gets to the ninth step, he might actually be able to pull it off."
Kent nodded, already paying close attention.
However, five minutes after Pill King Han Lu started, Pill King Yota also condensed his pill, coming out with a Tier 10 pill.
So the race began, with the end goal of concocting a Tier 12 pill with a purity level of 90 or above.
It was the passing mark, so they all were aiming for the highest score, and Kent could already start to see the rivalry brewing slowly.
Only three hours were left, and each had managed to bring the grade of their pill to Tier 11, but they weren’t done.
They continually refined and nourished using various techniques to achieve the best results.
With only one hour left, Kent finally saw where real mastery of pill-making comes in.
Both Pill Kings were just a step away from concocting a Tier 12 pill, but there was nothing else Kent could see them doing to push through to that step.
This left him wondering what would happen next.
"Moments like this are when you witness those with true mastery when it comes to alchemy.
They are both in a bind, and with less than an hour left, they will either come out in a tie, or one will manage to reach the Tier 12 stage.
Even so, it is uncertain whether they will be able to maintain their purity levels.
Either way, one of them will be winning today."
"Isn’t that obvious?
The duel was set so that the two would compete, and only the best would win." Kent smiled and focused on the duel.
Thirty minutes before the time ran out, the two Pill Kings changed techniques, and instantly, both their pills broke into the Tier 12 stage, causing hush and gasps to spread across the sitting area.
"Now, things have become even more interesting.
With the two in a bind, the chances of one coming out on top are less likely.
If anything, they will be drawn," Suoh said, but Kent shook his head.
"I think Pill King Yota will win." His words contained confidence, the kind spoken with certainty.
"How sure are you?
They both attained Tier 12 pill grade and managed to maintain their purity, which, judging by the smell of the pill, is 92%.
So, how sure are you he will win?"
"It is simple.
Pill King Yota has more understanding of the flame than Pill King Han Lu, and that will be how he wins."

chapters.title: Chapter 804: End Of The Duel, Winner
paragraphs: "I don’t think either of them can show more than what they’ve shown," Suoh said, looking at the two Pill Kings actively working to increase the purity of their pills.

The moment they refined the pill to Tier 12, they switched to purification techniques. However, according to Suoh, based on the smell of the pills, both Pill Kings have a 92% pure Tier 12 pill in their cauldron.
This means they are now drawn, and none will be winning the prize.
However, Kent estimated that, based on what he saw, Pill King Yota would win. This was because, during the condensing and refining process, he counted 62 flame runes in his pill flame.
He was using a soul flame that had been awakened manually. This allowed him to use the same type of flame but with different properties throughout the process.
However, Kent initially saw 62 flame runes.
Now, however, he was counting 96, and the reason he knew Pill King Yota would win was because flame runes not only enhance the various aspects of the flame, but they can also be used to purify it.
Just like there are impurities in pills, there are impurities in flames, too. However, by forming flame runes, removing such impurities can give the much-needed purity to the flame.
That said, just 96 flame runes isn’t enough, but at the moment, it is enough to make a difference, and Pill King Yota was about to show everyone just that.
Of course, showing his support for Pill King Yota may appear biased because he was human, and Pill King Yota is also a variant of human.
However, his support was backed by Pill Monarch Nefeli, who was paying attention to Kent when he expressed his expectations to Suoh.
When she saw that, her mind went into deep thought.
Not only did Kent point out mistakes made by the Pill Kings, but he even managed to see Flame Runes and knew how they could be used.

"He is a genius. I’d better ensure he joins the Pyris Pill Alliance." Her words came from her heart. As a leader in one of the biggest pill alliances, she most certainly would love to have someone like Kent in their ranks.
They are currently ranked 7th among the ten Pill Worlds.
Of course, ranking 7th isn’t too bad, but she had hopes and dreams, and one of those dreams was to raise the ranking of the Pyris Pill Alliance.
She saw a way in Kent to achieve that, and so she would do everything in her power to make it happen.

"Though he is still young to make a difference, after today, all will know his credibility, and knowing those old bastard, they would try to use their power to pull him to their side. I’d better be the first to get to him."
Meanwhile, with only five minutes left to end the duel, Pill King Han Lu decided to end his refining early before he made any last-minute mistakes.
He took out his pill and stored it in a jade pill box. He didn’t want to expose it to nature, fearing he might lose its purity just by being outside.
Pill King Yota, meanwhile, continued to purify for three more minutes before ending his process. He also stored his pill in a jade box.
Kent smiled when he saw his pill.
Both pills were golden in color, which shows the true color of the pill. However, on them were white and blue lines, just like what appeared on Pill King Han Lu’s pill.
These marks aren’t there for decoration; they are used to determine both the purity and quality of the pill.
The white represents 80% refinement. Both Pill Kings passed that.
The blue represents 90% refinement. That, too, was achieved by both Pill Kings.
However, the reason Kent smiled when he saw Pill King Yota’s pill was because, while hidden and not visible without close inspection, with his enchanted eyes, Kent saw a faint green mark appear.
That showed he was close to 93% purity but not quite there yet.
Of course, to the untrained eye, it would appear and smell like a 92% pure pill, where, in this case, the time of completion would be used to judge the winner of the competition.
But Kent knew deep within that, as an influential organization such as this one, they would surely have a way to determine not only the grade and purity of the pill, but its quality.
If they did have a way to check that, they would see a "Low" or "Medium" rating for Pill King Han Lu and a "High" rating for Pill King Yota.

Kent’s appraisal told him that, and he trusted his enchanted eyes, so he knew the winner would be the Flame Elemental Human, whom he had already started formulating plans to approach for advice on how to learn the flame.
Pill Emperor Matin appeared right when Pill King Yota sealed his pill.
"That was an intense battle, but it had finally come to an end.𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝔀𝓮𝒃𝙣𝓸𝒗𝒆𝒍.𝙘𝒐𝒎
First of all, I would like to offer congratulations to both Pill Kings for demonstrating a great understanding of alchemy and what it means to be Pill Kings.

Not only did they manage to demonstrate that turning Tier 9 ingredients into a Tier 12 pill is possible, but they also showcased their deeper understanding by refining the pill to the highest purity level they could achieve.
However, unfortunately, only one of them can win. However, one thing to note is that winning and losing aren’t too bad when they create room for improvement.

That said, the pill will be appraised by the Pill Monarch, so be sure that no mistakes will be made today." The moment he ended his words, a green-dressed beauty appeared in the space, bringing her nourishing aura with her.
Stars began to appear in the eyes of many when she appeared. They knew who she was, but only a few had ever laid eyes on her.
So, seeing her for the first time and finally witnessing the beauty many had fantasized about, they couldn’t hold back their lustful desires.
Kent, however, sat there looking at the lady with a curious gaze.
’Because she has this calm and healing aura, many would think she is the most harmless person in the universe. Of course, many believe wood cultivators to be harmless.
However, that concealed aura—the one that many bloodthirsty maniacs can’t even come close to having—shows this lady’s is no rainbow and sunshine.
I’d better stay away from here before she devours me for breakfast.’
Kent’s heart shook when he sensed Pill Monarch Nefeli’s true aura. She was dangerous, and as someone who knew danger, he recognized her for who she was.
She didn’t say anything; instead, she took the two pills and held them in both hands. A green energy wrapped around them, and after a few minutes, she placed them back inside the jade boxes.
At this point, everyone was eager to know what had happened.
"They both concocted a 92% pure Tier 12 pill. However, the winner emerged with a higher-quality version of the pill. This is why I declare Pill King Yota the winner of this duel.
Better luck next time, Pill King Han Lu."
Kent smiled, hearing what he had long expected to happen. It turned out his enchanted eyes hadn’t deceived him at all.
Pill Refinement Color Marking. This is only applicable to Pills starting from Tier 12...
White ↠ 80%
Blue ↠ 90%
Green ↠ 93%
Gold ↠ 97%
Purple Gold ↠ 100%

chapters.title: Chapter 805: Uncle Drake’s Dominance
paragraphs: While Kent was swimming in the past, a lot was happening in the future.

After the Flame Tower closed, as Kent expected, the various leaders of their respective races started arriving in Elarion. Their reason for coming was simple: they wanted to benefit from the sudden rise of the Half-Elves.
Of course, not all came for that; some came with different objectives and motives.
However, the Dwarves, being the first to arrive, were welcomed with open arms, for among the various races, they, to some extent, had some relationship with the Half-Elves.
In attendance were the Dwarven Queen Ylva, Princess Freya, her maid and best friend Helga, two elders, and the Great Blacksmith in all of Sonox, Metal King Magda.
Their visit contained all the ingredients for a good conversation and something to offer.
The Dwarf Queen was friends with Queen Jascia. This was their first good move, bringing the queen to have the conversation.
With her past with Queen Jascia, they indeed brought out the big guns.
The princess and her maid had already made contact with the princess of the Half-Elves during the Flame Tower trial, showing there was a path they could explore, too.
Then there was Metal King Magda, with his skills, power, and influence; the Half-Elves wouldn’t be able to turn them down.
Of course, the Half-Elves had no plans to turn them down, for they already wanted to ally with the Dwarves. This relationship would yield long-term benefits for both parties.
So they were received well, and even the princess and her maid joined the eight Half-Elves to train under Uncle Drake while the adults talked.
Days later, after Kent wakes up from his dream-like sleep, the result of this new alliance will become plain to him.
However, soon, more races started appearing, and while none were turned back, they were also not received with the same enthusiasm as the Dwarves.
This angered races like the Elves and Dragons. But the Half-Elves held no obligation to show them any respect when they never did the same for them.
Quickly, the day of the auction came, and that was what many had come for.
The auction was simple.
There were three parts.
In the first part, the items were sold for spirit stones. The highest bidder won. Five items were sold: the Dragons got one, the Elves got one, the Demons got two, and the Qilin got one.
The second part of the auction was an exchange.
The one with the item the Half-Elves wanted would give the item to them. Of course, they increased the quantity to ten.
The Dwarves managed to get four out of the ten since they had some rare minerals that the Half-Elves were interested in.
The Demons got three, the Qilin got one, and the other Beast races got the rest.
Then came the last part of the auction.
Only two items were sold: an Immortal-grade Ambrosia apple and a Tier 8 Innate Talent awakening pill.
Naturally, the Half-Elves had more pills and fruit, but they sold just one to send a message.
This meant that the moment one race bought it, the rest would want to get some too, which would call for negotiation.
The Half-Elves would use this to squeeze not only more slots for the next time the Flame Tower opened but also to build a relationship they knew would gradually take shape.
However, adding the Tier 8 Innate Talent awakening pill was just a way for them to flaunt their wealth.
However, because of this addition, something they never saw coming happened, and the outcome was something no one in attendance saw coming.
The Ambrosia apple was sold to the Dwarves since, when it came to money, they had it in abundance.
However, the moment the Tier 8 Innate Talent awakening pill was bought, seven powerful auras—ones that pressed down on everyone in Elarion—appeared in the air.
[Day of the Auction - What happened]
"Now, for our last items, ladies and gentlemen, I present a 100% pure Tier 8 Innate Talent Awakening Pill."
High Priestess Dnul said, taking out a beautiful pill box with a white pill inside. The moment everyone saw the pill in the box, their eyes widened, and greed was evident on their faces.
The Crystal Dragon King slowly started retrieving a Tier 13 talisman, one that could unleash powers beyond the limit of a Medium world.
He had his plans, and this was the right moment to execute them.
However, just when he could fully take out the talisman, a suffocating aura pressed down on everyone.
"Hand over the pill and we will be on our way, else we will destroy this city and kill everyone within," a great white shark man said, exuding both arrogance and power.
It was plain that none of the leaders there could match him, not even Queen Jascia, who held her husband’s arm, her face pale.
"Who are you people?" she asked, wanting to make sure.
"We are from the Great Sea Race, and that pill is something Lord Leviathan, the last remaining Leviathan from the ancient era, wants."
Hearing his words, everyone shuddered, and their faces turned even paler. They had heard of the Sea race and knew of their power, so seeing not one but seven of them, they realized they were doomed.
However, just when some could start passing out, Uncle Drake calmly walked toward the center of the auction area and raised his head, looking at the seven sea generals sent by the seven sea kingdoms.
"Turn around and leave, or else only one of you will be returning home alive."
His words dripped with arrogance, but the nonchalant look on his face and calm demeanor made the seven sea generals know he was no easy dragon.
However, arrogance has a way of blinding people.
Instead of running away, they chose to display their arrogance. "We came for the pill and will not leave until we have it. If you stand in our way, then you will be cut—"
SLASH
Before the Great White Shark could end his sentence, Uncle Drake moved and, with a casual swing of his hand, severed his head from his body.
SLASH
SLASH
Two more swings happened, adding more heads to the first one. But Uncle Drake didn’t stop there; he moved three more times.
SLASH
SLASH
SLASH
Within three seconds, six heads lay on the ground. Only a seahorse lady remained hovering in the air, her face pale like a white sheet.
"Take them and leave. Tell your Leviathan man, or whoever his name is, to come get the pill himself if he has the spine."
With a swing of his hand, the headless bodies and their heads were sent flying several miles away from Elarion, with the seahorse lady and the dead bodies with their heads slamming into a mountain.

Back in Elarion, although the aura had been taken away by the quick and decisive massacre, aside from the Half-Elves who had recovered and had color return to their faces, the other races still looked pale, watching Uncle Drake walk away.
The Crystal Dragon King quickly returned the talisman to his pocket, knowing a sudden mistake would cost him his life easily.
Not only he, but the others planning to make a stupid move were all enlightened about the danger they were in, and that alone changed their minds.
In an unusual way, the power shown by Uncle Drake had made Kent’s dream come true much faster than he would have ever expected.
After the auction, none of them immediately returned home; instead, they all sought to explore a possible alliance with the Half-Elves and to secure a better future for their people.

"Turn around and leave, or else only one of you will be returning home alive."
His words dripped with arrogance, but the nonchalant look on his face and calm demeanor made the seven sea generals know he was no easy dragon.
However, arrogance has a way of blinding people.
Instead of running away, they chose to display their arrogance.
"We came for the pill and will not leave until we have it.
If you stand in our way, then you will be cut—"
SLASH
Before the Great White Shark could end his sentence, Uncle Drake moved and, with a casual swing of his hand, severed his head from his body.
SLASH
SLASH
Two more swings happened, adding more heads to the first one.
But Uncle Drake didn’t stop there; he moved three more times.
SLASH
SLASH
SLASH
Within three seconds, six heads lay on the ground.
Only a seahorse lady remained hovering in the air, her face pale like a white sheet.
"Take them and leave.
Tell your Leviathan man, or whoever his name is, to come get the pill himself if he has the spine."
With a swing of his hand, the headless bodies and their heads were sent flying several miles away from Elarion, with the seahorse lady and the dead bodies with their heads slamming into a mountain.

Back in Elarion, although the aura had been taken away by the quick and decisive massacre, aside from the Half-Elves who had recovered and had color return to their faces, the other races still looked pale, watching Uncle Drake walk away.
The Crystal Dragon King quickly returned the talisman to his pocket, knowing a sudden mistake would cost him his life easily.
Not only he, but the others planning to make a stupid move were all enlightened about the danger they were in, and that alone changed their minds.
In an unusual way, the power shown by Uncle Drake had made Kent’s dream come true much faster than he would have ever expected.
After the auction, none of them immediately returned home; instead, they all sought to explore a possible alliance with the Half-Elves and to secure a better future for their people.

chapters.title: Chapter 806: Meeting Pill Monarch Nefeli [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Brother Kent, you said it. In the end, Pill King Yota did manage to win," Suoh said, and Kent smiled.
"I guess I was impressed with how he controls his flame, so I wanted him to win."
"Even so, you managed to see how good he was with his flame and predicted his win. Not many can do what you did." Suoh, of course, was doing everything to get in Kent’s good graces.
The competition had come to an end, and so they would be parting ways. Before that happened, he wanted to leave a good impression on Kent. Praising Kent’s ingenuity was one way of doing that.
Kent read that, and while he didn’t mind, he knew that the moment he woke up in the future, coming to the exact past again would be hard.

But then again, he didn’t know what would happen the next time he entered the Pill World. Gaia told him nobody could see him when he was inside the oil world, yet that wasn’t the case now, so who said he couldn’t come back to this point?𝐟𝕣𝕖𝐞𝐰𝕖𝚋𝐧𝗼𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝗰𝐨𝐦
So, in a way, he was hoping he would come back, and that was why he planned on giving this new friendship a shot.
"I also have to thank you for helping me know more about this place and your insight into Alchemy. I am grateful and would one of these days pay back your help," Kent said, and Suoh smiled.
"No need to thank me, Brother Kent. It’s what friends do for each other."
"I guess you’re right." Kent knew this was the time to show Suoh they were friends, so he added a few lines that brought a smile to Suoh’s face, "Since we are friends, you can just call me Kent."
"Then you can also call me Suoh."
And just like that, a friendship between someone 340,700 years in the past and one from the future had just formed.
"Here is my communication token. Whenever you visit the Elven Nation, you can contact me, and I will take you around the many Elven cities and even the Lotus Bloom Pill Sect."

Kent received the communication token and stored it in his tower storage, which surprisingly worked. Of course, he didn’t expect the token to be there when he went back, considering this was just a dream-like state he had found himself in.
A few minutes later, Kent felt the gaze of Pill Emperor Matin prompting him to look at him. He was standing a few meters away.
Kent quickly stood up.
"Follow me to see the Pill Monarch." Kent nodded and turned to Suoh. "Until next time, Suoh. I will be sure to buy you a drink so we can talk more about alchemy."
"Until next time, Kent." Suoh waved goodbye, and Kent left with the Pill Emperor under the watchful gaze of everyone still on the 7th floor.
They clearly still didn’t understand how a mere Pill Grandmaster was able to win such a big opportunity over them. The vengeful ones started looking into Kent, with a few turning their fangs at Suoh.

However, the moment they saw the badge of the Lotus Bloom Pill Sect, they backed off. Unless they wanted to incur the wrath of one of the strongest sects in the world, they would do well not to touch him.
Soon, Kent and Pill Emperor Matin entered a room, walked across it, and entered another room. From there, Pill Emperor Matin pointed at a door.
"The Pill Monarch awaits you there."

Kent nodded and nervously asked, "Can I get any pointers on how to face her? This is my first time seeing even a Pill Emperor, and as you can see, I am nervous around you, so how can I face a Pill Monarch without making a clown of myself?"
Pill Emperor Matin smiled, "Just be yourself. She is an easy-going person; you will do well just by being yourself."
"Being myself, huh? I suppose I can do that." Kent laughed nervously, making Pill Emperor Matin smile.
If the judges at the Academy Awards saw this, they would hand him the Oscar for the Actor of the Year award.
If anything, Kent wanted to see this woman more than anything. However, after seeing the various ways the Pill Kings concocted their pills, he knew there was so much he could learn.
He is good with the pill records, but learning from other sources will build upon the already embedded knowledge he received from the tower whenever he ascends a rank in Pill Making.
So he wanted to make a good impression on the Pill Emperor.
Perhaps one of these days, if he managed to find his way back to this place, he would ask for some pointers.
Safe to say he had done a remarkable job on that front. Now, all that was left was to meet the Pill Monarch and learn the reason why she summoned him.
Of course, when it comes to charming women, Kent has already sunk his fangs into a goddess, so he had no problem on that front.
Kent walked toward the door, and when he was in front of it, he pushed it open and walked through.
The moment he stepped into the room where the Pill Monarch was seated in her throne-like chair, Kent felt his body wrapped in a healing aura, the kind that made him feel relaxed.
’She is dangerous. If I didn’t know better, I would have fallen for her tactic. Too bad I know a threat when I see one, so don’t think you can pry into my secrets, lady.’
Kent stood there, looking at the Pill Monarch, who was also looking at him. The two were locked in a staring contest that lasted four minutes.
In Kent’s POV, he was keeping his composure, making sure he didn’t slip and let loose some of his secrets while the Pill Monarch was doing her best to examine Kent’s nature.
Safe to say, after four minutes, she couldn’t get anything out of him.

"Interesting. I have been around for almost twenty thousand years now, but this is my first time seeing someone who stood guard against me," the Pill Monarch smiled. "Tell me, Pill Grandmaster Kent, why do you look guarded facing me?"

Kent smiled. "My mother used to say the more beautiful they are, the more dangerous they are. You, Pill Monarch, are one of the most beautiful women I have seen, and as a good son, I take my mother’s words seriously."
The Pill Monarch burst out laughing, something nobody had the privilege to see. However, upon hearing Kent’s reply, she couldn’t hold back her laughter, which lasted a whole minute.
"Smooth talker, huh. I guess I can just call you Kent, and you can call me Big Sister Nefeli. You cannot reject that offer."
’I would be an idiot to reject such an inviting offer.’
Kent smiled. "I guess I will call you Big Sister from now on."
"That is better. So why don’t you sit down so we can have a conversation? I have a few things I would like to ask you, and don’t worry, they aren’t too much to get into your secrets."
Kent sat down and prepared himself to have a conversation with a Pill Monarch.

chapters.title: Chapter 807: Conversation With a Pill Monarch [Bonus]
paragraphs: "So, who are you, Kent? What is your story?" Pill Monarch Nefeli asked.
I guess that was one way of asking me to tell you everything about me. Kent smiled in his head and chose to answer to the best of his abilities.

"I am Kent, as you already know. Of course, my full name is Kent Madson. I am a human from a world called Sonox. Although I just said it, I don’t think you’ll know it because it’s quite a distance away.
I started walking the path of Alchemy about three years ago. Aside from that, I am also a swordsman, which I know you already know, for a swordsman recognizes one."
Kent smiled.
Pill Monarch Nefeli also smiled.
Kent could see it.
The calm and nurturing aura is from her Alchemy side. The woman sitting not far from him is, in fact, a Sword Emperor, and judging by her aura, she was a terrifying one.
"You are sharp, I will give you that. But if you don’t mind me asking, this world you are from, how far away is it?"
Kent thought for a moment, just to put on the appearance of trying to figure out the answer. After a few moments, he shook his head.
"Can’t say I can tell. Of course, I will try to look for this world when I go back."
"Oh, you didn’t come here by design?" Pill Monarch Nefeli raised her eyebrow.

"Something like that. One moment, I was walking down a hill; the next moment, I found myself here. Of course, I have a feeling I will either be here for a while or might vanish like I came any moment from now."

"I see. I suppose it’s complicated in a way, but it makes sense. I know you are a human like me, but also not like me. I am a wood human, and there are others out there like the Flame Human who won the duel.
You, on the other hand, aren’t like us. You are just human, not related to any of the eight principal elements. This means you really aren’t from this world or any of the pill worlds."
"I guess you can say that," Kent nodded to her deduction. It was spot on, and that alone explained why he wouldn’t have to do so many things anymore.
"So you can vanish any moment, huh? That is such a disappointment. Who knows when that will happen?"

Kent smiled. "I might not vanish anytime soon since I don’t know how any of this works, so we might as well have a conversation that will stick with us even if I were to vanish away one of these days or in a few hours."

"I suppose if you put it this way, things do come into perspective. In that case, do you want to join the Pyris Pill Alliance? I know you are a Pill Grandmaster, but I saw how you observed the two Pill Kings during the duel.
You knew more than you let on, and that alone is more than reason enough for me to want you to join this alliance. You are someone worthy of joining the Alliance.
So, what do you say, Kent?

Kent thought for a moment and then smiled. "I don’t mind joining the Alliance. However, what if I were to vanish and not return for hundreds of thousands of years? What then would happen to my status?"

"Your status as a member will remain intact no matter how many years pass, so don’t worry about that. However, you must at least improve your Pill Path to the Saint stage before making everyone aware of your status in the alliance.
Aside from that, you should also participate in a duel or two if you have time on your hands."
Kent nodded.
Pill Monarch Nefeli smiled and took out a scroll, unfurling it in front of Kent. "Drop your blood on it." Kent followed the process and dropped his blood on it.
The moment his blood touched the scroll, his name and current grade in the Pill Path appeared on it for a few seconds before it vanished.
The scroll vanished, and in its place was a token.
"That is your identity and membership badge. It works everywhere you go, and if you were to find yourself in a world affiliated with this alliance or the other ten pill worlds, it will glow.
You can use it to move around easily. Also, the markings on it indicate your rank in the alliance. So far, you are a mere member."
"How can I raise the ranking?"
"Simple: challenge disciples from other Pill Worlds and win. The more you spread the good name of the Pyris Pill Alliance, the higher your rank will soar.
Of course, there are other ways to push your ranking, but so far, this is the only method you need to know.
The ranks that follow are: Senior Member, Elder, Scholar, General, Commander, and Magnus."
"I see. I guess I will handle this badge with care and make sure I raise my rank much higher."
"You should strive for a higher ranking, because the higher you rise, the more perks you will receive, and the more perks you receive, the faster your growth."
Kent took her words in with a thoughtful expression. The likelihood that he would use the badge was low, considering where he was going back to.
Of course, there was the part where he would have actually taken the thing back to the future. It sounded corny, but he was merely dreaming, so taking anything back was less likely.
"Now, I will tell you something small about the Grand Pill Tablet, and you can figure out the rest. From what I know, the Grand Pill Tablet is a Supreme Item that holds the knowledge of Alchemy.

It contains everything there is to know, and whatever you ask it, it will respond with a solution. I have interacted with it on multiple occasions, and I can say it is the perfect tool for a young Alchemist such as you."
"It’s indeed a valuable item. I guess I will have a great time interacting with it," Kent said, already planning the things he would ask the Grand Pill Tablet when he got time with it.
"Unfortunately, you can only ask one question. After that, you have to wait 100 years before you can ask the next question.
Everyone must wait one full year to ask a question. But trust me, it is an invaluable item because the answer it gives is what you need.
Perhaps if all the broken parts are assembled, one could have more time to ask multiple questions."
Kent nodded.
"So what does one usually have to do to get time with the tablet?" Kent asked, and Pill Monarch Nefeli smiled.

"To get another chance to view the tablet, you must contribute greatly to the Alliance. Say you managed to defeat an alchemist of higher standing in the other pill alliances; that will boost your ranking and also reward you.
In most cases, adding to the alliance’s collection is perhaps the fastest way to gain access to the tablet."
Kent smiled. "And I suppose if I were to add items in my name but want the reward to be given to someone else, would that be allowed?"
"I suppose that can be allowed." Kent’s smile bloomed.
"In that case, I would like to add 20 Soul-type pill recipes to the alliance collection, and the reward should be given to Pill Sage Suoh."
Pill Monarch Nefeli’s eyes widened upon hearing Kent’s words.

chapters.title: Chapter 808: Back to the Future
paragraphs: "If it isn’t enough, I will add more to it," Kent said, watching the Pill Monarch, whose brow was raised, looking at Kent with an expression that on one part displayed shock while on the other side displayed an unreadable look—one that made Kent nervous.
He didn’t know whether his request would be received or might get him kicked out.

It sounded like he wanted to bribe the alliance to buy a slot for Suoh, whom he planned to leave a good impression on. However, he was merely trying to make a name for himself and help Suoh while at it.
"Are you sure you want to give 20 soul-type pill recipes to the alliance?" Kent sighed a little, hearing her question.
"Well, I don’t have a use for them, so I might as well give them away to a good cause, and since it will be helping my friend Suoh, I suppose it will be worth it."
Pill Monarch Nefeli studied Kent for a few seconds before asking a question.
"Do you know the value of a single soul-type pill recipe?"
"Can’t say I’ve had the privilege to explore the world of alchemy, seeing I started making pills just three years ago," Kent laughed, knowing he had only lit a pill flame for a quarter of the time.
"So why don’t you enlighten me?"
"Then listen well. In the world of Alchemy, some recipes are rare, so rare that finding them demands great wealth and connections.
Soul-type recipes are one such rarity.
They were once popular during the Primordial Era.

However, after the Primordial Era fell, they became so rare that even I, a Pill Monarch, only have two soul-type pill recipes, and even one of them was the basic taught to all Pill Emperors and above."
Kent furrowed his brow, hearing that. ’Looks like I have something many will kill for.’𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖
Realizing that, his face went pale when he recognized where he was and who had just discovered one of the many secrets he never knew he had.
In his defense, he never knew how amazing the pill recipes he received from the Primordial Pill Records were.
However, now it seemed he had to be more careful, and that started by figuring out whether his "supposed" big sister was greedy or not.
First of all, Kent knew he could not escape, and he most certainly could not face that lady, for she could kill him before he even thought of running away.
He faced a Spirit Lord before, but he knew King Balma would look like a puppy before Pill Monarch Nefeli.
Kent knew he was in deep now, and his mistake was not learning about all the amazing pill recipes he had.
Pill Monarch Nefeli saw the hesitation appear on Kent’s face and smiled, "Don’t overthink, Kent. I have no intention of stealing from you. If anything, I want to advise you instead."
Kent relaxed a little, but he still looked guarded.

"In the future, never reveal that you have any of these pill recipes. Anything related to Souls, Innate Talent, Meridians, and Cores. They are the most closely guarded secrets that cannot be easily revealed.
That said, since you offered, I will take the recipes, but I will only add one in your name since just one is valuable enough to allow your friend to view the Grand Pill Tablet five times.
However, I don’t intend to keep the rest for myself.
I will add the next recipe 10,000 years from today, and the third will be added 100,000 years from when the second was added.
Of course, should I die before then, it will die with me, for I cannot in good conscience add 20 Soul-type pill recipes to the collection of the Pyris Pill Alliance.
Doing so would be calling doom on myself and the entire Pyris Pill Alliance. I hope you understand my good intentions."
Kent nodded. "I guess you do what is good for the alliance and me. In that case, do you want me to write it down or transfer it to you?"
"Transferring will make it much more secure. It will be easy to place seals on said memories and only unlock them when the time intervals to release them reach."
"Then I will transfer it to you."

Kent walked closer and placed his index finger on Pill Monarch Nefeli’s forehead. Using the same method he had used to transfer skills to his undead and legion, he began transferring the recipes to her.
"This is crazy," she muttered as the recipes flowed into her head. When the last one was added, her eyes widened.
"This—"

Kent smiled. "It is something small for you to build your strength, so when it comes to it, you can better protect yourself. That said, if you can find a way to give a few of those pills to Suoh, I will be grateful."
Pill Monarch Nefeli was left stunned, unsure of what to say or how to behave.
Kent just smiled.
He had added the Innate Talent Awakening Pill. Now that he knew how rare soul-type recipes are, he didn’t want to leave her vulnerable.
With the Innate Talent Awakening Pills, if she had the ingredients, she would be able to rise to the level where nobody can kill her, regardless of their ranks, if they are below Divinity.
This would preserve her life, and since Kent had started thinking he was indeed in the past, he wanted to ensure the future didn’t disappoint him.
"I will be sure to treasure it with my life, Kent," Pill Monarch Nefeli said, and Kent nodded. Suddenly, a voice entered his mind.
⟦The master will wake up in 10 seconds⟧
’Good to hear your voice, Tower. Now, do me a favor by capturing an image of what you see now and framing it for me.’
⟦Already ahead of you, master⟧

Kent smiled. He wanted to say something, anything, but something told him he shouldn’t. So he just took in the beautiful looks of the lady before him, and when the timer hit zero, he woke up in the future.
[Planet Kryos (Immortal World). Nebulon Mountain. Grand Pyris Pagoda – Last Floor (Present day.)]

A beautiful green-haired, green-eyed, and green-lipped beauty sat in a majestic throne-like chair reading a scroll. Around her, a calm aura—one that would make even devils fall in love with her—filled the room.
And judging by the density of this aura, it was clear she was an immortal, a King Immortal to be precise. Her beauty is unimaginable.
In all of the 100 immortal worlds in the Vornix Immortal Planetary Alliance, she could be counted among the top three beauties.
She was both impressive, intelligent, and terrifyingly powerful.

Suddenly, her vision turned hazy, and then she fell back in her throne, passing out. Two hours later, she woke up feeling fine; however, a name appeared in her mind that made her wonder where it had come from.
"Kent Madson... Who is that?"
[Planet Panama (Immortal World)]
Inside a lush garden filled with pill herbs, a handsome elf was attending to his herbs when suddenly, he felt a little lightheaded. Before he could shake it off, he fell and passed out.
Two hours later, he woke up, also fine. However, just like what happened to Pill Immortal Nefeli, a name appeared in his mind, causing him to wonder just who that name belonged to.
"Kent... who is that?"

chapters.title: Chapter 809: Gains and Questions
paragraphs: Kent walked out of the Pill World room with many messages flooding his vision. He felt a little lightheaded from the sleep and the experience he had gone through.
When he came out, he drank some water before moving to a small herb garden he had planted the last time he was in the Alchemy Tower.
After sitting down, Kent cast his mind back to the experience he had just had, starting from when he met Suoh, the duel, and ending with his conversation with Pill Monarch Nefeli.
"That was intense," Kent sighed. "Going to the past through my sleep. Who would even believe that ridiculousness?"
Then he reached into his Tower Storage, only to find two things he never expected to see inside.
"This means it wasn’t a dream, and I really went to the past," Kent concluded with a thoughtful expression.
"Insane"

"If that is the case, does it mean if they are still alive, Pill Monarch Nefeli and Suoh would still remember me?" This question prompted Kent’s mind to enter a moment of reflection, one he never expected to have right after returning from the past.
"This is crazy, to think I went to the past and back through sleep. Isn’t this akin to time travel?" Kent wondered, and then he understood something that came to him naturally.
"The Pill World room is not merely a room or dream-pod; it is a channel to the Pill worlds Suoh and big sister Nefeli talk about."
This conclusion seemed more logical considering he not only has a badge that shows he is a member of the Pyris Pill Alliance, but he also has a communication token from the past.

"The only questions now are, ’Would I return to the exact past I left just now,’ or ’Would the ones I interacted with remember up to the point we left off after I was pulled back,’ or ’Would I be pulled to a different Pill world the next time I enter the Pill World room?’"
"Also, does this mean I can raise my ranking in the Pyris Pill Alliance by using the Pill World Room to visit other Pill worlds and challenge them to duels?"
There are many more questions Kent would love to ask, but he knew the answers could only be given by Gaia, who is still asleep.
He had to wait and ask them later.
"Tower, can you estimate how far back I went?" Kent asked, and the tower responded almost immediately.
⟦The master had gone 340,700 years back⟧
"Wow, that is a long time. But if that is true, then I must have long been forgotten by big sister Nefeli. Maybe not," Kent sighed and then turned to other things.
"Thinking too much about this won’t yield any results. If the two people I interacted with are alive, I will look for them when I become stronger."
Kent saw the messages that had appeared, and as he expected, most were messages showing improvements in his comprehension of the flame.

Naturally, he could feel that his understanding of the flame had improved dramatically, and it wasn’t just that; his knowledge about Essence extraction, impurity burning and removal, condensing, refining, and pill purification had also seen a drastic leap.
"I didn’t waste my time at all. In a way, I made so much progress that it would have taken me a while to comprehend on my own. This Pill World is a gold mine."
Kent laughed.

He most certainly didn’t expect to make this much progress, but he did, and the outcome is now plain as day: the Pill World is the answer to some of the questions he has and the easiest way to add more knowledge to what he already knows when it comes to Alchemy.
"If the Pill World is already this good, I wonder what the Sword World will be like and what I will gain from using that."
Kent began to see a more effective use of the tower that Gaia had been mad at him for not utilizing. Kent has the means, but he wasn’t using them like Gaia expected him to.
If he had, he would have made so much more progress than he had at the moment.
Kent shook his head and was already waiting for Gaia’s shameless remarks when he praised her for telling him about how impressive the tower is. "She will gloat, but I guess she deserves to gloat."
His gaze turned to the last set of messages, and the smile on his face widened.
⟦Congratulations, a race you have under your protection has gained new allies. You will now receive Soul Essence from the new allies⟧
Kent quickly checked the Guardian Allies for the Elarion Half-Elves, and his eyes widened.
⟦Elarion Half-Elves⟧
⟦Allies:
↠ Stoneforge Dwarves
↠ Flame Demons
↠ Shadow Demons
↠ Dark Elves
↠ Qilinkin
↠ Tigerkin
↠ Succubi
↠ Blood Demons
↠ Bearkin
↠ Incubi
↠ Earth Dragons
↠ Lynxkin
↠ Boarkin
↠ Serpentkin
↠ Ice Demons
↠ Elves⟧
"Looks like some are still resisting. However, knowing what this means, those who have joined, it won’t be long before the rest fall in line.
But to see the Elves in this lineup, I suppose they aren’t as bad as I thought.
I will let Array Emperor Ashfur come and build the Grand Ascension Platform for them.
Soon, I will go to other high worlds, and using the coordinates, I can link them to the Ascension Platform, allowing them to have more options to choose from when ascending.
I will also make it so they can return whenever they want."
Kent was about to close the interface when he saw new messages.
Upon checking, it turned out the Foxkins in Fedora had also strengthened their alliances with the Catkins and the Tigerkins. This added more Soul Essence to Kent’s stockpile.
"At this rate, I have to know how far along the asteroid has come." He entered the Soul Universe, and when his gaze landed on the asteroid, his smile bloomed.
The asteroid is now about 24 meters in diameter, and as he looked at the metallic shine coating it, Kent knew he had built a deadly weapon.
"But this isn’t enough. I want an asteroid with a diameter of 10 km. This way, the moment it is unleashed, it won’t fail.
And since I now have more than enough Soul Essence, I can get it done in months at this point." The happiness on Kent’s face said it all.
"This is good. I can now feel secure and wait for the day I will need to unleash this. But first, I have to go to the sect, which will get me access to other worlds.
That is more Soul Essence for me to use for my Moon and Space Missile projects.
It is going to be raining moons and missiles soon."𝚏𝐫𝚎𝗲𝕨𝐞𝐛𝕟𝚘𝐯𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝗺
Kent exited the Soul Universe and freshened up. He changed into his casual attire and vanished back to Elarion.

The selected disciples will be heading back to the Flame Mountains in a few hours, where the sect will come to collect them. But until then, Kent wanted to see what had changed in Elarion while he was away.
Also, he wanted to give some missions to the Half-Elves that would further elevate the amount of Soul Essence he was getting from them.

When he appeared, Uncle Drake was giving the last set of advice to the youngsters he had trained, which now included the Dwarven princess and her friend Helga, Kella from the Elves (since they are now allies with the Half-Elves), to Kent’s shock, and a few others from the other races.
He smiled and approached them.
