chapters.title: Chapter 810: Getting Ready [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Looks like you guys have made a lot of progress since the last time I saw you," Kent said, looking at the eight Half-Elves and a few others who were in the Flame Tower with them.
They seemed happy and proud of their achievements.

"It’s all thanks to Uncle Drake," Princess Elowen said, her smile blooming. "He helped us understand quite a lot. We even managed to push our mastery of some of our flame techniques to the Intermediate stage."
Kent looked at Uncle Drake and smiled.
He started to see that the dragon before him was more than he appeared to be. There was more to him.
"Since he has indeed managed to help you, none of you should fail the entrance exams. You all must enter the sect and dominate." They nodded, and Kent chose to have some words with Uncle Drake.
They moved away, and after walking for a few seconds, Kent asked the question he had been aiming to ask from the moment he arrived.
"Did anything interesting happen while I was gone?"
Uncle Drake just smirked and shrugged. "Some idiots from the Sea Race came trying to seize the pill during the auction. I killed six and sent their parts away with the seventh."
"Oh. I suppose they didn’t get the memo, so they tried to act tough."
"I suppose. They claimed that a guy named Leviathan wanted the pill. I’m sure any day now he will come, or he might send some more goons over."
"What do you plan on doing?"
"Kill them all. I don’t have much going on, so I might as well use them to train. I only hope they don’t disappoint me."
Kent laughed.

’I suppose that’s how it feels when your strength exceeds the world you’re in. I guess after that Leviathan guy comes and he takes care of him, I will send him to Fedora to see if he can grow much more before I ascend.’
"Just don’t kill too many of them. If anything, offer them an option to become your subordinates. If they reject, just kill a few and let the rest go.
Also, if the Leviathan guy comes, thrash him but don’t kill him. I own the Leviathans, so killing their descendants—even if one is as arrogant as this—isn’t something I plan on doing."
"I can do that."
Kent nodded and went on to talk to Uncle Drake for a few minutes before parting ways.
He went to see the king and queen, who were in a meeting with a few representatives from the Elven Kingdom and the Earth Dragon Kingdom.
He allowed them to end their conversation, and after they left, he started his meeting with them. They told him all that had happened after he left.
Most, of course, he was already aware of, for he had seen the messages and the changes in his Soul Universe. After they had ensured everything was said, Kent also shared his plans for their future.
"I will send someone here in the next few months to begin building a unique Ascension Platform. It will link to a high world called Fedora, home to beasts.
In the future, I will add more worlds to it. However, for now, it will have only one world, and the good part is that you can go and come back, provided you have the Spirit Stones to return.
As for those who can use it, I will leave that to you to figure out. That said, you should also visit all the races you are allied with and select twelve capable people.
I will leave a special package with Uncle Drake. He will help with their training.
Aside from that, if you can gather the resources on this list, in the future, Uncle Drake wouldn’t even be required to protect you or any of your allies from danger."

Kent went on, making sure they all had what they needed before he left. They were supplying him with what he needed every single second, so he might as well ensure they also had what they needed to keep growing.
After everything was said and done, Kent joined the rest of his peers. Of course, speaking of peers, they were much older than he, but they all looked the same, so they were his peers in looks.
[Supreme Immortal Sect – Outer Area – Grand Hall]
Supreme Elder Jian, the highest authority in the outer area of the sect, sat in his chair, looking at Elder Lance, whose expression alternated between happiness and fear.
He was angry.
It had been a few days since Elder Lance dropped the bomb on them, and since then, things had never been the same.
As elders of the sect, they were obligated to seek out talented and promising disciples and send them to the Inner Area for proper grooming.
They had been doing their work quite well for the past thousand years. However, this time around, they were in a bind, for they didn’t know what to do.

Corruption was pervasive, and although it was uncommon for such a prestigious sect to have corrupt individuals, all six senior elders in the outer area of the sect were rotten to the core.𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶

This was why, instead of giving Sonox the quota they deserved every three years, they lied to the higher-ups that the place was filled with trash and, in return, sold half the slots that belonged to Sonox to the other worlds.
However, things were different now.

Elder Lance provided them with evidence showing the talent he had discovered in the world they called trash, and as such, they didn’t know how the higher-ups would behave if they found out these talents had been hidden all this time.
The reason they weren’t discovered was that Sonox was given only 100 slots, depriving them of the chance to send more people to the sect.
This was why they had to fix that, and they had the best leverage.
"Listen, you lowlife," Elder Aster, the beautiful Dark Elf, said, pointing at Elder Lance.
"You are the strongest in your world, and it’s because of that the Slime Race couldn’t lay a finger on your people. So, listen to what we tell you, and it will remain that way.

All you have to do is veer off course by a fraction when moving through the humming void. The rest will take care of itself. When at a critical junction, use the teleportation talisman to get back here, and we will handle the aftermath.
Do I make myself clear?"
Elder Lance didn’t respond.
"I will take that as a yes. Now, get moving. Use the teleportation formation when going. It will cut the trip short."

Elder Lance left the hall, clenching his fist. He didn’t know he would find himself in this situation, where he would be asked to choose between his race and a group of geniuses he knew would uphold the good name of the sect.
Unlike the senior elders, he held the goodwill of the sect at heart. This was why he didn’t want to doom a group of geniuses by doing what he was asked to do.
But he couldn’t bring harm to his people, either.
’What should I do?’
His mind started to hum, looking for answers as he made his way to the teleportation formation to pick up Kent and the others from Sonox.

sentences.text: "Looks like you guys have made a lot of progress since the last time I saw you," Kent said, looking at the eight Half-Elves and a few others who were in the Flame Tower with them.
They seemed happy and proud of their achievements.
"It’s all thanks to Uncle Drake," Princess Elowen said, her smile blooming.
"He helped us understand quite a lot.
We even managed to push our mastery of some of our flame techniques to the Intermediate stage."
Kent looked at Uncle Drake and smiled.
He started to see that the dragon before him was more than he appeared to be.
There was more to him.
"Since he has indeed managed to help you, none of you should fail the entrance exams.
You all must enter the sect and dominate." They nodded, and Kent chose to have some words with Uncle Drake.
They moved away, and after walking for a few seconds, Kent asked the question he had been aiming to ask from the moment he arrived.
"Did anything interesting happen while I was gone?"
Uncle Drake just smirked and shrugged.
"Some idiots from the Sea Race came trying to seize the pill during the auction.
I killed six and sent their parts away with the seventh."
"Oh.
I suppose they didn’t get the memo, so they tried to act tough."
"I suppose.
They claimed that a guy named Leviathan wanted the pill.
I’m sure any day now he will come, or he might send some more goons over."
"What do you plan on doing?"
"Kill them all.
I don’t have much going on, so I might as well use them to train.
I only hope they don’t disappoint me."
Kent laughed.
’I suppose that’s how it feels when your strength exceeds the world you’re in.
I guess after that Leviathan guy comes and he takes care of him, I will send him to Fedora to see if he can grow much more before I ascend.’
"Just don’t kill too many of them.
If anything, offer them an option to become your subordinates.
If they reject, just kill a few and let the rest go.
Also, if the Leviathan guy comes, thrash him but don’t kill him.
I own the Leviathans, so killing their descendants—even if one is as arrogant as this—isn’t something I plan on doing."
"I can do that."
Kent nodded and went on to talk to Uncle Drake for a few minutes before parting ways.
He went to see the king and queen, who were in a meeting with a few representatives from the Elven Kingdom and the Earth Dragon Kingdom.
He allowed them to end their conversation, and after they left, he started his meeting with them.
They told him all that had happened after he left.
Most, of course, he was already aware of, for he had seen the messages and the changes in his Soul Universe.
After they had ensured everything was said, Kent also shared his plans for their future.
"I will send someone here in the next few months to begin building a unique Ascension Platform.
It will link to a high world called Fedora, home to beasts.
In the future, I will add more worlds to it.
However, for now, it will have only one world, and the good part is that you can go and come back, provided you have the Spirit Stones to return.
As for those who can use it, I will leave that to you to figure out.
That said, you should also visit all the races you are allied with and select twelve capable people.
I will leave a special package with Uncle Drake.
He will help with their training.
Aside from that, if you can gather the resources on this list, in the future, Uncle Drake wouldn’t even be required to protect you or any of your allies from danger."
Kent went on, making sure they all had what they needed before he left.
They were supplying him with what he needed every single second, so he might as well ensure they also had what they needed to keep growing.
After everything was said and done, Kent joined the rest of his peers.
Of course, speaking of peers, they were much older than he, but they all looked the same, so they were his peers in looks.

chapters.title: Chapter 811: Elder Lance Troubles [Bonus]
paragraphs: "You all should do your best and get into the sect. It is the start of your journey, one that will take you to the peak," Queen Jascia said, looking at the lineup of youngsters going to the sect.

Beside her were the other leaders, whose candidates were among those who trained under Uncle Drake. They all came to wish them farewell and encourage them one last time to do their best to join the sect.
After they said all they had to say, Queen Jascia opened a portal to the Flame Mountains, and everyone entered. Most stayed behind, but she went with Kent and the others.
Uncle Drake also went with them.
When they appeared on the Flame Mountain, there were others there. Of course, most were new faces, mostly royals who had received an invitation to enter the sect.

Of course, Kent could sense the stares from them, and judging by the ones he was receiving from the Crystal Dragon Prince and the Flame Dragon Princess, they weren’t happy he was taking all the spotlight from them.
But who could blame them? If they were to learn 12 Divine grade techniques, perhaps they would also gain the same spotlight.

Kent didn’t even bother with them, for he knew killing them would be as simple as waving his hand. Had it not been for his duel with the Pill Princess, he wouldn’t have wasted his time entering the sect.
Of course, he was now eager to see the strongest the medium world had to offer, and the only way to do that was to join a sect that could give him that platform.
These children, thinking they were the greatest under the heavens, were merely swimming in ponds while he had already dived into the surging seas.
They settled down and began to wait for the representatives from the supreme Immortal sect.
It took two hours, but eventually, Elder Lance arrived, this time alone. He appeared through the void since it was the fastest way to move.

’That is odd. For a sect of renown, they sure don’t hold their potential disciples in esteem, sending only one person to come for them," Kent said inwardly, looking at the elder appear through the void.
After the void closed, everyone started to wonder the same thing as Kent.
Of course, none had the guts to voice it out. Kent didn’t care. To him, reaching the sect was of utmost priority. He didn’t care who came for him or how many of them there were.
Elder Lance looked at everyone and sighed.
’I can’t in good conscience send all his high-spirited kids to their death. I just can’t,’ he said inwardly, looking around until suddenly his eyes landed on someone who made him raise his brow.
’What if he can help... what if I take away the slot of one person and give it to him so that he can escort them? I can justify this by saying they survived thanks to him.
Those bastards can’t do anything to me then, and I will be able to preserve the life of my people in the process.’
A plan formed, and so he moved toward Uncle Drake, who stood there, arms folded across his chest, ignoring all the heated stares from the dragons.
"Can I have words with this senior?" Elder Lance said, and Uncle Drake looked at him calmly for a few seconds before nodding.
Uncle Drake waved his hand, and the void cracked, pulling both him and the Elder in. The leaders of the various races raised their brows, seeing such an impeccable display of void mastery.
Kent just smirked because he couldn’t do it either.
⟦I can sense the master is jealous of what he saw, so I have added Void Mastery to your schedule. Once you have completely formed your core, you can begin learning it⟧
’Tch. Who is jealous? I couldn’t care less what else he can do, and I can’t. But thank you for adding it to my itinerary.’ A smile appeared on his face.
⟦You are welcome, Master⟧
Kent was about to turn toward Princess Elowen to have a few conversations when his body was wrapped in void energy and pulled into Uncle Drake’s Void Space.
[Uncle Drake’s Void Space – Two Minutes before Pulling Kent In]

Elder Lance was taken aback when he appeared in a space filled with darkness, yet he could see clearly. He had been using the void to travel, but it was merely for movement. He had never stayed inside it for more than three seconds.
However, he was now standing in one, and that alone raised his expectation of Uncle Drake. ’Not even Supreme Elder Jian can do that.’
The dragon looked at the elder for a few more seconds before speaking, "You look troubled. Is everything alright?"

Elder Lance sighed. "I will go straight to the point. The sect elders want me to kill this year’s batch of disciples while taking them to the sect. I don’t want to do it, but they are using the safety of my people to blackmail me.
I can’t say I will choose the side of these children over my own family, so I was hoping the senior could help me save them and also save my people in the process.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝒆𝔀𝒆𝙗𝓷𝒐𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝓶
Even if they can’t make it to the sect, they also can’t die. I won’t be able to sleep at night knowing I brought their doom.
I already have a plan, and if the senior is willing to help me, everything will go well in the end. I genuinely believe that."
Uncle Drake sighed. "You are a good person for telling me this. But you shouldn’t be talking to me, tell him everything instead. He will help you."
"Who—"
Elder Lance wasn’t done with his question when Kent was pulled into the Void Space.
"Wow, that was disorienting," Kent said when he appeared in the space. He looked around him like anyone would before turning to Uncle Drake and Elder Lance.
"Uhm, why am I here?" Kent asked.
"He needs help, and you can help him." Uncle Drake spoke like he wasn’t concerned about the lives of everyone he had just heard were in danger.
Of course, he was rocking that dragon nonchalance like a flag. Kent turned to Elder Lance, who didn’t know, or more like wasn’t sure, what was happening here.
One minute, he was telling his troubles to Uncle Drake, and now, he was asked to say the same to a mere kid he could swipe away with the back of his hand.
This made him wonder if Uncle Drake was merely playing a prank on him.

"If you want to save your people, then you will talk to him. Because today, whether you come clean or not, every last kid going to the sect will reach the sect, for he alone is enough to ensure their safety.
I can save the kids, but I can’t help your people. He, on the other hand, can do both, so talk to him."
Kent raised his brow and looked at the elder. "Let me guess, somebody wants you to kill us, and to ensure you do it, they are holding your people hostage."

Elder Lance hesitated but nodded. "It’s the Outer Area Senior Elders. They want you all dead, for if you get to the sect, it will be revealed the corruption ring they’ve been running all these years."
"Tell me more."

chapters.title: Chapter 812: Heading to The Sect [End of Volume IV]
paragraphs: "Hmm. This is interesting," Kent said, pacing back and forth after hearing what Elder Lance had to say.
He had just told him the plan the elders came up with to kill Kent and every new potential disciple coming to the sect from Sonox.
He told him about the corruption ring the elders had been running all this time. He even went into great detail, explaining how the recruitment process was supposed to unfold.
As the world housing the sect, they are allowed 200 slots every three years, some of which will be allocated to the Flame Tower.
However, the elders deemed it best to allocate only 100 to Sonox and sell the rest to other worlds that have only 100 slots, and some even 50.
This placed things in perspective for Kent to realize that corruption is everywhere. He had expected this foul behavior to be limited to Earth, where power was determined by money.

But here, instead of these elders using their strength to get what they wanted, they instead chose to use underhanded means, even willing to go as far as killing mere children to cover up their tainted actions.
That was just too much, awful enough that Kent didn’t even know what to do to them when he got his hands on them.
"To think a whole sect with prestige third only to the best on this side of the universe would have such rotten elders," Kent sighed. "This is unbelievable."
"And to think they will hold a race of 3 billion humans hostage just to get what they want. Do they perhaps think they can get away with it?"
Kent was pissed.

The idea of holding 3 billion potential Soul Essence generators hostage infuriated him, and for that, he planned to make the elders pay a huge price, one that would make them wish they had never met the one called Kent Madson.
"First of all, we have to think of a way to save your people." Kent thought for a moment and asked, "How do you get back to your world?"
"There is a teleportation formation in the sect that can take me there."
"That won’t do. Who knows what measures they’ve taken to ensure you can’t get back there on time? We need something that doesn’t have anything to do with the sect."
Elder Lance took out a crystal from his space ring. "This is a one-way teleportation token that can take me to my world. But it is for one use only.
I planned on using it as the last-ditch effort to get back to my world if I couldn’t bear to contribute to killing these kids."
Kent took the token and examined it for a moment. "This will do." Kent turned to Uncle Drake. "It’s between going to save a whole world and facing the Leviathan guy. Your pick."
Uncle Drake was about to speak when Elder Lance cut him off. "He can’t pick my side. Lord Leviathan is among the top ten strongest in the Celestial Conclave Planetary Alliance.
If he is coming after someone dear to you, then you can face him instead. He is dangerous and merciless."
"Oh. It looks like he’s a big shot. You will be having fun then."
Uncle Drake just shrugged. Kent, meanwhile, sent the token to his tower storage and made the tower make copies of it.
"I guess I will send the Bloodvein tribe to protect them. With their strength, not even this Leviathan guy can do anything to your world."
Kent studied Elder Lance’s expression for a few seconds before taking out two tokens from his tower storage.

"If you are still worried, then don’t be. You can contact them and let them know that help will be sent over, and they are to welcome them. They will stay and make sure your people are well protected so you don’t have to worry."
Elder Lance stood there for a few more seconds, not understanding what was going on.
However, for the safety of his people, he took out an expensive-looking communication tablet and activated it using his energy. He spoke into it and then waited for a response.
A few seconds later, a voice came from the other side, "We look forward to welcoming them, Supreme Protector."
Kent smiled. "That takes care of it. However, after everything is said and done, you should consider hiring my Guardianship service. It comes with bonuses you wouldn’t want to miss."
With a smile on his face, he turned to Uncle Drake. "You can send us back now."
Elder Lance was the first to be sent away. When he was gone, Uncle Drake turned to Kent, "I will let you know when that Leviathan guy is taken care of, so you can send me to this different world."
Kent took out a token and handed it to him. "You can go there when you are free. It has only humans, so maybe you will learn how to behave more humanely there."
Uncle Drake smirked and appeared outside with him.

Eyes turned toward them, but Kent just walked away and headed back to his friends while Uncle Drake ignored everyone and stood there, waiting for Elder Lance to handle his business so he could return and sleep.
"Sorry for the delay, everyone," Elder Lance said, looking more relaxed now.
A huge load had been lifted from his shoulders, and now he could get back to being the dedicated elder of the Supreme Immortal Sect.

"Today marks the beginning of a new path for you all. In a few hours, you will be almost a step into the sect. Of course, whether you have what it takes to step in will depend on your prowess during the entrance exams.
However, from what I saw the last time I was here, I have no doubt that you all will pass the entrance exams. Just believe in yourself and you can pull through."
Everyone was thrilled to hear Elder Lance’s words.

Of course, they all knew that not everyone would be entering, but hearing his encouraging words made them feel like they could make it through the gate of the sect and step in, becoming disciples for life.
Elder Lance saw the readiness on their faces and smiled. He took out a miniature ship and made it float in the air. It then expanded and soon became large, like a mansion.
"Everyone with a token should board the ship."𝙛𝒓𝓮𝙚𝔀𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝒐𝒎
Elder Lance wasn’t even done when some were already standing on the deck.
Kent turned to his friends and smiled, "This is it, you all. This is the start of a new Chapter, so we all should make it count."

They nodded and flew onto the large deck of the flying ship. Kent landed with a calm step and swept the entire deck and inner rooms with his senses just to be sure the elders hadn’t done anything to it.
If anything went wrong, he would fly to the sect, find the elders, and beat the shit out of them.

Elder Lance handed the rewards to the races that came first, second, and third in the ranking during the Flame Tower trial. Then, he flew back to the ship, and with a wave of his hand, the void crack closed, and the ship sped through it.
The moment it closed, everyone dispersed, for they knew the young ones were now on their way to claim their destinies.
(A/N: That’s a wrap on Volume IV. It was a wild ride from the Human Continent to the other side of the world. Can the entire Alliance contain the Chaos Dragon... We will find out in the next volume.
Volume V: Kent vs The Sect & The Alliance)

"It’s between going to save a whole world and facing the Leviathan guy.
Your pick."
Uncle Drake was about to speak when Elder Lance cut him off.
"He can’t pick my side.
Lord Leviathan is among the top ten strongest in the Celestial Conclave Planetary Alliance.
If he is coming after someone dear to you, then you can face him instead.
He is dangerous and merciless."
"Oh.
It looks like he’s a big shot.
You will be having fun then."
Uncle Drake just shrugged.
Kent, meanwhile, sent the token to his tower storage and made the tower make copies of it.
"I guess I will send the Bloodvein tribe to protect them.
With their strength, not even this Leviathan guy can do anything to your world."
Kent studied Elder Lance’s expression for a few seconds before taking out two tokens from his tower storage.
"If you are still worried, then don’t be.
You can contact them and let them know that help will be sent over, and they are to welcome them.
They will stay and make sure your people are well protected so you don’t have to worry."
Elder Lance stood there for a few more seconds, not understanding what was going on.
However, for the safety of his people, he took out an expensive-looking communication tablet and activated it using his energy.
He spoke into it and then waited for a response.
A few seconds later, a voice came from the other side, "We look forward to welcoming them, Supreme Protector."
Kent smiled.
"That takes care of it.
However, after everything is said and done, you should consider hiring my Guardianship service.
It comes with bonuses you wouldn’t want to miss."
With a smile on his face, he turned to Uncle Drake.
"You can send us back now."
Elder Lance was the first to be sent away.
When he was gone, Uncle Drake turned to Kent, "I will let you know when that Leviathan guy is taken care of, so you can send me to this different world."
Kent took out a token and handed it to him.
"You can go there when you are free.
It has only humans, so maybe you will learn how to behave more humanely there."
Uncle Drake smirked and appeared outside with him.

Eyes turned toward them, but Kent just walked away and headed back to his friends while Uncle Drake ignored everyone and stood there, waiting for Elder Lance to handle his business so he could return and sleep.
"Sorry for the delay, everyone," Elder Lance said, looking more relaxed now.
A huge load had been lifted from his shoulders, and now he could get back to being the dedicated elder of the Supreme Immortal Sect.
"Today marks the beginning of a new path for you all.
In a few hours, you will be almost a step into the sect.
Of course, whether you have what it takes to step in will depend on your prowess during the entrance exams.
However, from what I saw the last time I was here, I have no doubt that you all will pass the entrance exams.
Just believe in yourself and you can pull through."
Everyone was thrilled to hear Elder Lance’s words.

Of course, they all knew that not everyone would be entering, but hearing his encouraging words made them feel like they could make it through the gate of the sect and step in, becoming disciples for life.
Elder Lance saw the readiness on their faces and smiled.
He took out a miniature ship and made it float in the air.
It then expanded and soon became large, like a mansion.
"Everyone with a token should board the ship."𝙛𝒓𝓮𝙚𝔀𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝒐𝒎
Elder Lance wasn’t even done when some were already standing on the deck.
Kent turned to his friends and smiled, "This is it, you all.
This is the start of a new Chapter, so we all should make it count."
They nodded and flew onto the large deck of the flying ship.
Kent landed with a calm step and swept the entire deck and inner rooms with his senses just to be sure the elders hadn’t done anything to it.
If anything went wrong, he would fly to the sect, find the elders, and beat the shit out of them.
Elder Lance handed the rewards to the races that came first, second, and third in the ranking during the Flame Tower trial.
Then, he flew back to the ship, and with a wave of his hand, the void crack closed, and the ship sped through it.
The moment it closed, everyone dispersed, for they knew the young ones were now on their way to claim their destinies.
(A/N: That’s a wrap on Volume IV.
It was a wild ride from the Human Continent to the other side of the world.
Can the entire Alliance contain the Chaos Dragon...
We will find out in the next volume.
Volume V: Kent vs The Sect & The Alliance)

chapters.title: Chapter 813: Spreading Rumors
paragraphs: [An Hour After Leaving For The Supreme Immortal Sect]
"Are you sure?" Elder Lance asked, his hands shaking as he held the communication tablet firmly in place.

"Yes, Supreme Protector. Twenty powerful beings with red skin arrived just a few minutes ago. Judging by their aura, even though I don’t want to look down on you, I have to say they are far stronger than you."
A sigh escaped Elder Lance’s mouth as he turned and looked at Kent sitting meters away, watching the passing mountains and forests.

"Just who is this kid? He only said he would be gone for a while, but five minutes later, he returned, and now, twenty people, several times more powerful than I, have arrived in my world.𝒻𝑟𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝑛𝘰𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝘤𝘰𝘮
Where did they come from, and who are they?"
"Who are you talking to, Supreme Protector?" the voice on the other end of the communication token asked, prompting Elder Lance to realize he was talking out loud.
"Don’t be concerned about that, Malu. Just alert me whenever something is happening."
"I will, Supreme Protector."
Elder Lance put away the token and sat down on the edge of the flying ship. He needed a moment to adjust and make sense of what had just happened.

One minute, he was worried about his people; the next second, he received a message that they were now being protected by people more powerful than him, and the one responsible was the handsome human sitting, observing nature like an excited child getting a chance to go out and play.
"What kind of monster am I sending to the sect this time?" He finally acknowledged that Kent is a monster, and his initial profile of him was entirely incorrect.
"Since he has come through on his side, then I’d better handle my part well."
He took out a different communication token and activated it. "Klint, you can start now."
Kent smiled where he stood. ’Looks like he has finally come to terms with who I am. Now, I expect 3 billion plus supplying me with soul essence soon.’
[Supreme Immortal Sect – Outer Section]
Life was usual in the sect.
Disciples were going about their day as usual. Of course, today they were much more active, knowing their sisters and brothers would be joining them in a few hours.
Well, those fortunate enough to receive a slot to take part in the sect entrance exams would be arriving, so they were pumped and ready to welcome them.
Although not all were eager to welcome them with open arms, some wanted to use the power they had built in the outer section to take the new arrivals as subordinates and use them to their advantage.
They want to use them to farm Supreme Points, the currency in the sect.
Some wanted to use them to finally handle the requirements needed to enter the inner sect exams and become inner disciples.
In contrast, those who had given up on the dream of ever becoming inner disciples just wanted to suppress the newcomers with the power they’d developed over the years.
In all, all kinds of people were waiting for Kent and his friends to arrive.
However, with whole anticipation starting to build, a subtle rumor began spreading—one that shook everyone.
"Word spreading around is that this year’s batch, coming from Sonox—24 of them—reached the 4th floor of Flame Tower, and every last one of them managed to comprehend multiple Mythic-grade techniques.

However, that isn’t all; apparently, 12 among them reached the 5th floor, and each had comprehended a divine technique. However, there is more: the shocking part is that one of them, a human, comprehended 12 divine-grade techniques.
I mean, this has to be a lie, right?" one disciple said, sitting with a few friends at a restaurant where dozens of disciples were seated, chatting among themselves.
"I think it is a lie."
"Me too."
"How can a trash world like Sonox produce such outstanding disciples? They must be spreading false rumors to make themselves look good."
"I think so, too."
Suddenly, one disciple burst into the restaurant holding a recording crystal.
"Guys, something big is coming."
"Jeez, Steve, you startled me... What do you have to say after making me spread a baseless rumor?" The disciple who told everyone about the rumor stood up, pointing at Steve.
"It wasn’t baseless. See, I have video proof." Steve moved forward and activated the recording he had miraculously copied from someone who had also miraculously copied it from someone else.
The video showed the display board of the Flame Tower.
When everyone saw the video, all doubts were cleared from their minds.
"Holy smokes, so it wasn’t a false rumor. Someone had indeed learned 12 divine-grade flame techniques and even mastered all forms. What a monster."
Everyone was blown away, some still staring at the paused scoreboard with shocked eyes.
"That’s it. I will prostrate myself and swear my fealty to this Kent Madson, forever becoming his subordinate... scratch that, his slave if that is what it will take to get close to him."
"Count me in on that, Frody."
"I think I will be joining you guys. I must get close to this Kent Madson. He has the makings of someone who can become one of the big five."
"I’m going to dress to impress. His name sounds like a handsome person. I’d better wear clothes that will bring out my shape so he can notice me."
"I need to wax."
"Me too."
Soon, words and videos spread everywhere, even reaching the inner area. There, too, when the disciples saw it, they were blown away.
They couldn’t place a finger on it. It was just too much for them to comprehend, especially when Kent’s achievement was put into perspective.
Everyone was soon shocked, and some started making their way to the outer section of the sect to meet Kent Madson when he arrived.
[Supreme Immortal Sect – Inner Section – Grand Hall]
Supreme Elder Espen held a recording crystal in his hand, showing a projection of the scoreboard of the Flame Tower.
Seated on both sides of him were ten elders. They each held the same recording, shock written all over their faces. What they were looking at was just unreal...
"How am I only now seeing this?" Supreme Elder Espen asked.
Elder Calix, a high elf, swallowed nervously.

"Supreme Elder, I asked Supreme Elder Jian two days ago about the standing of the current disciples coming from Sonox this year, and he said they were trash as usual. He said nothing about what we are seeing now."
Elder Calix replied, ready for a deadly response. However, Supreme Elder Espen continued to look at the recording.
"Who went for them?" he asked next, but none of the elders knew, for they didn’t place much emphasis on the disciples from Sonox, as all they had heard and seen showed they were indeed trash.
The two good ones they’ve raised, one is arrogant, and the other is too prideful for her own good.
"Unbelievable."

Supreme Elder Espen stood up, bringing a heaviness, one that Elder Lance would have recognized, for he felt the same from Uncle Drake. Elder Espen is also a Dragon, one of the powerful ones in the sect.
"Elder Calix, Evander, and Lain, make sure the disciples from Sonox get here in one piece. Elder Mikko, summon Supreme Elder Jian here immediately.
He must explain why he never bothered to disclose this important information to me."

chapters.title: Chapter 814: Kent Madson
paragraphs: [Supreme Immortal Sect - Outer Section - Grand Hall: Supreme Elder Jian’s POV]
Just a couple of hours ago, Supreme Elder Jian had figured everything out.
He saw a path forward that, in a few hours, would secure him another run at carrying out his corruption ring that he had been running for the past 17 thousand years.
It was a close call, but he ultimately prevailed.
He and his corrupted elders had finally escaped all forms of scrutiny that would have come from the higher-ups, especially Supreme Elder Espen, one of the righteous and dedicated elders in the sect.
However, that all came crashing down when a sudden rumor, seemingly out of nowhere, started spreading.
It moved through the cracks and, before they could put a stop to it, it had already seeped into the running river, taking it away and spreading it everywhere.
Within an hour, almost everyone had heard and seen the circulating video. The name Kent Madson has reached every ear and every tongue that has said it.
Supreme Elder Jian held the recording in his hand, anger etched on his face. "Who was responsible for this?" he asked, his tone cold like ice.

The elders sitting in the same hall looked at each other, but couldn’t tell who was responsible. They knew they weren’t the ones responsible, and thinking about it, they knew Elder Lance wasn’t accountable either, for he had more to lose.
This then sparked the debate about who was the root cause of this problem.
Of course, it could have been solved had they paid more attention to Sonox. They would have known that Elder Lance wasn’t the only one who went to Sonox the last time.
He went with two disciples, and one of them was the cause of this. But due to their own negligence, they now found themselves in hot soup.

"The only way out now is to push the blame. We must place the blame on Elder Lance. He must take the fall, and knowing we have our foot on the neck of his people, he will read the situation the moment he returns and comply.
"He has so much to lose, so we should use that weakness to make him take the fall," Elder Ester said, her tone cold like the Dark Elf she is.
"Elder Ester is right, we have to make that lowlife take the fall. Though we will be losing a huge business after this, we will at least be able to keep our lives and jobs."
"I support this plan also. Let’s make him take the fall."
With that, the elders agreed to throw Elder Lance under the bus, and, knowing the control they have, they were confident in their plans.
[Supreme Immortal Sect – Core Region. Pill Princess POV]
Inside a neat pill room featuring shelves lined with the finest pill bottles and some herbs sat a beauty worthy of her name.
By all standards, she was a lady that many men would kill to have. She was tall and elegant with emerald green eyes and waist-length silver-blonde hair.
Her long ears extended cutely, seeking all the attention they could have.
She was clad in a flowing green robe etched with ancient alchemical runes, highlighting her alchemy side, as did every other alchemy disciple.
However, while most wore the standard-issue sect robes, hers was specially made, crafted in a design that suited her alone.
She was the Pill Princess, the pride and joy of the Alchemy faction in the sect, and one of the five seeded candidates for the upcoming Interplanetary Sect competition.

In her hand, she held a recording crystal, one showing the display board of the just-ended Flame Tower Trial. She received it five minutes ago, and from the expression on her face, it was clear she wasn’t happy.
It was one thing to reach the 4th floor and another to learn multiple Mythic-grade Flame arts and then climb to the fifth, doing even worse.
Previously, she held the top ranking in the Flame Tower trial. However, not only have some unknown competitors shattered her records, but they have also far surpassed her.
And then there is Kent, who doesn’t make sense to anyone who saw his name.
"Kent Madson."
Her fist clenched as she said that name.
[The Ice Maiden’s POV]
In the Supreme Immortal Sect, if there is a Pill Princess, then there has to be an Ice Maiden. Thankfully, they have both, and this one is true to her name.
She is a pale-skinned beauty with long, icy blue hair that cascades to her hips.
If one doesn’t know better and looks into her frosted silver eyes, their hearts might freeze—not out of love, but out of shock, one that captures their very being.
She is seated inside a cave of ice, one that has frozen the 10 kilometers around it, clad only in her crystalline ice armor, which glows faintly.
In her hand is also a recording crystal showing what the Pill Princess had seen.
A faint smirk appeared on her lips. "She must be pissed by now. Haha, this is good. Kent Madson has done well. I will be sure to reward him when he gets here."
Her laughter, one that continues to spread the ice all over, rang out as she looked at the recording.
As a rival of the Pill Princess—who can also be called the Flame Princess thanks to her mastery of the flame—this display board had given something to tease her with.
It’s a happy day for her, unlike the Pill Princess, who wore a frown and seethed inwardly.
[The One-Eyed Demon Spawn’s POV]

Sitting atop a raised platform, a primal aura—one earned through slaughter and bloodshed—a broad-shouldered and towering young man with black hair streaked red sat, holding a recording crystal in his hand.
A spiked eyepatch covers his right eye, while his left eye burns scarlet.
Horns twist faintly above his forehead, giving him that terrifying look, one that will shake the heart of his opponent before he draws his sword.
He is the One-Eyed Demon Spawn, son of the Blood Berserker King from planet Netherkar. Among the five seeded core disciples, he can be likened to the most destructive and bloodthirsty.
"Kent Madson, huh. I suppose I will meet you soon and see if you are worthy to wield divine-grade techniques."
[The Arrogant Crystal Dragon Prince’s POV]

Perhaps the one more pissed than the Pill Princess is the Crystal Dragon Prince, the gifted first son of the Crystal Dragon race and the sole reason the Crystal Dragons are the leaders of the dragon race.
He is naturally gifted, perhaps even stronger and deadlier than Kent, but his arrogance made him disliked and hated by all.
However, he doesn’t care and always makes sure people know that. But today, he received the most heartbreaking news.
Someone more impressive than him, back when he joined the sect, is on his way, and that pisses him off.
"Kent Madson." His fist clenched, teeth gritting as he looked at the ranking like everyone else.
[The Venom King’s POV]
His dwelling is a cave filled with misty poison. Nobody aside from his right hand can enter, and he cannot stay more than a minute, or he will drop dead.
They called him the Venom King, and as most refer to him, the most dangerous among the five-seeded core disciples.
He is dangerous by all standards, and at the moment, he was observing the name everyone had heard and would forever hold in their hearts.
"Kent Madson." An evil smile appeared on his face as he read the name.

He is naturally gifted, perhaps even stronger and deadlier than Kent, but his arrogance made him disliked and hated by all.
However, he doesn’t care and always makes sure people know that.
But today, he received the most heartbreaking news.
Someone more impressive than him, back when he joined the sect, is on his way, and that pisses him off.
"Kent Madson." His fist clenched, teeth gritting as he looked at the ranking like everyone else.
[The Venom King’s POV]
His dwelling is a cave filled with misty poison.
Nobody aside from his right hand can enter, and he cannot stay more than a minute, or he will drop dead.
They called him the Venom King, and as most refer to him, the most dangerous among the five-seeded core disciples.
He is dangerous by all standards, and at the moment, he was observing the name everyone had heard and would forever hold in their hearts.
"Kent Madson." An evil smile appeared on his face as he read the name.

chapters.title: Chapter 815: The Humming Void
paragraphs: "It is done, Elder Lance. The video has spread everywhere now, and a few minutes ago, I saw Elder Mikko leading Supreme Elder Jian to the inner sect, and judging by the frown on her face, she looks pissed."
Elder Lance smiled. "Nice work, Klint. I will reward you when I get back."
"Safe journey back, Elder Lance."
The connection was severed. Elder Lance sighed inwardly.
"If all this goes well, this nightmare will be over by the time I get back." He sat back down on the edge of the ship, ready for anything.

Of course, if it were before, she would be cautious moving through some of the dangerous regions on Sonox. However, the ship he was on has mechanisms that will trigger and protect everyone should any beast dare attack them.
Kent was also seated not far from him now, talking to Princess Elowen and Princess Freya.
"Are you ladies ready to meet your big sisters and brothers?" Kent asked.
"We are. I mean, I haven’t seen my big brother and sister for a while now, so I will be thrilled to spend some time with them," Princess Elowen said, a smile painting her face.
Now that her mother has been cured, she finally has time for herself, and so the beauty of a princess was now blossoming on her.
Princess Freya wore the same smile.

"My big brother has long ascended," she said. "It turns out that blacksmiths are much more needed and appreciated in the high worlds than in medium worlds. As for my big sister, she is an artisan and a core disciple, so meeting her will be hard if she doesn’t come to me."
"But knowing her, she will probably be waiting for me in the outer section."
"I guess it is good to have siblings," Kent smiled, feeling the emotion in the air.
"Don’t you have siblings?" Princess Elowen asked.
Kent shook his head. "Biologically, no. However, I have a few undead siblings and Regress immortals eating into my accounts every day, so I guess I have a lot of them now."
The two princesses looked at each other and smiled. "Where are they now?"
"Who knows? They are probably somewhere out there biting off more than they can chew." Kent laughed, drawing the attention of some disciples not far from them.
Most wanted to be in his place now. I mean, sitting between two beauties isn’t something any sane young man would reject. They were jealous of him.
Even Elder Lance kept glancing at Kent, not out of envy, but as a fellow human, he was proud to see his bloodline taking the beauties in both arms.

If only he knew Kent was merely using his human side as camouflage to mask his true nature. If he were to unleash his dragon side, things wouldn’t end well for the world he found himself loving every single day.
"Listen up, everyone, we are nearing the Humming Void. All those who don’t have the mental capacity to handle sonic attacks should move to the lower decks and lock themselves in the protected rooms.
They are designed to block the humming."
Many disciples started moving down, not ready to have their minds messed with when they still hadn’t come to terms with how they were going to handle the entrance exams.
Kent looked at the two ladies sitting on both sides of him. "You ladies should go lock yourself up, too. Though you can handle it, which I am sure of, ignoring it will be better for you."
"What about you?" Princess Elowen asked, slightly worried.
"I will be fine."

In the end, only Kent and Elder Lance were left on the deck of the ship as they neared the Humming Void. Even from several miles away, he could hear the humming like soulless music seeking to devour his mind.
"What caused this?" Kent asked, walking toward Elder Lance. He turned and studied him, and sensing he wasn’t showing any discomfort, he answered.
"Long ago, a great battle happened here. From the records, I learned that a powerful music cultivator and a swordsman fought here, and the residue of the battle remains to this day.
It had created a field that haunts the mind for the next 10,000 miles.
The music from the music cultivator has evolved into a haunting sound, one that hums and penetrates the mind, breaking it from within.
It can be heard from everywhere and cannot be resisted. In a way, you let it in but never allow it to suppress the mind to the degree you can reason.

As for the sword aura, it is in the air, thick and slicing. It was what the elders wanted to use to kill you all. Unless your sword aura has reached the peak of the profound stage, staying outside of this preplanned route will be deadly."
"Looks like there are some dangerous places in the world," Kent said, feeling the music assault his mind.
However, as much as this humming tune would love to penetrate his brain and overwhelm his mind, Kent’s resolve was as thick as metal.
"Also, some beasts managed to brave the danger and, using the abundance of energy here, they’ve mutated beyond the limit they were meant to be.
They live in the inner section, so unless you want to die, going there is the last place even the strongest in the sect will do."
Kent laughed. "Well, I am not crazy enough to come back here."
However, as he spoke those words aloud, a message appeared before him prompting him to issue a different mental order.
⟦My scan has detected some Aura stones in the inner section of the Humming Void.⟧
"Good job, tower, place markers here. We will be back soon." As a swordsman, an aura stone is something he cannot have enough of.
It is required if one wants to refine their Sword Aura in the easiest way.
It doesn’t raise one’s understanding of sword aura, but it can refine it to the point that just a mere form of it can create devastation when unleashed.

So, despite its dangers, Kent wants nothing more than to get his hands on them, and if that means going against the humming, the sword aura, or the beasts hidden within, then he will prepare and come for them.
The trip through the Humming Void was slow, meticulous, and heart-gripping. However, they slowly made their way through it, and soon, they were nearing the edge of the void.
However, when they were exiting the Humming Void, three powerful presences descended from the void, stopping 2 km from the ship.
"Inner Sect elders," Elder Lance stood up and readied himself for anything. He never expected elders from the inner sect to appear outside the Humming Void, as if they’d been waiting for them.
This gave him a bad feeling, so instinctively, he became nervous.
"Elder Calix, Evander, and Lain, what brings you here?" Elder Lance asked the moment the ship exited the Humming Void.
"Are you Elder Lance?" Elder Calix asked, looking calmly at Elder Lance.
"Yes."
"Good. Supreme Elder Espen sent us three to escort the disciples from Sonox. So we will take over from here." Without even asking for permission, they moved, and the ship moved with them.
A trip that would have required another five hours to make was now being cut in half. Kent watched all this with intrigue.
’They are strong."

chapters.title: Chapter 816: Arriving at The Sect
paragraphs: [Supreme Immortal Sect - Outside the Main Gate - Exams Area]
The doors of the Supreme Immortal Sect are open to many worlds.
Every three years, they accept disciples from all kinds of worlds, including non-Alliance worlds. Of course, while the Alliance is made up of 64 worlds, some worlds have yet to join the Alliance.

They have all been extended some form of goodwill in hopes of gaining good seeds from them. Some have produced good ones, while others are just too trashy to make any difference. Even so, every three years, disciples from all these worlds come, and today, they are arriving.
Elves, Beastkins, Demons, Dragons, Dwarves, Elementals, and many more alien races began to make their appearance.
Soon, the space was filled with thousands of high-spirited young prodigies, each with dreams of walking through the giant, magnificent gate of the sect that floats in the clouds.
Before the sect was established, it was a city known as the Floating City. Now, it has become a sect that every last genius looking at the magnificent gate wants to stay.

"The first thing I will do when I pass the entrance exams is ride the cloud horses. My sister said it is one of the many early experiences we can have," a spirited young lizardkin said, wagging her tail as she looked at the sect gate.
"Me too. Though I have ridden a cloud horse before, they said the ones here are magical and the view is breathtaking, especially when the sun is setting."
"Look at you all dreaming of what you will do when you haven’t passed the entrance exams, yet," a dark elf youngster said, smirking at the two overly spirited individuals.
"Take your tainted energy away, you dark blood worm." The lizardkin young lady shot an annoyed look at the dark elf. Her tone was surprisingly sharp. Probably for her own good.

Naturally, her remark wasn’t received well, so the dark elf exuded his aura, ready to exchange blows; however, before anything could happen, three carriages tore through the void and arrived almost simultaneously despite coming from different worlds.
This drew everyone’s attention.

Murmurs began spreading, which soon turned into hushed remarks until the first carriage door opened and a young man stepped out clad in red leather armor, his body surrounded by an overwhelming blood aura.
Naturally, the disciples around the area where his carriage landed distanced themselves, feeling the deadly aura coming from him.
Many immediately recognized him.
"That is Kael Vrynn, the youngest prince of Netherkar and the junior brother of the One-Eyed Demon Spawn."
"Damn, he is, as the rumors say, very terrifying just by looking at him."
"Indeed. I heard he even has more potential than his big brother and was even rumored to have awakened an ancient bloodline linked to the Blood Barbarians."
"Holy smokes. I can’t believe I will be joining the sect in the same batch as the Bloodfire Tyrant. This is already enough for me."
"Me too. I will be sure to tell my grandkids about today."

However, as words started echoing all around about the arrival of a once-in-a-thousand-years genius, the second carriage door opened, and a beauty stepped out, bringing her own form of overwhelming aura.
Lyra, the baby sister of the Ice Maiden, also stepped down from her carriage.
Although she is an ethereal beauty with silver skin, one who captured everyone’s attention like her sister, she has no iciness to her.
She looks nothing like her sister, who has a cold, icy air around her, signifying her affinity for Ice.
Instead, she carried the aura of the stars and constellations, one that made everyone feel as if she were looking into their fate, heart, and mind.
That aura made her look surreal in a way that shook everyone’s heart.

"Oh my god, even The Star Oracle has chosen this sect. I heard the Celestial Gate Sect sent the Bleeding Sword Emperor personally to recruit her. Who would have thought she rejected them and came here instead?"
"This can’t be, right? The master strategist has joined the Supreme Immortal Sect. This is huge."
"That’s it. No matter what, even if it costs me my arms, I will join the sect."
"I will follow you on that, brother. No matter what, we all have to join and cheer for this genius that only appears once every ten thousand years."
Then came the third carriage. When it opened, everyone quieted down.
An ethereal beauty, one whose beauty is unmatched, even rivaling the likes of the Pill Princess, stepped out. However, instead of people admiring her, everyone merely stole glances at her.
One would expect such a beauty to be flocked by men on all sides; however, everyone had their backs turned at her.
Of course, everyone values their lives.
Among the five seeded candidates of the sect, the Venom King is regarded as the strongest and most dangerous.
However, while his legacy is unmatched and can’t be surpassed, his baby sister has also carved a path for herself, making her something akin to the most dangerous in the current generation.
The Widow Empress, the master manipulator, the Thread Assassin...

All know her and have been left with an impression, for she is the only one to have blatantly rejected the offer to join the Crimson Cult, the elite unit of terrifyingly powerful cultivators that even high worlds are wary of.
That alone made her someone many hated and feared at the same time, for at just 67 years old, she had already formed her core and refined it seven times.
According to rumors, she had already rebuilt her foundation in one of the most dangerous places in her world, the Devil’s Anus.
She is a monster in human form, and now she has come to join the Supreme Immortal Sect.
"What is she doing here?" someone asked in a hushed tone.
"What does it look like she is doing? Obviously, she is here to take the exams and join the sect like us all. And stop talking to me—she can hear us."
"He’s telling the truth, I can hear you." Suddenly, the Widow Empress appeared behind the two who had just spoken and placed her hand on their shoulders.
Their bodies stiffened, their breath caught in their chests, and their expressions turned pale. At that moment, death was all they could think about.
"So, what do you two think? Do I deserve to join the sect?" she asked with a teasing smile.
One thing about her is that she is extremely friendly, despite people not always being inclined to talk to her.
The two she placed her hands on couldn’t make a move. Suddenly, they felt threads entering their bodies.
At that moment, they knew they would never know peace again. When the Widow Empress latched her threads onto you, that was the end for you.
Luckily for them, just when she could do anything, the void cracked and a large ship appeared through the crack, bringing some form of heaviness upon everyone.

Kent and his pals finally arrived at the sect. He stood at the edge of the ship as it emerged through the cracks. Kent gazed at the majestic sect hiding in the clouds, and a smile appeared on his face.
"I am finally here..." he smiled, then gazed down. That was when his gaze landed on the thousands of people, each looking back at him and his pals.
"And there shall be Chaos."

chapters.title: Chapter 817: You Can Call Me Kent
paragraphs: "Looks like the trash has finally arrived," one disciple said, looking at the flying ship that had just arrived.
It was no secret within the sect that the world in which the sect existed had produced fewer than twenty capable cultivators.
The few they managed to gather, some died, others ascended, but none managed to get recruited into the Crimson Cult.
Other worlds had produced hundreds, and because of that, Sonox was regarded as a trash world by the different worlds out there and even within the Alliance.
So watching them arrive was like the most ridiculous thing to happen in this year’s entrance exams at the Supreme Immortal Sect.
"Seriously, why do they even come? The last time they came, I was told only five out of a hundred passed the exams. They are just wasting slots at this point."
"Just look at them. They appear like they haven’t seen a floating city before."
"Can you blame them? They are in a world that doesn’t even know it is part of an alliance. They haven’t been anywhere aside from their homes, so this is a new experience for them."
Just like that, the ridicule in the air started to spread all over, and by the time Kent and his pals landed on the ground, everyone had something bad to say about them.
Meanwhile, Elder Lance was called to follow the three elders who came to pick them up at the edge of the humming void.
They took him straight to the inner section where Elder Jian was currently held. They both had some questions to answer.
Kent strolled, scanning everyone.
Of course, most were average, while some had some spine in them. But a few caught his interest.
When he saw the Big Three, as people started calling the three younger siblings of three of the five seed candidates for the interplanetary competition, his brow rose slightly.
"They are impressive."
Kent knew danger when he saw one, and he knew the three were dangerous. However, they weren’t on the level of Uncle Drake, whom he wasn’t sure he could defeat.
But these three, he was sure, he could handle them.
When he found a place and stood with the disciples from Sonox, everyone now focused their gaze on them as if trying to intimidate them.
Naturally, that worked. A few turned pale, having this many eyes on them.
However, those who trained under Uncle Drake stood their ground, looking calmly at them.
This caught their attention, making a few take a step back.

They sensed it—something was wrong, and that something could be sensed from 24 individuals. Naturally, these twenty-four were the ones who reached the 4th floor, and 23 out of them trained under Uncle Drake for a few days.
One of the things he put them through was how to function under pressure. So, he used 20 percent of his aura to train them, and that was enough to keep them composed under the gaze of everyone.
"Tch."
Princess Elowen chuckled when she saw some backing away, knowing they might just be seeking their doom if they made the wrong move.
Kent, on the other hand, was locked in a fierce gaze with the Widow Empress, who now held a frown on her face.
Kent smirked. "Let me guess. You are someone who enjoys playing mind games, and one way to do that is by staring into your eyes.
Too bad my mind is bigger than yours; so, if you want to have fun, find someone your own size.
This big daddy won’t be playing with you today. I have bigger fish to fry."
Suddenly, all the staring and scrutinizing at the dsicples from Sonox stopped when Kent spoke. Tracing the direction of his eyes, they saw he was staring at the Widow Empress.
This caused people to widen their eyes in surprise. They knew staring at that young lady was akin to giving her the key to enter your mind.
And once she gets inside your mind, stopping her becomes impossible.
Her power comes in three forms.
The first is her eyes. Those with weaker minds will find their minds taken over by her just by staring into her eyes. She had used it to kill many, and for that, not many dared to stare at her.
The second is her threads. They are a way to one’s soul. The moment her threads latch onto one’s soul through physical contact, that will be the end for them.
People say she uses those threads to control both human and beast puppets, but that is yet to be confirmed.
The last, of course, is her daggers. They are an extension of her hands, and whenever she moves, death follows.
Such a person is not one to be told to look for those of her size to play with. That is just asking for trouble.
However, while trouble was expected, it never came after Kent spoke. Nyss Wu, or as most call her, the Widow Empress, stood there for a few minutes before a smile appeared on her face.
"What is your name?" she asked.
"You can call me Kent."
Nyss moved, and the next second, she was standing beside Kent, her hand clasped in his. Kent felt threads seeping into his soul. However, instead of resisting, he allowed her to do what she wanted.

He knew the three he sensed to be powerful would try to look down on him, which was something he wouldn’t be thrilled about. So if this chance would provide him the means to handle one of them, then who was he to reject it?
Nyss blinked a few times when she sensed that no matter how much she tried, her threads never found anything to latch onto within Kent’s soul.
It felt like she was extending her threads into a deep void where nothing but bottomless darkness awaited.

...shocking.

All three of them reached the core formation stage when they were 40 years old, and even Nyss went ahead and reached the peak faster than both of them.
But hearing someone reach the same stage that made them prodigies within 21 years was unheard of.
This discovery wounded them, and doubt crept into their hearts.
Kent smiled, knowing his work was already done. The target is the Pill Princess, not the small fries. They don’t hold much weight against him.

In the Celestial Conclave Alliance, there are ten individuals outside the Crimson Cult who are recognized as the top ten strongest.

The sect leader of the Celestial Gate Sect holds the top rank. The sect leader of the Primal Beast Sect is second but often swaps positions with the sect master of the Supreme Immortal Sect every thousand years.
It has been four years since the last swap.
However, the fourth position has been held by the Mistress of Mirrors, Lady Enzi, as she preferred to be called.

She is the Supreme Elder of the Core section/region in the sect. She has been in seclusion for the past 200 years. However, a few minutes ago, she sensed something that made her come out of seclusion.
"What was that? Did I just sense a Cold Flame?"

"Seriously, why do they even come?
The last time they came, I was told only five out of a hundred passed the exams.
They are just wasting slots at this point."
"Just look at them.
They appear like they haven’t seen a floating city before."
"Can you blame them?
They are in a world that doesn’t even know it is part of an alliance.

chapters.title: Chapter 818: Confidence
paragraphs: [Planet Xandria - Home World of Elder Lance - Ten Minutes Before Arriving at The Sect]
A few hours ago, when Kent learned of the scheme of the Elders, he briefly entered the tower to ask the Elders of the Bloodvein tribe if they could help him for a few days.
Naturally, they were more than happy to do so.
Even the Tribe Chief joined them, and along with the four of them were 16 other powerful warriors. They wanted to see how far they had grown, so they brought them along.
Thanks to the tower, each received a teleportation token, and that was how they managed to get to planet Xandria.
It’s a vast human world that shares connections with a few other worlds, so there are a few beings from those worlds.
It isn’t too big, but it isn’t small either. However, a powerful cultivator like the tribe chief can travel to the other side of the world in under ten seconds.
So Sonox is much larger.
Tribe Chief Malthar and his elders were warmly received upon their arrival.
They were also handled with care, and aside from the special elders selected by Elder Lance, nobody else knew they were there.

This was why, a few minutes ago, when 45 powerful Dark Elves, demons, and Elves appeared surrounding the place, everyone was shocked to see 20 red-skinned beings, with strengths so overwhelming that when Tribe Chief Malthar unleashed his aura, all 45 attackers were sent crashing down.
It was a one-sided massacre that lasted a minute.
On the other side of the world, too, more people were purged a few minutes later, since at the very moment the main strike force was handled, the rest tried to flee and were swiftly dealt with.
The chaos that was supposed to happen never did. Instead, it was a complete and total purge of all filth planted by the Elders of the sect, which appeared to have been years in the making.
[Supreme Immortal Sect - Inner Section - Grand Hall]

Supreme Elder Esper sat in his chair, looking coldly at Elder Lance, who had just been brought into the Grand Hall by three elders. Aside from them were seven other elders, Supreme Elder Jian, and the five other elders from the outer section.
He was questioned after Elder Mikko brought him, but as planned, he made sure the five elders corroborated his story.
They almost got a free pass. However, Elder Lance is a master Schemer than they are.
During the questioning process, one of the Inner sect elders made a new discovery.

He managed to pick up another rumor that Elder Lance had gone to Sonox with two disciples. He doesn’t know who these disciples were, for there are many, and it will take time to gather them all and question them.

However, the rumor stated that Elder Lance instructed the disciples to release the video. There was no reason why he did that, but this was already enough to tell Supreme Elder Jian they had been played.
So they found a way to send a message to his men in Elder Lance’s world, with plans to capture his wives and children, perhaps kill a few to make him aware of what was wrong.
They knew he could contact his people, and they could contact him, so the plan was for him to hear the voices of his captured family before he even got back to the sect.
The order was given, and the outcome was now to be determined the moment Elder Lance was brought to the hall.

Supreme Elder Esper cleared his throat and spoke, "I am going to give you one chance to tell me why you deem it okay not to report the fact that a disciple from Sonox had managed to master not one, but twelve divine grade techniques.
Pick your words well, Elder, else I will kill you where you stand."
Elder Lance shuddered and, for a moment, broke into a cold sweat—not out of panic but from the sheer fear he felt from the sound that just entered his ears.
He turned slightly and looked into the cold gaze of Supreme Elder Jian’s eyes. Those eyes spoke all the threats in the world, and Elder Lance understood his task.
He looked at Supreme Elder Esper and answered, "But I did report. It was the first thing I did when I returned from Sonox six days ago.
I reported to Supreme Elder Jian, Elder Aster, Elder Aren, Elder Xior, Elder Kenna, and Elder Lewin. I told them everything in detail, but I guess they were too scared to tell you.
And oh, among the hundred disciples I brought today, three are above one hundred years old, but I saw it best to add them, for they are among the twelve that made it to the fifth floor.
And while we are at it, you should also know that the human named Kent Madson actually managed to learn all twelve divine-grade techniques in under an hour.
If you don’t believe me, you can test him and you will find out how talented he is."
"Wait, did you say the hundred disciples you brought? Shouldn’t there be two hundred of them?" Elder Mikko asked.
She is in charge of the Law Enforcement Hall in the Inner Section of the sect, and as someone who maintains discipline, she could smell something fishy.
Elder Lance looked at Supreme Elder Jian, whose fist was clenched, and smirked.
"Supreme Elder Jian should answer that because, as far as I know, only 100 slots have been given to Sonox, so I brought 100.
Actually, while I have the chance to speak, I would like to play an audio."𝓯𝓻𝒆𝙚𝒘𝓮𝙗𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝒍.𝙘𝓸𝙢

Elder Lance took out a recording crystal and played an audio he recorded of his interaction with the elders when he reported the flame tower trial, and another audio of when they told him their plan to kill the disciples.
"They will tell the rest, but I would like to clarify that your scheme was flawed, Elder Jian. You picked the wrong target this time, which is why you failed.
Your men are dead. My people took care of them just ten minutes ago. Every last one of them snuffed out of existence."
They say when the ball is in your court and the enemy is cornered, words flow like a river. At the moment, Elder Lance was holding the ball, and thanks to Kent, Supreme Elder Jian was cornered.
"You deem humans as trash, that we are nothing but weaklings. But I beg to differ, for if you put a human and a thousand dragons in a room, before the human dies, half of the dragons will be dead.
It wasn’t because the dragons are weak; it was because humans are naturally born schemers. We aren’t the brightest, nor the weakest, but we are survivors, and that was your mistake.
Threatening me with the lives of my fellow humans was your mistake. Now, you must bear the consequences."
Mic drop.
If this were Earth, there would be a mic drop, as Elder Lance had delivered one hell of a performance, one that had already sealed the fate of the six elders.
Supreme Elder Esper looked coldly at Supreme Elder Jian, whose back broke into a cold sweat.
"I am disappointed to even look at you. To think—"
Before the Supreme Elder could continue his words, the whole hall turned cold, freezing cold. Then, suddenly, like glass breaking, the bodies of the Supreme Elder and the five elders shattered.
That’s how the six senior elders of the Outer Section of the Supreme Immortal Sect died, and the Mistress of Mirrors made her appearance.
