chapters.title: Chapter 819: Lady Enzi
paragraphs: [Inner Section - Grand Hall]
*Step* *Step*
A crisp step echoed in the grand hall.
Wherever she stepped, the sound produced sounded like a glass breaking.
Even the way her body swayed, the movement of her hand caused the space around her to crack like glass and repair almost instantly.
Elder Lance, who had seen the death of the six elders, stood there frozen, too scared to turn and look at the danger coming from behind him.
Supreme Elder Esper, on the other hand, didn’t have the luxury of not looking at who was coming, for he was already facing the door.
So when the gorgeous lady entered the hall, he saw her, and his heart skipped a beat.
Of course, any man would have his heart skip a few beats when they laid eyes on the beauty that had entered the hall.
However, Supreme Elder Esper didn’t have the luxury of admiring her that way. His heart skipped a beat, not for her beauty, but recognition of her, and that alone terrified him.
Anybody in his shoes who knew the lady who had just entered the hall will feel the same way, for they know what she is capable of.
While the past 200 years had been the best of his life, today he was terrified, and he would remain so for a while before finding his peace again.

The Mistress of Mirrors, the one rumored even to have the power to dethrone the strongest in the Alliance, had just walked into his Grand Hall. As someone who had seen her in action and knew her character, he immediately stood up.
"Supre—Lady Enzi."

He dared not call her Supreme Elder Enzi, for he knew it would be detrimental to him. He moved away from his seat, and as expected, Lady Enzi moved past Elder Lance without even a glance and sat down.
The Mistress of Mirrors was beauty in her own right, with pale ivory skin with an opalescent sheen—the kind that isn’t common even when all of the Ivy Star System is taken into consideration.
She had long, dark hair with silky strands of silvery blue that shimmered faintly, like moonlight on water.
Slender and graceful by all standards.
Of course, her long ears showed her Elven heritage. However, she was no simple elf.
Lady Enzi hailed from a non-Alliance world, one where only the Moonborn Elves lived. It was a small world with fewer than 100,000 elves.
Finding her kind isn’t something that can be achieved easily, but thanks to her, this small non-Alliance world continued to live in peace.
The last time another world tried to lay its hands on her people, half of the intruders’ world shattered like glass.
Now she sat on the throne of a dragon, but Supreme Elder Esper could only bow his head in respect, for he wouldn’t want what happened to Supreme Elder Jian to happen to him.
"Tell me more about this Kent Madson," she said, directing her words at Elder Lance. The humble elder swallowed nervously and answered.
"He is a human, 21 years old. Of course, I couldn’t confirm that age yet, but he had already reached the Level 3 Core Formation stage.

I don’t know much about him, but when I went to supervise the Flame Tower trial, he was with the half-elves. He topped the ranking, climbing to the 5th level and mastering twelve divine-grade techniques in under an hour.
The half-elves seem to value him, and now it seems most of the races in Sonox hold him in high esteem.
Of course, it might just be because they want to learn the divine-grade techniques from him, which is why they are showing him this respect."
"So you don’t know much about him," Lady Enzi asked, and Elder Lance nodded.
"Not much is known about him, even to the half-elves," Elder Lance said, and Lady Enzi sighed.
"Go to the human continent and see if you can learn something about him. You have a month." Elder Lance nodded, bowed, and walked away.

When he was outside, he sighed, wiped the sweat off his forehead, and moved straight to a teleportation formation. He wanted to go to his world first, but as it stood, he might as well look into Lady Enzi’s assignment first.
Nobody wants to be on her bad side after all.
Back inside the grand hall, Lady Enzi turned to Elder Mikko. "Go handle the entrance exams. I will be there to supervise."
The elder bowed and left, doing the same thing Elder Lance did. She didn’t want to admit it, but she kind of admired the woman and would be happy if she could become her sworn sister.
However, she was an Eaglekin; they and the Elves don’t share a great history.
The pointy ears used to use her kind as target practice back in the day, and so deep down in her heart, she hated elves. But she was just scared of this one.
She called five Inner disciples from her Law Enforcement Hall to escort her to handle the entrance exams.
Inside the grand hall, Lady Enzi looked at Supreme Elder Esper and smirked.
"You couldn’t even look after your own elders, and let such rot happen in the sect. Do you perhaps not see the sect as a place that requires disciplined leaders?
Had it not been for that human elder, their actions would have gone unnoticed with mere pats on the back. I can’t say I’m disappointed, for I should have done a purge years ago.
But I am back now, and you should pray there are no skeletons in your closet—all of you." She stood up and walked forward, then stopped.
"Before going to bed next time, thank that elder for saving your ass today. But there won’t be a next time."
With a step, the space before her shattered like glass, and she vanished. It was only after the space repaired itself that everyone sighed.
However, her last words remained in their heads. It was almost like she was unhappy for letting them live, and that alone scared the hell out of them.
"You all should get to work. At the end of the day, I want all corrupt elders locked up inside the hell prison. Of course, if you are corrupt yourself, then you know where to lock yourself.
That was the Mistress of Mirrors, and to those of you who don’t know her, listen well...
She doesn’t care about your family, your mother, or your father.

Her words are final and must be taken in good grace. If you even think of doing anything that doesn’t follow sect rules, be sure to prepare to die like glass shattering, for she is the Mistress of Mirrors and she has eyes everywhere."
The Mistress of Mirrors appeared in the outer section, disguised as an ordinary elder. She walked through the section, examining everything.
A few seconds later, a smile appeared on her face.
"One way to exaggerate it, Esper, but I do have eyes everywhere." She gazed at the sect entrance and sighed...
"Now, this Kent Madson, it’s time for me to see what you are capable of and look for who has this cold flame that even brought me out of seclusion."

sentences.text: [Inner Section - Grand Hall]
*Step* *Step*
A crisp step echoed in the grand hall.
Wherever she stepped, the sound produced sounded like a glass breaking.
Even the way her body swayed, the movement of her hand caused the space around her to crack like glass and repair almost instantly.
Elder Lance, who had seen the death of the six elders, stood there frozen, too scared to turn and look at the danger coming from behind him.
Supreme Elder Esper, on the other hand, didn’t have the luxury of not looking at who was coming, for he was already facing the door.
So when the gorgeous lady entered the hall, he saw her, and his heart skipped a beat.
Of course, any man would have his heart skip a few beats when they laid eyes on the beauty that had entered the hall.
However, Supreme Elder Esper didn’t have the luxury of admiring her that way.
His heart skipped a beat, not for her beauty, but recognition of her, and that alone terrified him.
Anybody in his shoes who knew the lady who had just entered the hall will feel the same way, for they know what she is capable of.
While the past 200 years had been the best of his life, today he was terrified, and he would remain so for a while before finding his peace again.
The Mistress of Mirrors, the one rumored even to have the power to dethrone the strongest in the Alliance, had just walked into his Grand Hall.
As someone who had seen her in action and knew her character, he immediately stood up.
"Supre—Lady Enzi."
He dared not call her Supreme Elder Enzi, for he knew it would be detrimental to him.
He moved away from his seat, and as expected, Lady Enzi moved past Elder Lance without even a glance and sat down.
The Mistress of Mirrors was beauty in her own right, with pale ivory skin with an opalescent sheen—the kind that isn’t common even when all of the Ivy Star System is taken into consideration.
She had long, dark hair with silky strands of silvery blue that shimmered faintly, like moonlight on water.
Slender and graceful by all standards.
Of course, her long ears showed her Elven heritage.
However, she was no simple elf.
Lady Enzi hailed from a non-Alliance world, one where only the Moonborn Elves lived.
It was a small world with fewer than 100,000 elves.
Finding her kind isn’t something that can be achieved easily, but thanks to her, this small non-Alliance world continued to live in peace.
The last time another world tried to lay its hands on her people, half of the intruders’ world shattered like glass.
Now she sat on the throne of a dragon, but Supreme Elder Esper could only bow his head in respect, for he wouldn’t want what happened to Supreme Elder Jian to happen to him.
"Tell me more about this Kent Madson," she said, directing her words at Elder Lance.
The humble elder swallowed nervously and answered.
"He is a human, 21 years old.
Of course, I couldn’t confirm that age yet, but he had already reached the Level 3 Core Formation stage.
I don’t know much about him, but when I went to supervise the Flame Tower trial, he was with the half-elves.
He topped the ranking, climbing to the 5th level and mastering twelve divine-grade techniques in under an hour.
The half-elves seem to value him, and now it seems most of the races in Sonox hold him in high esteem.
Of course, it might just be because they want to learn the divine-grade techniques from him, which is why they are showing him this respect."
"So you don’t know much about him," Lady Enzi asked, and Elder Lance nodded.
"Not much is known about him, even to the half-elves," Elder Lance said, and Lady Enzi sighed.
"Go to the human continent and see if you can learn something about him.
You have a month." Elder Lance nodded, bowed, and walked away.
When he was outside, he sighed, wiped the sweat off his forehead, and moved straight to a teleportation formation.
He wanted to go to his world first, but as it stood, he might as well look into Lady Enzi’s assignment first.
Nobody wants to be on her bad side after all.
Back inside the grand hall, Lady Enzi turned to Elder Mikko.
"Go handle the entrance exams.
I will be there to supervise."
The elder bowed and left, doing the same thing Elder Lance did.
She didn’t want to admit it, but she kind of admired the woman and would be happy if she could become her sworn sister.
However, she was an Eaglekin; they and the Elves don’t share a great history.
The pointy ears used to use her kind as target practice back in the day, and so deep down in her heart, she hated elves.
But she was just scared of this one.
She called five Inner disciples from her Law Enforcement Hall to escort her to handle the entrance exams.
Inside the grand hall, Lady Enzi looked at Supreme Elder Esper and smirked.
"You couldn’t even look after your own elders, and let such rot happen in the sect.
Do you perhaps not see the sect as a place that requires disciplined leaders?
Had it not been for that human elder, their actions would have gone unnoticed with mere pats on the back.
I can’t say I’m disappointed, for I should have done a purge years ago.
But I am back now, and you should pray there are no skeletons in your closet—all of you." She stood up and walked forward, then stopped.
"Before going to bed next time, thank that elder for saving your ass today.
But there won’t be a next time."
With a step, the space before her shattered like glass, and she vanished.
It was only after the space repaired itself that everyone sighed.
However, her last words remained in their heads.
It was almost like she was unhappy for letting them live, and that alone scared the hell out of them.
"You all should get to work.
At the end of the day, I want all corrupt elders locked up inside the hell prison.
Of course, if you are corrupt yourself, then you know where to lock yourself.
That was the Mistress of Mirrors, and to those of you who don’t know her, listen well...
She doesn’t care about your family, your mother, or your father.
Her words are final and must be taken in good grace.
If you even think of doing anything that doesn’t follow sect rules, be sure to prepare to die like glass shattering, for she is the Mistress of Mirrors and she has eyes everywhere."
The Mistress of Mirrors appeared in the outer section, disguised as an ordinary elder.
She walked through the section, examining everything.
A few seconds later, a smile appeared on her face.
"One way to exaggerate it, Esper, but I do have eyes everywhere." She gazed at the sect entrance and sighed...
"Now, this Kent Madson, it’s time for me to see what you are capable of and look for who has this cold flame that even brought me out of seclusion."

chapters.title: Chapter 820: Nature Of The Entrance Exams
paragraphs: After Kent shocked everyone, they all started murmuring among themselves and began to put things into perspective. This brought the space into a state of quiet.
The only one still talking was Nyss Wu, who still couldn’t come to terms with the fact that Kent was more talented than she was, having reached the core formation stage at just 21 years old.

Kent wanted to let her know that he had started cultivating three years ago, so technically, he had reached the core formation stage in three years, but he held himself back, knowing it would be too heartbreaking.
Be that as it may, making new friends was cool, and Nyss Wu sure had some form of aura Kent was vibing to, so he wasn’t about to break her spirit.
"Big brother Kent, please take me as your disciple. You are so cool," Nyss said in a slightly flirtatious tone. Princess Helga and Elowen looked at each other and smirked.
Her attempt to lower Kent’s guard so she could get inside his mind was becoming increasingly ridiculous by the second.
"For the last time, you are older than I am. Though this is unusual to hear, you are probably older than my grandma."
"Pfff."
The Dwarven and Half-Elf princesses couldn’t contain their laughter anymore. And they weren’t the only ones. A few of the disciples from Sonox held the same amused expressions.
However, they all shut down when Nyss glared at them. She had no time for them since her target now was Kent, the one person she had never succeeded in using her two strongest abilities on.
"You are cruel, big brother Kent."
Nyss said, throwing her body at Kent, who dodged, but instead of falling, Nyss was relatively quick on her feet, twirling only for Kent to find her back in his arms.
She was annoying, but not unpleasant to be around.
Kent had no feelings either for or against her. It was merely like handling a snotty-nosed kid on the street. It was annoying, but one couldn’t deny that snotty noses also needed some attention.
*Crack.*
Suddenly, the space cracked, and Elder Mikko and the five inner disciples appeared in the air. Everyone looked up.
’I guess I’d better form my core so I can start learning the void too. With Ingrid helping me, it will be an easy mastery for me.’
"Welcome, everyone. I am Elder Mikko, and I will be overseeing your entrance exams with the help of these inner disciples.
I have only one rule, and that is discipline. All those who have disciples wouldn’t do anything that would put them in trouble. So discipline yourself, and we will have a good first meeting.
Now, to those of you wondering whether the entrance exams will be hard, the answer is yes, so be prepared.
The sect is not a place for the weak, so if you want to grow while here, you must have a winning attitude from the start.
This means you must start by walking through those sect gates and claiming your place in the vast sect, for whether you like it or not, you are here, and going home will be a bummer."
’She doesn’t joke around, does she?’ Kent said inwardly, looking at the Elder. He scanned her and knew she had some strength.
’What do you think, Tower?’
⟦She is superior to you in both strength and speed. So don’t think about winning in speed, even if you use your movement technique.
She is an eagle. She is built for speed. The only advantage you have here is your soul immunity and superior skill. Even so, a slight recklessness and your head is coming off.
She is impressive, and I think you should take her seriously.⟧
’You were supposed to be on my side, Tower.’
⟦I am, master, and that was why I told you all that. If possible, find a way to train your speed with her. I am sure she would be happy to do that if you show some discipline.⟧
Kent wanted to laugh reading the message, but he knew that would be bad for him. However, he would follow the Tower’s suggestion and show some discipline.
"The exams are going to be just one." The moment she said that, the five inner disciples formed a seal, manifesting a formation.
The formation appeared in the air, and after gathering enough energy, a beam shot from its center and landed on the gate.

Suddenly, the sky turned dark, and from within, a stairway appeared from the clouds, leading into the gate. Then, from within, it extended and soon stretched, forming dozens of steps leading down to the ground.
After a few minutes, a 100-step stairway formed, leading straight to the main gate.
"This is the Will of an Angel Stairway. It is a treasure from a high world and one that will be used to see those who have the will to become true disciples."
Everyone turned, looking at each other. They never expected these exams. They expected the three-step exams their sisters told them about.

"I know you all expected first to be tested based on talent and bloodline. You expected to carry stones and run a few miles. You expected to be seated and asked to comprehend a technique or decipher a hidden issue.
All these are good, but in my eyes, they are just a waste.
In the end, it is not how many problems you can solve that will save your skin or how many stones you can carry that will keep you going.
Ultimately, it is the strength of your will to live.
The will and conviction of a warrior are stronger than anything else. With a strong will, even when outnumbered, you will never lose your conviction.

You will never falter when conjuring those spells, activating those skills, and swinging those swords. The will of a warrior is your greatest strength, which is why today I will see how much you all want to enter the sect.
Before you is a 100-step stairway leading to the doors of the sect; all you have to do is climb every last step and walk through the gate.
That is how you get into the sect.
If you want to become one of the many disciples in the sect, then walk through the gate on your own terms.
And let me tell you, the stairway will break you, make you doubt yourself, and even make you think of giving up. But if you are willing to become a disciple, you will never back down.𝘧𝑟𝑒𝑒𝘸𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝓁.𝘤𝘰𝓂

So use your will to climb, and those with the strongest will will make it into the sect at all costs. You have 24 hours to walk through the gate; after this time, those who haven’t yet entered the doors will be escorted back home.
The supreme immortal sect isn’t for the weak."

Kent stared at the stairway, and a sigh escaped his lips. ’I think climbing the Stairway to Heaven in China followed me to this world. He had already climbed two stairways, and now the third was smiling at him.
"If you have a question, now is the time to ask."
Kent raised his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 821: Test Of Will
paragraphs: Elder Mikko looked at Kent and, with a neutral expression, gestured for him to ask his question. Of course, the question contained a series of questions.
"When you said our will determines whether we can become disciples or not, does that include us using treasures like enhancement pills, elixirs, techniques, and the like to climb?
Also, can one help their friends climb? For example, consider carrying them to the top.
Lastly, are there rewards for those who climb faster?"
Kent asked logical questions, and every disciple—though most are too prideful to ask—would most certainly want to know the answer. Elder Mikko looked at Kent more closely this time before answering.
"You can use any means to climb, but I recommend skills and techniques, for pills will burn out three times faster, and the higher you climb, the more quickly the effect wears off.
Treasures like artifacts and weapons will also lose 90% of their functionality the higher you climb. The only things that will aid you here are your techniques and skills.
Then, of course, the most important thing is your will to climb.
In the trial of will, your treasures can fail, you can run out of pills, but you can never run out of skills or techniques, for they are within you.
Of course, it will be slightly challenging to use them the higher you climb, but if you are determined to climb, you will.
For your second question, the answer is no. You can’t help anyone, since the moment you step onto the stairway, you will be in your own space, where the only way to come out is to climb to the top.
And for the last question, there is no other reward for becoming a disciple—that is reward enough. Any more questions?"

Kent shook his head. ’I guess they will handle it on their own. In the end, they have their own wills, and I have mine. We may share some form of destiny, but with weaker wills, even that thread linking us can break.’

"Good," Elder Mikko said and then spoke one last time, "Use this chance to say your goodbyes because, as much as I would love to see you all become disciples of the prestigious Supreme Immortal Sect, most of you will be going home.
So say your goodbyes, because some of you might not meet again in this life."
Her words hung heavy as friends turned to each other and started hugging and wishing each other luck.
’This is heartbreaking,’ Kent said inwardly. The next second, Nyss turned and looked at him with tears almost falling from her eyes.
"I have never been happy before until I met big brother Kent. And even though we only interacted for a few minutes, you made me the happiest lady in those few minutes.

So if this is the last time we meet, I would like to say that this little sister of yours will miss you. But don’t worry, I will train hard here so I can come take you with me on adventures. I won’t make you miss out on much." She tugged on Kent’s arm, not letting go anytime soon.
"Please, Elder Mikko, I have another question. Can we push others off the stairway and disqualify them?"
Elder Mikko, who already had her eyes on the disciples from Sonox, smirked hearing Kent’s question. "No, you cannot do that."
"Too bad. Some people clearly need a little push."

"You are too cruel, big brother Kent," Nyss said out loud, causing everyone to turn and look at the purple-haired human, whose life was turning miserable just because he didn’t have the heart to push Nyss away.
The inner disciples, who had heard Kent’s name for the first time since they came out with Elder Mikko, turned and looked at each other, clearly not believing their eyes.𝒻𝓇𝑒𝘦𝘸𝑒𝒷𝓃ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝒸ℴ𝘮
The Kent that everyone couldn’t wait to see was the one with the weakest cultivation base among the thousands of disciples taking the exams.
That was just unreal, and judging by the look on Elder Mikko’s face, she, too, was taken aback. She expected Kent to have already refined his cores like most had.
However, the brat was merely sitting on the 3rd level, not even done forming his core. They couldn’t wrap their minds around it.
Kent, the one human everyone wants to meet, just doesn’t make sense.
Kent ignored all the stares and turned to his friends. "You’ve all come this far. Now, it’s just 100 steps away to claim a part of your destiny.
See it as your last remaining obstacle to claim what you truly desire, for believe it or not, it is just a stairway, and if you truly believe that, then climbing it will be a piece of cake."
"We will not fail, Kent... We will climb and become disciples," Princess Elowen said, and the rest nodded. Kent just smiled and turned back to face the stairway.
"Aren’t you going to say some inspiring words to me, Big Brother Kent?" Nyss asked, sounding like a spoiled child.
Kent clicked his tongue but eventually spoke, "’Make sure you don’t get too close to the edge of the stairway.’ You will never know why some winds are strong enough to give you a push over the edge."
Nyss laughed.
"Big brother’s sense of humor is the funniest."
Eventually, everyone managed to say their goodbyes and good lucks.
"Since we are all ready, you can start climbing now."
The moment the order was given, everyone started moving. They all wanted to start early, as they had only 24 hours to complete the task.
"We are leaving, Kent. See you in the sect," Princess Elowen said, and Kent nodded. He planned to stay behind and see how many of his friends and the others from Sonox would be able to get in.
Kent looked at the annoying young lady in his arms and sighed, "You should probably start early. I will join later."
At least this time, she knew she had to. But even so, she waited an hour for the other two geniuses to make their move.
Though the three of them were from different planets, they were rivals, and while she would love to annoy Kent some more, she couldn’t let them join the sect faster than she would.
So she left Kent’s side an hour after the exams began.
"What a handful," Kent said, looking at the annoying beauty who waved at him as she was about to step on the first step.
"Very annoying." Kent just stood there watching as disciples of all races and lineages made their way up the stairs.
He looked at the three geniuses who had waited an hour before starting to climb and sighed.
"The only mistake you three made was allowing my pals to have a one-hour head start." Kent knew they had waited one full hour so that they could show everyone their true prowess.
However, if there was one thing his friends knew about climbing, it was that the Flame Tower was their best teacher.

Now, looking at the 60th step, where Princess Elowen, Princess Freya, Madea, and the others had reached, he knew the three geniuses wouldn’t be the ones making the first appearance in the sect this time around.
The big three realized this when, just within three hours, Kent’s pals had already reached the 90th step, but they had only just reached the 70th.
"Arrogance is bliss." Kent took out an apple and bit into it, savoring the taste as he sat and watched the drama unfold.

See it as your last remaining obstacle to claim what you truly desire, for believe it or not, it is just a stairway, and if you truly believe that, then climbing it will be a piece of cake."
"We will not fail, Kent...
We will climb and become disciples," Princess Elowen said, and the rest nodded.
Kent just smiled and turned back to face the stairway.
"Aren’t you going to say some inspiring words to me, Big Brother Kent?" Nyss asked, sounding like a spoiled child.
Kent clicked his tongue but eventually spoke, "’Make sure you don’t get too close to the edge of the stairway.’ You will never know why some winds are strong enough to give you a push over the edge."
Nyss laughed.
"Big brother’s sense of humor is the funniest."
Eventually, everyone managed to say their goodbyes and good lucks.
"Since we are all ready, you can start climbing now."
The moment the order was given, everyone started moving.
They all wanted to start early, as they had only 24 hours to complete the task.
"We are leaving, Kent.
See you in the sect," Princess Elowen said, and Kent nodded.
He planned to stay behind and see how many of his friends and the others from Sonox would be able to get in.
Kent looked at the annoying young lady in his arms and sighed, "You should probably start early.
I will join later."
At least this time, she knew she had to.
But even so, she waited an hour for the other two geniuses to make their move.
Though the three of them were from different planets, they were rivals, and while she would love to annoy Kent some more, she couldn’t let them join the sect faster than she would.
So she left Kent’s side an hour after the exams began.
"What a handful," Kent said, looking at the annoying beauty who waved at him as she was about to step on the first step.
"Very annoying." Kent just stood there watching as disciples of all races and lineages made their way up the stairs.
He looked at the three geniuses who had waited an hour before starting to climb and sighed.
"The only mistake you three made was allowing my pals to have a one-hour head start." Kent knew they had waited one full hour so that they could show everyone their true prowess.
However, if there was one thing his friends knew about climbing, it was that the Flame Tower was their best teacher.

Now, looking at the 60th step, where Princess Elowen, Princess Freya, Madea, and the others had reached, he knew the three geniuses wouldn’t be the ones making the first appearance in the sect this time around.
The big three realized this when, just within three hours, Kent’s pals had already reached the 90th step, but they had only just reached the 70th.
"Arrogance is bliss." Kent took out an apple and bit into it, savoring the taste as he sat and watched the drama unfold.

chapters.title: Chapter 822: After 5 hours Report, Kent’s Dominance
paragraphs: "Looks like from the 90th step upward, things aren’t rainbows and sunshine."
It has already been five hours since the entrance exams began, and at the moment, the ones leading are Princess Elowen and Freya, who are on the 95th step.
However, while they used less than 3 hours to reach the 90th step, it has been 2 hours already since they started traversing the last ten steps.
But judging by the pace they are moving, Kent could tell they are facing something much more difficult than the previous ones, and this only made him wonder what they were going through.
"Though I have to give it to them, unlike most who have already started using enhancement skills, none had activated any yet. But they would have to start now."
As if Kent was reading their minds, Princess Elowen activated her cold flame, wrapping it around her body.
With that, she moved, and in under a minute, she stepped through the sect gate, becoming the first among the new disciples to set foot inside.

Princess Freya didn’t have to use her flame because the moment Princess Elowen activated her soul flame, all those within five steps from her felt the pressure bearing down on their bodies lifted to some degree.
Even in the case of Princess Freya, who was close to the half-elf princess, she felt all pressure lifted, allowing her to enter the sect gate a few steps after Princess Elowen.
Madea was third to get in, activating an enhancement skill on the 98th step after riding on Princess Elowen’s flame from the 93rd step.
Soon, more of the disciples from Sonox entered the sect. Of course, all of them were the ones who had trained under Uncle Drake.
By 7 hours, all 23 of them had entered. By then, the three geniuses had also entered, but not as quickly as they had wanted.
Princess Elowen, Princess Freya, and Madea topped the ranking, making all three of them feel sour.
By 12 hours, out of the 100 disciples that came from Sonox, 30 managed to make it through the sect doors.
Thirty-three made it in by the 20th hour, which was surprising considering hundreds of them came, but had it not been for Kent, fewer than 20 would have made it in.
This shows how weak Sonox is. But Kent knew that 3 years from now, Sonox would surprise everyone.
He had already made sure of that.
By the 23rd hour, 35 disciples from Sonox had entered.
It was then that Kent stood up and stretched. "Time for me to show them how it is done."
⟦What if the master couldn’t make it to the sect within an hour⟧
The tower asked, sarcasm laced in its words.
"Wanna bet on that?"
⟦What are the stakes, master⟧

"If I fail to climb in under ten minutes, I want you to dress me however you want for the next three days, and if I win, I want to have ten minutes unrestricted access to the tower store to pick anything I want for free."
⟦I can do ten seconds⟧
"One minute"
⟦20 seconds⟧
"30 seconds"
⟦Deal. However, I will keep the names and descriptions of the items confidential. This means you will be going in without a clear understanding.
And to make it fun, I will rearrange the position of the items so you can’t cheat by relying on memories. Your appraisal ability also wouldn’t work⟧
"I dont mind."
Kent smiled, and then he moved toward the stairway. Elder Mikko and the five inner disciples were staring at him in shock.
The past 23 hours had them wondering if Kent had given up, for nobody, not even inner sect disciples, can climb the stairway in under an hour on their first trial.
They first had to adapt. Yet Kent merely sat there, and when it was left with an hour before the exams came to an end, he stood up.
"He can’t actually think he can climb in under an hour, right?" One of the inner disciples asked, looking closely at Kent.

"Do you even have to ask. He is from Sonox, and we both know they are a trash world. Though they claim he has learned 12 divine grade techniques, I say that is just bullshit, and he will prove me right here."
Obviously, this disciple has a problem with disciples from Sonox, making him blinded by anger. But then his eyes widened when, in under ten seconds, Kent was already on the 20th step.
"I expected there to be pressure on the stairway, but aside from the cold air, everything is just...normal."
Kent said with a smirk like he was merely climbing an air-conditioned stairway. Within a minute, he was already on the 70th step.
By the 2nd minute, he had reached the 90th step. Then, like a boss, he walked through the gates of the sect as if he had climbed into an elevator that took him into the sect.
Be it Elder Mikko, the five inner disciples, the disciples still on the stairway, or Lady Enzi, who was watching from the outer area of the sect, they all held shocked expressions.

From start to finish, Kent showed no sign of being affected by the three stages of the stairway. He climbed them all as if it were the easiest thing. All three levels of the stairway were nothing to him.
The first level was to test their conviction of the soul.
Many passed this stage because it has something to do with the soul, and as people who have already formed their cores, their connection to their souls is much stronger.
The second is the conviction of the Mind. Many suffered there, but eventually passed.
The last part is where many struggle, for it involves the conviction of the body. That is where the pressure comes in, and also where many have suffered the most, and some continue to suffer.
However, regardless of all three, Kent went through them all as if they weren’t even there.
But then again, they weren’t aware he had already broken a limit on his Mind, soul, and body. That alone took care of all forms of pressure that would have affected him,
In a way, because he broke those limits, he became immune to the stairway.
"Is that even possible. The fastest climb was 45 minutes, and that was after 10 trials."
"To think a mere outer disciple broke the record of the will of an Angel Stairway, and the new one set is just 2 minutes on the first trial. I think nobody will believe this."
"I have it all on video," Another disciple said, holding a recording crystal.
"This is just too crazy."

Lady Enzi stood there frozen, unable to process what she had just seen. In all her life as an elder in the supreme immortal sect, today was the first time that she had seen something that surprised her.
"Just who is this kid, and how was he able to climb all 100 steps like we were ordinary?"
"I need to understand him better before making assumptions about him. But if my eyes aren’t deceiving me, then this kid is someone hiding a great deal, and I must find out what that is.

chapters.title: Chapter 823: Fighting For Her Big Brother
paragraphs: Seven thousand two hundred and three disciples came with big dreams, but only 720 made it through the sect doors.
The rest were escorted back a few hours after the exams ended. Some left with tears rolling down their faces.
The few who came close to entering the sect pleaded severely, but against someone like Elder Mikko, not even the emperor would have been allowed to enter.
In the end, they can only go and come back three years later.

Of course, if new geniuses emerged in the various worlds linked to the sect three years from now, then their chances of coming back to try again would be next to none, since the sect would give priority to the new geniuses over the old ones.
[Outer Section - A few hours ago]

Every last disciple in the outer section of the sect was waiting patiently for the disciples to enter. Those who have their motives set and are ready to implement them have already prepared their speeches.
Those waiting for their sisters and brothers were also actively waiting, each gazing at the giant door with the growing blue portal.
When the first person entered the gate, everyone saw her and most raised their brows.
"She is a half-Elf."
One disciple said, looking at Princess Elowen with a shocked expression.

Those who bet that an Elf would make it through the doors first lost. Those who picked the side of the Dragons also lost. The half-elves who aren’t that prominent in the Outer sect were also shocked to see their kind enter first.
"It’s here, Princess Elowen. She is finally here," one half-elf shouted, almost giving the others a heart attack.

"No way. I thought she rejected entering the sect about 7 times. Does it mean the queen is dead?" Another half-elf who knew more about the reason why the princess didn’t join the sect all this while asked.
Of course, his question made every half-elf frown, and a few started flying toward Princess Elowen. However, before they could get close to her, an invisible barrier blocked them.
"The hell."
"The exam is not yet over, so refrain from approaching the disciples." The voice was sweet, calm, and collected, but it made everyone take a step back.
At that very moment, Princess Freya also entered, adding more frowns to everyone’s faces. Then Madea, another half-elf, appeared, and this time, the most arrogant dragons and Elves started murmuring.
However, broken hearts set in when the 4th, 5th, and 6th were all half-elves
This struck them like lightning.
However, by the time the 23rd person entered, they knew things had changed and would never be the same again. The half-elves have arrived, and their performance was nothing short of amazing.
Eventually, the conversation shifted when many noticed Kent, or the human who was supposed to be among the half-elves, hadn’t appeared yet.
"I knew it. That video was tampered with, making it so we all should hold this trash from Sonox in high respect when in fact, he is just trash."
"I mean, what do you think? Using a human as their shield clearly shows they are trash. The last time I remember, the humans fell off after the war."
"I wasted my time for nothing."
"Me too."
"If this human manages to get here, I will be sure to stomp on his face and beat the crap out of him for making me wager on him and losing precious supreme points."
"Add me to that beating. I want to get my Supreme Points’ worth."
Nyss, who was listening to all these disciples badmouth Kent, bubbled with anger to the point that her pain and anger for failing to enter the sect first was even washed away.
She turned and glared at the disciples and pointed her slender fingers at them.
"Who are you calling trash? Big brother Kent is not trash, unlike you lot who couldn’t even become inner disciples after lazing around for years now.
If you want to call someone trash, then why don’t you take a mirror and look at what trash looks like?"
Her words struck like a needle, making everyone who was badmouthing Kent boil with anger.

"Bitch, who are you calling trash? Do you think stepping through the gates of the sect makes you one of us? If I were you, I would glue that mouth of yours and hope I don’t smack the shit out of you."
"Or you think because you are from Thryxis, you can’t be touched?"

Nyss pointed back and threatened, "I won’t use my race to brag, unlike you useless dragons and elves. If you have the spine, challenge me to a deathmatch now, and let’s see if you can continue living after today."
"Oh yeah. Had it not been for the barrier, I would have already separated your head from your body. Hiding behind an invisible wall to brag, do you think that wall will protect you for long?"

Nyss didn’t say a word; instead, she moved and soon crossed the barrier. "I have stepped out of the barrier. Anyone dare challenge me now? Or do you think I am the Widow Empress, will be afraid to cross a mere barrier?"𝗳𝗿𝐞𝕖𝘄𝗲𝕓𝗻𝚘𝚟𝕖𝐥.𝚌𝕠𝕞
A cold air washed over everyone when Nyss spoke after crossing the barrier. It was as if the angel of death had descended upon her and spoken through her.
Everyone looked at each other, and a few who had spoken took major steps back.
They had heard of her. They knew her legend.
So they knew she was not one they could mess with.
Nyss narrowed her gaze at them and, for a moment, nearly lunged at the one closest to her. Thankfully, Kent appeared at that moment, making her calm down a bit.
"All you do is talk trash, but when a real threat appears, you cower like a bunch of rats." She pointed her dagger at the disciple closest to her.
"I don’t know the rules of this sect yet, but know that the moment I do, I will challenge you first and use your blood to purify my body for engaging with the likes of you."
She moved back into the barrier, causing many to sigh in relief.
A second later, her frown disappeared, replaced by a beaming smile as she moved toward Kent.
"Big brother Kent, I missed you so much. Why did you make me worried?" She wrapped her arm around Kent’s, appearing like she had known him for years already.
Kent shook his head, knowing this was what he would have to deal with for the next couple of years that he would be staying in the sect, so he might as well get used to her now.
"I am here now, and that is all that matters."
Nyss nodded and rested her head on Kent’s shoulder. ’Just where did this troublemaker come from?’ Kent smiled, then he focused on all the eyes staring at him.
He studied them for a few moments, then his smile widened.
"This goes to all Outer and Inner disciples. I don’t know what you all expect to gain from hating me, nor do I care about any of you.
However, I have recently come to realize that preserving life is something we should all strive to practice.
It has many benefits.
So, all those thinking of challenging me to a death match, don’t. I don’t want a death match, for I don’t plan on shedding blood.
But to those who won’t listen to reason and still challenge me, if I don’t kill you in under five seconds, I will pack my things and leave the sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 824: Lady Enzi’s Sneakiness
paragraphs: If there is one thing more dangerous than a terrorist, it is a person who gives threats while smiling. That is the next level of psychological manipulation, the kind that Kent used to send his message.

The smile, the words, and the way they were delivered were just too chilling for most not to hear him. Initially, Kent wanted to patronise everyone, but when he saw Elder Mikko and scanned her, he knew he was still lacking.
He saw that when it came to speed, he was lacking, and so he changed his mind. He needed to focus on improving himself.

The sect is a place filled with the best and the brightest, so in one way or another, he is going to find someone with something unique he can’t measure up to, and if he wants to reach perfection and surpass his past selves, then he must ensure he was the best version of them all.
Vexthra, being a goddess and knowing what it takes to reach that stage, advised him to improve the smallest aspect of himself.

The small mistakes he might choose to ignore, the unique way something he is doing can be done, and the idea that he was better than everyone else... all these must be fixed, for it is the only way he can attain perfection.
He must embrace the idea that in the journey to the top, he isn’t the only one walking it, and relying solely on himself isn’t the way to walk it.
To reach perfection, he must take the small chances he can get and build upon them. That and only that is the way to the top.
Of course, not all qualify to make him tick.
So while he had found himself in the right place, he wasn’t about to let just anyone waste his time. He has better things to do, so the warning was warranted, and as expected, everyone became quiet.
"What an arrogant guy," one of the inner disciples who came with Elder Mikko said.
"I kind of like his style. Just look at him, there was nothing like fear in those eyes. If anything, he meant everything he said, and that kinda makes him look cool."
"But challenging the whole outer and Inner sects, does he look down on us like that?"
"If you don’t like it, you can challenge him. Of course, it doesn’t have to be a deathmatch."

Elder Mikko hovered in the air, looking at the disciples bicker among each other for a few minutes. She was waiting to see if anyone would say something against what Kent had said, but even after five minutes, nobody had the spine to do so.
She turned and looked at Kent, ’I must recruit him into the Law Enforcement Hall. Someone with this much effect will bring order to the sect easily.’
She was about to proceed with her duties when, suddenly, a voice spoke, accompanied by the sound of glass shattering.
"One would say those words are very arrogant, don’t you think, disciple Kent?" Reality shattered like glass, and she walked out, looking calmly at Kent.
⟦She is a red flag master. Whatever you do, don’t make her angry, for you will shatter like glass before you know what happened⟧
’No need to exaggerate it, Tower. I know danger when I see one.’
⟦I wasn’t exaggerating, master. This lady is dangerous, and while I would love to be on your side and tell you there is a chance for you, there is none.
Of course, you can kill her with the asteroid, but would that be something you would want to waste your precious asteroid on⟧
’I get it, Tower. I will treat her carefully and not scare her.’
Kent smiled in his head as he looked at the beauty that had appeared in the air.
"I don’t see it as arrogance. If anything, it is merely a suggestion, one that shouldn’t be too hard to follow."
"Oh, that is thoughtful of you, disciple Kent." The lady smiled, gently landed on the ground, and walked closer to where Kent stood.
"Why don’t I also make a suggestion. I am willing to give 1,000,000 supreme points to any disciple who can last more than five seconds against Disciple Kent ."
"WHAT"
Every eye widened, and jaws swung open. Nobody, regardless of who they were, was able to hold their composure hearing what Lady Enzi said.
Of course, Kent didn’t know what Supreme Points were, but judging by the looks on everyone’s faces, he knew it was something they all would kill for.
Lady Enzi smiled, brightening the sky and shaking hearts.

"Of course, while I would love to allow everyone to challenge him, unfortunately, I don’t have that much time, so we will be using the Great Titan body to select the first 100 disciples with the highest points to challenge him.
I will personally oversee the selection since, at the moment, I am the acting Supreme Elder."
Once again, many were taken aback, but Lady Enzi wasn’t done with her words.
"To the new disciples just joining, know that the supreme point is the way you can survive in this place. You need to buy cultivation resources and even food.
So, being offered a million points isn’t something you should ignore. That said, not more than 20 of you can handle the selection trial, so you are free not to participate.
But those who will qualify will automatically become Inner disciples." Then the third shock hit them, and they all felt their spirits lifted high already to handle everything thrown at them.
They all want to be part of the 100 disciples to challenge Kent, not to win, but to become Inner disciples.
"Of course, while you all will be getting something, the one being challenged must also earn something." Lady Enzi smiled slyly at Kent.
"Disciple Kent, if you manage to defeat the first 20 disciples, you will qualify to become an Inner disciple. If you defeat 50, you will be eligible to use the Spiritual Core Pool for seven days.
If you defeat 70, you will not only become an Inner disciple and enter the Spiritual Core Pool, but you will also have two opportunities to ask me for help with your cultivation.

And finally, if you manage to defeat all 100, first, like I said, you will become an Inner disciple, have 7 days access to the Spiritual Core Pool, get two chances to ask for my help, and now, you will automatically qualify to participate in the upcoming selection trial for the 20 disciples that will represent the sect in the Interplanetary Sect competition.
Aside from that, I will personally give you 500,000 Supreme Points and a chance to choose which Cultivation peak you want to join when you become an Inner disciple."
⟦What a sneaky woman. She managed to use your own words against you.⟧
’She is indeed sneaky. But she might have just given me the chance to accomplish my dreams faster than I expected.’
⟦That is indeed true. According to the sect’s rules, Inner disciples who have achieved some success can seek private lessons from the elders.
Becoming an Inner disciple will bring you closer to both improving your cultivation and gaining the opportunity to challenge the Pill Princess.
This is a golden opportunity, presented subtly.⟧
Kent smiled.
However, the next second, the space cracked in two different places and two people with terrifying auras appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 825: The Golden Opportunity [Bonus]
paragraphs: ’A swordsman and an Alchemist’
Kent said, staring at the two figures that appeared.
The male is a bald fellow with a sword strapped on his back, clad in a flowing robe, the kind monks wear.
He is the only Sword Emperor in the sect, known widely as Old Sword. His understanding of the sword is one that no one can measure.
In fact, in the planetary alliance, he is among the top three Sword Emperors and a member of the Crimson Cult, so even if he is stronger than the strongest in the planetary alliance, nobody can tell.

The female, however, is the only Pill Emperor in the world and the master of the Pill Princess, Pill Emperor Liora, a flame elemental, and the most mysterious woman in the sect and the entire alliance.
She had never challenged anyone to a fighting duel despite rumours suggesting she could rival even the sect master.
To all, she is one of the best alchemists in the entire planetary alliance and even the Ivy Star system.
The two powerhouses appeared, and every disciple present felt the pressure.
"Old Sword, Lady Liora, what brings you here?" Lady Enzi asked, her tone calm.

"Shouldn’t we be the ones asking that? We’ve waited 200 years for you to come out of seclusion so we can drink a new wine I brewed, but who would have thought you would not only kill six elders, including a supreme elder, but now stir the pot among the disciples.
Were you that bored that you sought entertainment from these kids?" Lady Liora asked, a charming smile gracing her lips.
Lady Enzi shrugged, hearing her words. The air around her is glassy, while the air around Lady Liora is calmer and warmer. As for Old Sword, the air around him is sharp.
"I do need some entertainment, and there is nothing wrong with seeking it here. Of course, if you want me to apologize for killing those bastards, then know I won’t.

I killed them for tarnishing the image of the sect and putting the lives of billions in harm’s way. Now, if you are here to watch, then stay on the sidelines and watch; you might find it more enjoyable than you think."
Lady Enzi turned to Kent, "So what do you think, Kent? Can you defeat all 100 of them, each under 5 seconds, and gain all these benefits?"
Kent smiled and looked around him, making sure everyone got a good look at him.
"I am a humble kid, just 21 years old, so bragging isn’t in my blood. However, moments like this, if I don’t brag and farm for some aura, it will just be a waste, so ye all should hear me.
Getting a chance to challenge me is as far as you can go. Thinking about actually winning is not something that can happen; it’s something that can only be achieved when you catch me in my sleep.
So, try your best if you are an outer disciple and become one of the 100 disciples, so that you can become an inner disciple.
Of course, who am I if not generous? In the 100 battles that will be fought, I will stand in one place and will not move.

So, to those who can make me take a step back, even if I defeat you, I happen to know a thing or two about alchemy. So, you will have a chance to request any pill you want, and I will concoct it for you.
It will be Tier 8, 100% pure and out of my account."
Stunned silence.

Everyone could only stare at Kent like he was the most unique thing they’d ever seen. His confidence and the way he spoke, even though it oozed with arrogance, no one could deny that he truly deserved to be arrogant.
Nobody in their right mind can boldly stand and challenge an entire sect made of two sections, and even add stakes so high that many would kill for.
"Hahahahaha." Suddenly, Old Sword burst into laughter, then he vanished, appearing before Kent. Nyss, who was beside Kent, hid behind him now, using Kent as her shield.
Old Sword slammed his hand on Kent’s shoulder, and the brat felt an energy move through his body, but instead of resisting, he let it flow through his body.
"Hahahahaha," Old Sword laughed again, "Kid, what is your name again?"
"Kent."
"A good name. Well, Kent, I can tell you are also a swordsman, and judging by your aura, you are not a weak one.
I am impressed, and for that, I will sweeten the pot. If you manage to defeat all 100 disciples, I will allow you to view the True Blade Tablet for 30 days."
Both Lady Enzi and Liora raised their brows, hearing Old Sword’s words.
"I don’t know what the True Blade Tablet is, but I would surely love to have a chance to view it." Kent smiled, and Old Sword laughed and vanished back to where he was.
Liora used spiritual energy to ask him a question when he appeared beside her, "Do you really have to go that far? Offering him a chance to view the tablet while not even a core disciple yet?"
"That is the thing, this kid qualifies to become a core disciple. I tested his sword aura, and while he is only a sword grandmaster, he had already unlocked Profound Sword Aura."
"What?" Lady Liora snapped her eyes back to Kent, who was looking back at her. Their gaze met, and for a moment, a golden glow flashed across Kent’s eye.
She noticed, but it would be later on that she would recognize what she saw.
"Grandmaster swordsman and had already unlocked Profound Sword Aura. Doesn’t that make him comparable to those monsters that mostly come from the High Worlds?"
Old Sword nodded.
"I think this time, we have found a gem. And oh, he said he is an alchemist, so maybe you should keep an eye on him; he might have the means to teach your arrogant disciple some manners."
Lady Liora didn’t say anything, but she would now keep a close eye on Kent, for she could tell there was more to him than met the eye.
"Everyone should settle in. Elder Mikko will handle that. But know that in two weeks, there will be a major duel that will happen here in the Outer Section.
That means, for the next 13 days, you each have one chance to land your strongest attack on the Great Titan’s body, and those who fall within the top 100 will participate in the upcoming competition.
Now, those of you thinking of using pills to cheat, know that I will personally oversee the selection and competition, so be sure not to test me.
I don’t mind shattering your body into countless glassy pieces. That said, welcome once again to the Supreme Immortal Sect."
She vanished like shattered glass.𝒻𝘳ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝒷𝘯ℴ𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝑐ℴ𝑚
Elder Mikko took over and began explaining the minor rules of the sect to everyone. To her, ’discipline’ is the most important rule, for those with discipline will not break the other minor rules.
When she was done, everyone earned their badge, which allowed them to get their sect robes, rooms, and their first cultivation resources.
Due to the duel, everyone was given the next two days off to prepare.

chapters.title: Chapter 826: The Selection [Bonus]
paragraphs: When word spread of the duel, every disciple, regardless of what they were doing, abandoned everything and rushed to the outer section where the selection would be happening.
It took just an hour, but the queue extended several miles. Every last disciple in the inner and outer sections of the sect wants to participate.
Of course, knowing one doesn’t have to defeat Kent but merely has to hold on till five seconds run out was the reason all of them wanted to join the competition.
Of course, even if there was no such stake to the duel, they would still want to participate, for they wouldn’t let a chance to earn a million Supreme Points go to waste.
So they came and they joined the line.
It’s already been three days since Kent and his pals arrived in the sect, and so far, they’ve managed to learn quite a lot about the sect.
They explored at least the outer section, and from what they saw, they were impressed. It is the most comfortable place to cultivate.
There are formations everywhere, each designed to make cultivation not only faster but also more comfortable.
The most basic thing there are the training grounds. Aside from the normal training grounds, there are also ones for Lightning elements, Fire elements, Water, and many more.

There are also places where significant events happen. The sect doesn’t have something like going to a classroom to listen to lectures. They have none of that; instead, they have several places where one can go to learn.
Kent and his pals saw at least 20 of said places. One can go to see an elder concocting pills or an elder practicing the sword.
Kent noticed that many people frequented these places, and after spending a few hours there, he understood why.
There are formations present that enhance whatever was happening, allowing the disciples to gain a much deeper understanding of it.
Many who seek to gain enlightenment come there to watch, and he knew he would frequent those places too when he was done handling his business.
Aside from that, they explored the Supreme Market, where disciples who have items to sell or wish to buy go to conduct their transactions.
Aside from that, there are also the official stores of the sect where even more treasures are sold.
Of course, spirit stones don’t work there, and while Kent would love to use the tower to top up his own account, he refrains from doing that, for he wants to work for his keep.
In all, they are impressed with what they saw. However, they knew there was more to be had in the inner sect if the outer sect was already this impressive.

This means they all want to try their best and become one of the 100 disciples who will face Kent. In fact, most had already joined. The only ones left to join the queue were the 11 that made it to the 5th level of the Flame Tower.
Over the past three days, Kent helped them to the best of his ability, or more accurately, within their capabilities. He has more treasures, but they can’t handle it yet.

"You all have come a long way, so I have no doubt you will be making it into that 100 selected disciples. Of course, defeating me is not something you can do, so try to become one of the selected disciples so you can make it into the Inner sect.
All three geniuses have already entered the top ten spot, but you 11 are already impressive, so don’t give them a chance to outshine you."
They nodded and left to join the queue.
When they arrived, the queue was still long, and judging by their position, it would take them a few days to get a chance, but that was alright because they knew their turn would come eventually.
Nine days later, their turn came.
Arion was the first to go.
The Giant Titan’s body is a colossal metal structure imbued with Tier 14 formations, designed to measure the strength, mastery, and lethality of an attack.
After capturing these three things, it will reveal the score based on numbers. Currently, on the ranking board, the first person is a swords saint from the inner sect.
His score is 98, demonstrating the strength, brilliance, and deadly accuracy of his attack.
Arion is also a swordsman, so he retrieved his sword, and when he was 5 meters from the giant titan’s body, his flame surged, engulfing his sword.
"Wow, that is one fierce soul flame," a disciple said, watching Arion closely.
Of course, Arion didn’t stop there. The flame moved across his arm and then enveloped his entire body.
Eyes widened and jaws dropped, but Arion wasn’t done.
He raised his sword and pointed it up, then activated his skill.
"Flame Lord’s Hand." He added his other hand and held the sword firmly, and then, with a powerful swing, Arion unleashed a flame hand, one that filled the space with scorching hot flame.
BANG
It slammed into the metal statue, creating a powerful shockwave. Arion was pushed back, but Princess Elowen was there to support him.
When everything calmed down, they turned and looked at the ranking board.
Arion smiled, walking back under the shocked gaze of many who saw his attack and felt the shockwave.
"That is no simple skill."
Murmurs began to spread.

However, they quieted down when Princess Elowen moved, her bow drawn. When she was 10 meters away from the statue, she stopped, and then, at once, the space around her froze, raising spikes made of ice.
However, those who felt the coldness sensed some burning sensation in it, making them wonder what was happening.
"That is no ordinary ice." Of course, they all thought it was ice; however, when the skill was unleashed, they saw its true nature.
"Flame Phoenix Ascendence."
The arrow turned into a brilliant white flame, Phoenix, cold yet hot. When it exploded on the statue, the surface froze for a few moments.
On the ranking, she appeared at number 5, indicating that her attack had some power behind it.
Princess Freya was next to go, appearing at number 7.
Then the rest went one after the other, and by the time Norion’s turn came, everyone was left wondering just what was wrong with this year’s batch of disciples from Sonox.
All 11 of them took the top 30 spots in the ranking, showcasing their prowess. Of course, one need not be told that they had already made it on the list of 100 disciples to be selected.
By the time the selection came to an end, their positions shifted, but they remained in the top 40.
Aside from them, a few others from Sonox made it onto the list, with all seven survivalists Kent helped making the list.
Even Kent was taken aback when they came to him smiling and cheering.
"You guys really impressed me. I know you 11 can make it thanks to your superior skills, but you seven truly made me proud.
I will reward you all after kicking your butts tomorrow."
They laughed, knowing winning was impossible. Uncle Drake had already told them to look up to Kent, for he is someone terrifyingly strong.
So had it not been for the chance to become inner disciples, none of them would have dared challenge him.
Tomorrow, they knew it would be a one-sided beatdown, but still, they looked forward to it.

sentences.text: When word spread of the duel, every disciple, regardless of what they were doing, abandoned everything and rushed to the outer section where the selection would be happening.
It took just an hour, but the queue extended several miles.
Every last disciple in the inner and outer sections of the sect wants to participate.
Of course, knowing one doesn’t have to defeat Kent but merely has to hold on till five seconds run out was the reason all of them wanted to join the competition.
Of course, even if there was no such stake to the duel, they would still want to participate, for they wouldn’t let a chance to earn a million Supreme Points go to waste.
So they came and they joined the line.
It’s already been three days since Kent and his pals arrived in the sect, and so far, they’ve managed to learn quite a lot about the sect.
They explored at least the outer section, and from what they saw, they were impressed.
It is the most comfortable place to cultivate.
There are formations everywhere, each designed to make cultivation not only faster but also more comfortable.
The most basic thing there are the training grounds.
Aside from the normal training grounds, there are also ones for Lightning elements, Fire elements, Water, and many more.
There are also places where significant events happen.
The sect doesn’t have something like going to a classroom to listen to lectures.
They have none of that; instead, they have several places where one can go to learn.
Kent and his pals saw at least 20 of said places.
One can go to see an elder concocting pills or an elder practicing the sword.
Kent noticed that many people frequented these places, and after spending a few hours there, he understood why.
There are formations present that enhance whatever was happening, allowing the disciples to gain a much deeper understanding of it.
Many who seek to gain enlightenment come there to watch, and he knew he would frequent those places too when he was done handling his business.
Aside from that, they explored the Supreme Market, where disciples who have items to sell or wish to buy go to conduct their transactions.
Aside from that, there are also the official stores of the sect where even more treasures are sold.
Of course, spirit stones don’t work there, and while Kent would love to use the tower to top up his own account, he refrains from doing that, for he wants to work for his keep.
In all, they are impressed with what they saw.
However, they knew there was more to be had in the inner sect if the outer sect was already this impressive.
This means they all want to try their best and become one of the 100 disciples who will face Kent.
In fact, most had already joined.
The only ones left to join the queue were the 11 that made it to the 5th level of the Flame Tower.
Over the past three days, Kent helped them to the best of his ability, or more accurately, within their capabilities.
He has more treasures, but they can’t handle it yet.
"You all have come a long way, so I have no doubt you will be making it into that 100 selected disciples.
Of course, defeating me is not something you can do, so try to become one of the selected disciples so you can make it into the Inner sect.
All three geniuses have already entered the top ten spot, but you 11 are already impressive, so don’t give them a chance to outshine you."
They nodded and left to join the queue.
When they arrived, the queue was still long, and judging by their position, it would take them a few days to get a chance, but that was alright because they knew their turn would come eventually.
Nine days later, their turn came.
Arion was the first to go.
The Giant Titan’s body is a colossal metal structure imbued with Tier 14 formations, designed to measure the strength, mastery, and lethality of an attack.
After capturing these three things, it will reveal the score based on numbers.
Currently, on the ranking board, the first person is a swords saint from the inner sect.
His score is 98, demonstrating the strength, brilliance, and deadly accuracy of his attack.
Arion is also a swordsman, so he retrieved his sword, and when he was 5 meters from the giant titan’s body, his flame surged, engulfing his sword.
"Wow, that is one fierce soul flame," a disciple said, watching Arion closely.
Of course, Arion didn’t stop there.
The flame moved across his arm and then enveloped his entire body.
Eyes widened and jaws dropped, but Arion wasn’t done.
He raised his sword and pointed it up, then activated his skill.
"Flame Lord’s Hand." He added his other hand and held the sword firmly, and then, with a powerful swing, Arion unleashed a flame hand, one that filled the space with scorching hot flame.
BANG
It slammed into the metal statue, creating a powerful shockwave.
Arion was pushed back, but Princess Elowen was there to support him.
When everything calmed down, they turned and looked at the ranking board.
Arion smiled, walking back under the shocked gaze of many who saw his attack and felt the shockwave.
"That is no simple skill."
Murmurs began to spread.
However, they quieted down when Princess Elowen moved, her bow drawn.
When she was 10 meters away from the statue, she stopped, and then, at once, the space around her froze, raising spikes made of ice.
However, those who felt the coldness sensed some burning sensation in it, making them wonder what was happening.
"That is no ordinary ice." Of course, they all thought it was ice; however, when the skill was unleashed, they saw its true nature.
"Flame Phoenix Ascendence."
The arrow turned into a brilliant white flame, Phoenix, cold yet hot.
When it exploded on the statue, the surface froze for a few moments.
On the ranking, she appeared at number 5, indicating that her attack had some power behind it.
Princess Freya was next to go, appearing at number 7.
Then the rest went one after the other, and by the time Norion’s turn came, everyone was left wondering just what was wrong with this year’s batch of disciples from Sonox.
All 11 of them took the top 30 spots in the ranking, showcasing their prowess.
Of course, one need not be told that they had already made it on the list of 100 disciples to be selected.
By the time the selection came to an end, their positions shifted, but they remained in the top 40.
Aside from them, a few others from Sonox made it onto the list, with all seven survivalists Kent helped making the list.
Even Kent was taken aback when they came to him smiling and cheering.
"You guys really impressed me.
I know you 11 can make it thanks to your superior skills, but you seven truly made me proud.
I will reward you all after kicking your butts tomorrow."
They laughed, knowing winning was impossible.
Uncle Drake had already told them to look up to Kent, for he is someone terrifyingly strong.
So had it not been for the chance to become inner disciples, none of them would have dared challenge him.
Tomorrow, they knew it would be a one-sided beatdown, but still, they looked forward to it.

chapters.title: Chapter 827: Mind Manipulation
paragraphs: Kent stood in front of his cultivation cave, a smile on his face.

All the houses in the sect are caves designed and empowered using formations. This allows one to cultivate much faster, since the abundance of spiritual energy in the cave is a result of the formation built within it.
Of course, the formation isn’t always active, as it requires Spirit Crystals to power it. However, Kent, like any new disciple, was given only one Spirit Crystal, which lasted him for just a day.
He went to buy some, but he found out that one Spirit Crystal is equivalent to 100 Supreme Points, and at that moment, he had only 100 Supreme Points given to him by the sect.

However, Kent didn’t hesitate to buy the crystal, for while many wouldn’t benefit much from the abundance of spiritual qi in the cave due to their weak cultivation techniques, Kent’s cultivation technique was unique.
With just one spirit crystal, he made significant progress.

Of course, thanks to his time with Princess Lovina, he was able to rise to Level 4 Core Formation, but he knew it would require him at least ten spirit crystals, that is, a thousand supreme points, to make progress next time.
The reason he was smiling, however, was due to two things.
The first being the feeling of actually living the disciple life now. He planned to live such a life in the Divine Palace sect, but that didn’t happen.
Of course, he knew it was because of his wives around.
He couldn’t keep his hands away from them, so his time there was wasted in a way. Now, however, he was alone, and that made him finally get into the life of a disciple, and so far, he was loving it.
The second reason, of course, was the upgrades done to his skills. He used the skill upgrade points to upgrade some of them.
He had held the skill upgrade points for long, and so finally, he found a good use for them.
One of the skills he received after adding Princess Lovina to the harem was [Mind Prison].
Initially, it was a Mythic-grade skill that allowed him to imprison someone’s mind and look through their memories.
Kent didn’t need that since Soul Absorb allows him to do that. The only difference was that with Mind Prison, he can read their thoughts while they are still alive.
It was a good one, but Kent wasn’t satisfied with just that aspect of it, so he upgraded it to Divine grade, and that’s when it changed to [Mind Manipulation].
This time, instead of just reading the mind, Kent can manipulate those with weaker minds to do his bidding.
It is similar to [Soul Torture], but instead of killing the person within 10 minutes, this one keeps them alive while manipulating them.
He can even attack their minds, and to some extent, depending on how weak the opponent’s mind is, he can plant false memories in there.
Kent didn’t know how much stronger his mind had become after breaking the Mind Limit, so he wanted to test it in the competition.
While thinking, Kent sensed the presence of Elder Mikko long before she arrived. When she saw him standing, gazing into the rising sun, she sighed.
"You don’t have to worry too much. Even if you couldn’t win all matches, winning just 20 will get you into the Inner Sect and set you up for more advanced resources and rewarding missions."
"Huh."
Kent was taken aback. ’She thought I was second-guessing myself.’ Kent smiled but didn’t correct her.
"I will do my best to win at least 20 duels, Elder Mikko." Instead, Kent made her feel like her deduction of his character was spot on.
"By the way, why are you here, Elder Mikko?"
"I am here to pick you up. Lady Enzi wants to have a few words with you before the competition starts."
Kent nodded and started following Elder Mikko to the location, where he could already hear cheers coming from. Everyone was pumped for the battle they’d waited 14 days for.
"This place is beautiful," Kent said, gazing at the rainbow that appeared in the clouds as the sun rose from the horizon.
The picturesque look that appeared was one Kent couldn’t deny was something he would love to wake up every day staring at.
Elder Mikko smiled but didn’t say a word.
Kent wasn’t the first person to say that and wouldn’t be the last.
Soon, they appeared at the arena, which had been built with meticulous attention to detail. It has a turtle-shaped design and is large by all standards.
Every last disciple was already seated, with a few spaces that could take a couple of hundred more.
"This is the grand Turtle Arena. It was built in honor of a disciple who once led this sect to victory in the interplanetary sect competition.
He ascended ten thousand years ago, and if all things are well with him in the place where he ascended to, he without a doubt has become a powerful cultivator by now."
The pride in her tone was one Kent noticed, and he knew this Turtle guy must have made the sect proud. Even after ten thousand years, they still held him in their hearts.
’Good for Mr. Turtle, I guess,’ Kent said in his head before entering the door that doesn’t lead to the main stage where the duel will happen; instead, it led to a hallway.
They moved for a few minutes, not rushing when they could make the distance within seconds. Eventually, they arrived in front of a portal door.
"Lady Enzi is waiting for you," Elder Mikko said, gesturing toward the door. Kent nodded and walked through.
He expected to appear in a room with chairs and tables. However, he found himself in a glass room. Every part of the room was made of glass, and at its center sat Lady Enzi.
’This is strange, why the fascination for glass?’
Kent wondered why someone would surround herself with glass. In some way, he understood that she had an affinity for the glass element.
But even so, it can be a bit creepy staring at one’s reflection all day.
Kent spent most of the last few days pondering various things. He asked the tower a lot of questions, one being the glass element Lady Enzi has affinity for.

Vexthra, who later joined in on the topic, advised Kent that if possible, he must never find himself on Lady Enzi’s bad side, for the moment he gets trapped in her mirror, that will be the end for him.
She said that in all her life as a goddess, she had only met one person who had glass elemental affinity, and that person had long since become a celestial being.
She didn’t delve much deeper into it, but she made Kent aware that he might have either found someone who could greatly help him or cause him harm.
Now, he was about to face her, and he could only hope the conversation went well.
"Sit down," Lady Enzi said, and Kent sat down, facing her.
She studied him for a few moments and then spoke again, "Ask the question that pops into your mind when I snap my fingers."
*SNAP*
"Why haven’t you ascended yet?" Kent asked, not waiting for a second to pass.
