"Yuna, one of these days, I am going to seal your body and turn you into a puppet.
How many times did I tell you to walk and not run when entering the garden?"
Yuna, a dark-haired beauty with an aura of a Root Immortal, smiled.
"I am sorry, my lady, I just couldn’t contain my happiness and shock."
Pill Immortal Nefeli turned and looked at her, "You are always happy."
"This time I am overly happy."
Pill Immortal Nefeli just smirked, "Tell me why you are happy then."
"You won’t believe it, but I just got word that the Sword Dao Tablet has just inscribed a name.
I have never heard that name before, but everyone is talking about this mysterious name."
"Are you going to tell me the name, or should I pull it out of your mouth?"
Yuna smiled, "The name that appeared on the tablet is Kent Madson, an unknown person."
"What did you just say?" Pill Immortal Nefeli appeared before Yuna, looking very demanding.
Yuna didn’t panic, for she knew her master wouldn’t hurt her.
To anyone other than her, they would have panicked and fled.𝘧𝓇ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝘣𝓃ℴ𝓋𝑒𝑙.𝑐𝘰𝑚
To her, seeing her master this eager to hear something and even displaying these many expressions made her happy.
Her master is always cold and distant, so this was a new side of her she would love to see more often.
Her master has shown her an emotion, which means she wasn’t a robot, as most thought she was.
"I haven’t seen the name myself, but from rumors going around, the name Kent Madson has appeared on the Sword Dao Tablet.
Many sword Sovereigns and immortals are already making their way to the Sword Canyon to look at it themselves.
This is big, which means...
"The sword world is about to become more interesting and deadly again," Pill Immortal Nefeli smiled.
"Why are you smiling?" Yuna asked, looking strangely at her master.
Pill Immortal Nefeli looked at the half-completed image of the handsome purple-haired brat on her canvas, and her smile bloomed.
"I will be away for a while, Yuna.
Be sure to look after yourself and don’t get into a fight with the others.
I know you are the strongest, so don’t bully them."
"I will, master," Yuna smiled, "And don’t worry, I will take care of the garden, making sure all the flowers are nurtured."
"Just don’t kill them."
Saying that, Pill Immortal Nefeli vanished.
Yuna looked at the image of the person on her master’s canvas and smiled.
"If you turn out to be a scam and you break her heart, I will gut you, whoever you are or whatever your name is."
She also left, leaving the canvas behind.
A few minutes after they left, an ethereal beauty, one whose beauty is out of this world, appeared in front of the canvas and formed a chair out of nothing and sat down.
She gazed intently at the half-completed image on the canvas, spending several hours just staring at it like she wanted to burn it into her head.
After a day, she used her hand to brush Kent’s cheek and stood up.
"Looks like you are back, Jest, and have already started making waves.
As expected of the Genesis himself," she smiled.
"But for abandoning me, I will gut you when I get my hands on you... punk." Her divine aura leaked, which drew Yuna’s attention.
However, by the time she arrived, the lady was already gone.
"Maybe I miss my master so much that I thought she had returned."

chapters.title: Chapter 838: Meeting the Sword Dao Again [Bonus]
paragraphs: [Supreme Immortal Sect - Abandoned Mountain - 60 days ago]
From the moment Kent sat down to start comprehending the 14 marks, something inside him told him never to give up, no matter how profound and complex it seemed.
Thus, despite not making any progress from the start, Kent never stopped.
He used the sword mind from the get-go, so he was inside that mind space with the stone standing tall before him.
A day passed, and before long, a week passed, but he remained seated. His focus was rooted in the 14 markings, with no expense spared on other endeavors.
After a week since Kent climbed the Abandoned mountain, the elders who hadn’t seen Kent or heard anything new about him started to panic, in fear that something had happened to him.
So they came to the mountain to inspect it, hoping to persuade him to abandon his current cultivation Peak and join one of the eight.
Supreme Elder Esper was the first to get there.
However, when he was just 2 miles away from the mountain, a glassy barrier blocked him.
No words were spoken, but he immediately knew what was happening and how to act.
He stopped and, thanks to his enhanced sight, he was able to see Kent seated with his eyes closed, facing the stone.
It turns out that while the uptight Glass woman said she wouldn’t pay attention to Kent anymore, she couldn’t stay away from him.
So, the moment she heard Kent had picked the Abandoned Mountain as his cultivation peak, she came to confront him.
However, as someone who had lived for thousands of years, when she arrived and saw Kent examining the stone, she stayed back.
She could tell Kent was up to something, and confronting him at the moment would be a bad idea. So she decided to keep her distance and make sure nobody else disturbs him.
On the 20th day, Old Sword, who, thanks to Kent, was able to comprehend the basic form of Intent Solidification, also rushed over when he heard the decision Kent had made.
Naturally, he came to meet more elders, each standing 2 miles away from the mountain.
He wanted to ask why, but after sensing the barrier, he stopped and, like the rest of the elders, maintained his distance, watching and speculating about what Kent was up to.
Crossing the barrier is a bad idea.
If he dares to try to forcefully get to Kent by breaking the barrier, he might just regret it, because when it comes to trapping people, Lady Enzi is the best.
[40th Day - Kent’s POV]
The past days have been him doing his best, trying all he could. However, no matter what, Kent wasn’t making any progress until the 40th day when he sensed something.
At first, it was subtle, but Kent sensed sword will from the first mark, something he only sensed from the Sword of Enlightenment inside his sword tower.
This was his first breakthrough.
So he ignored the other marks and focused on the first mark. That was when he saw it, a complex pattern woven and perhaps rewoven with additional layers, all translating to one word.
At that moment, Kent knew what had to be done.
To understand what he was after, he must comprehend the first true name of the sword Dao.
In total, there are 14 true Names of the sword Dao, and he must comprehend all 14 if he wants to attain True Sword Energy.
Thus, Kent started working on that with complete and absolute focus.
He had been working so hard that within just 58th days, the name formed, and that was when everything changed.
"Rèn"
The moment Kent mentioned the first True Name of the sword Dao, the heavens came to an absolute silence, and then in front of all those watching, the sword Dao descended on Kent.
In that very moment, all swordsmen within the 10,000 km of Kent fell into enlightenment, one that, if they pass, will shape their journey beyond their wildest imagination.
Kent remained seated; however, his consciousness was pulled away to the realm he had been before and one he was promised to return to one day.
He had finally returned, and seated in a giant throne was the same person with the hidden face staring at him.
Kent can’t see his face, but he can sense his gaze on him.
That is the sword Dao, the true essence of the sword, and one every swordsman tries to understand.
"We meet again, slave," the sword Dao said, making Kent raise his head further, making sure the man sees the dissatisfaction on his face.
"No need to be uptight, Kent, I was just messing with you."
Kent didn’t say anything for a few more seconds before he spoke, "You know, after our first meeting, I asked myself many questions about you.
I know you are the Sword Dao, an entity beyond anyone’s comprehension—something, or perhaps someone, with a grand existence beyond this reality.
So I ask myself, if you are such a person, then shouldn’t you be more regal, mysterious, and perhaps cold? You are the sword Dao after all.
So you can only imagine how huge a question this was. It took me 5,000 years to get the answer."
"Oh, do tell. What was your answer?" the sword Dao asked.
"That you are a bastard."

Kent smiles, "I mean, you being a bastard can only explain why you can be carefree when I am serious. I mean, did you know there would be consequences from our first meeting, but choose not to tell me?"
Their first meeting was supposed to be the door Jest had been trying to open. However, after finally opening, he was met with a somewhat heartbreaking discovery.
No matter how hard he tried, he couldn’t progress on his sword path. This made him frustrated, which eventually led him to learn the basics of the sword, the only way he managed to make progress.
So all this while, the hunger and anger to face the Sword Dao again and tell him his mind had been weighing heavily on his heart.
But finally, he can point at the bastard and berate him for making his life hell for a few centuries back when he was Jest.
"That was cold, Mr. Sword Dao. If I could, I would land a few smacks on your head for making me suffer."
After 5 minutes, Kent was finally done pouring out his anger and frustration.
The sword Dao remained quiet for a few minutes before a sigh escaped his lips.
"I suppose I should have warned you about that. However, what is done is already in the past, so we should keep it in the past and focus on important stuff like how amazing you turned out to be."
"Tch," Kent sat down and crossed his legs, as if he had arrived in his lost, abandoned home. He looked comfortable, something that would take anyone aback if they were to witness this.
"You are still not mad, are you? I mean, I won’t call you a slave anymore, and about the issue with the minor bad luck, that was an oversight.
However, you turned out well in the end.
So instead of looking sour, perhaps you should thank me for helping you completely master all the basics of swordmanship, which was the main reason you managed to find your way here today."
Kent raised his brow, "So why am I here?"
"Very simple, you are here to inherit the first part of my legacy."

chapters.title: Chapter 839: The Legacy
paragraphs: "Your legacy?"
Kent asked, his brow furrowed.
"Yes. My legacy."
"Is it even possible for a human to become the sword Dao?"
"What are you talking about, Kent? I never asked for you to become me."

"Then what do you mean by ’I was here to inherit your legacy’? From where I come from, inheriting someone’s legacy means taking their path and following in their footsteps, or aiming to become them one day.
I have no plans to become a Sword Dao, Mr. Sword Dao.
So why don’t you make your sentence more precise to wash away the confusion?"
"I understand your confusion. However, I indeed want you to inherit my legacy. However, I am not looking for you to become me in the future.
A Dao cannot be replaced."
Kent nodded.
"Then what do I get from inheriting this legacy?"

"Something you have been chasing after from the day you touched the sword, the path beyond. You have been searching for that path for many years now, and while I don’t know what lies beyond, I have a way to get there.
It is something you crave, and it is what you will get if you inherit my legacy. If you want to rise to the peak and see the path beyond, then becoming the True Swordsman is the only way."
’Interesting. Looks like there is a true swordsman. Meaning the ones out there and I are just nobodies in his eyes’ Kent thought inwardly, shaking his head.
"No need to put it that way. There are swordsmen out there with understanding so vast that calling them True Swordsmen is only deserving of them.
Trust me, long before you, many swordsmen rose and came close to reaching the peak. They earned my respect, but you were the only one who qualified to see me.
"As to why that was, I still don’t understand."
Kent smirked, a smug expression plastering his face. Although the Sword Dao read his mind, he didn’t mind, for this wasn’t his first rodeo.
Hearing the Sword Dao’s confusion made him happy.
"Tell me more about this legacy, and if you are lucky, I will accept it."
Kent laughed.
The sword Dao, wondering why Kent was the only person who managed to see him, was like a validation he had been waiting for for billions of years.
He couldn’t help feeling some pride.
"I know you already know what a Dao is, but to make matters simple, when we talk of the Dao, it is The Way.
I am the sword Dao, meaning I am the way of the sword.
This means to get an understanding of the sword, you must understand me. That starts from the moment you admire that sword hanging or the swing you couldn’t grow up fast enough to make.
Understanding me is complex yet simple.
Linear yet versatile.𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝙬𝙚𝓫𝒏𝓸𝓿𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝙤𝓶
There is no one way to understand me, and that is the main reason why there are many sword paths out there. Everyone’s understanding of me is unique and comprehensive.
However, there is one true path out there, one that has existed since the very beginning, and to truly understand it, you must first gain my approval, which you did, and then inherit it.
In simple terms, this path is merely a way for you to get to what is beyond this realm.
This legacy holds that, but whether you can reach it will depend on your abilities. I am the Dao; I cannot be impartial and cannot have favorites.
However, I recognize greatness, and you have earned my respect, so I offer the one true path to reach what is beyond."
"Thanks for explaining. However, I have another question," Kent thought for a moment, then he asked, "If you are the way of the sword, then shouldn’t you know what is beyond this stage?"
"It is more complicated than you think. So, for the sake of not looking too far ahead, why don’t we focus on the legacy?"

"I suppose that will be for the best. However, the next time we meet, I will ask again and keep asking until you provide an answer. Fooling me by telling me you dont know what is beyond is just too bland."
The sword Dao just shook his head.
"The legacy has fourteen forms. You came here because you found the key to the first form. The first form is, as you called it, Rèn, meaning Edge.
The Edge represents the most fundamental principle of the sword: sharpness, decisiveness, and the power to sever. Without an edge, a sword is but a scrap of metal in one’s grip.
However, Rèn is the way to master the sword until it has reached the stage of absolute sharpness, decisiveness, and most importantly, Severing."
"Before I continue, can you tell me what a sword is?"
"A sword is simply an edge sharp enough to cut through even metal."
"That is correct, but not accurate. When we talk of a sword, it can be a scrap of metal, a mere branch on a tree, your limbs, and many more.
A sword, it’s just something you can wield, it can even be your heart, organs, and many more.
The foundations of this legacy seek to train not only the sword in your hand, but also your heart, mind, body, and soul.
All these aspects of you must be attuned with the sword. Once all that is done, you can then proceed to the next step.
It will come to you when you fully comprehend Edge."
"Sounds like a lot of work."
"Well, you are Lord Genesis, so anything is possible for you."
"Thanks for that, and I accept, I will accept the legacy." Kent wasn’t even done when a rune flew and merged with his forehead.
This made him smile, and he raised his index finger on his right hand.

"Thank you again. However, to walk your legacy, don’t you think you have to pay me? I mean, if I am not stretching it too thin, this is the second time you are talking to a living being, and this won’t be the last, so if you plan to keep talking to me, why don’t we come to some agreement?
I know aside from me, you haven’t talked to another mortal, so why don’t we keep this new friendship going?"
"Are you looking to extort from me?"
"No. Of course not. Why would I extort a whole Sword Dao? I am not that shameless.
I charge by the minute, and I have already spent an hour here.
So, how is it going for me, a few secrets on how to master ’Rèn (Edge)’ or perhaps, a way for me to easily form the foundation of two sword techniques?
Take your pick."
The sword Dao looked at Kent’s smug face for a while before a sigh came from his lips.
"You know, in all the Daos there are, I am the strongest and the most complex, yet to think a mere mortal will use logic to extort something from me."
Kent laughed, "There is a first time for everything, Senior Rèn, so this is your first time."
"Very well. I chose the second option. I will demonstrate two sword techniques that haven’t been shown before in this universe. If it is your destiny to master them, then you will."
"Bring it on."
Kent focused, and in about an hour, he was pulled out of the Sword Dao realm with a smile on his face.
When he opened his eyes, the first message he saw made him widen his smile.
His aura surged, filled with sharpness, like the air was made of countless blades.
⟦Congratulations, you have formed three sword foundations successfully. Defeat all 13 levels of the bridge to become a sword Saint⟧

⟦Congratulations, you have formed three sword foundations successfully.
Defeat all 13 levels of the bridge to become a sword Saint⟧

chapters.title: Chapter 840: Progress
paragraphs: ⟦Congratulations, you have successfully formed three sword foundations. Defeat all 13 levels of the bridge to become a sword Saint⟧.

The first message was already enough for Kent to know he had taken a massive leap in his sword path. Forming the foundation of the three sword techniques is something that may sound simple, but it has a much deeper meaning.
To have the foundation is to be able to build upon that in the years to come.
Kent had formed three foundations, each a piece of art.

It was something he never expected to happen to him so suddenly, but it did, and now, he has not only gained a slot to view the sword realm of Old Sword, but he can now use that knowledge to start building the various forms of his sword technique.
His initial plans before meeting the Sword Dao again were to use the knowledge he would gain from Old Sword’s Sword Realm to build the second foundation.
But things are different now. The knowledge will likely be applied to something else.
Kent focused on his body and examined himself.
"I can sense my senses sharpened, my sword intent, and aura had both reached level 3. This is just too good. With this, facing Sword Sages and Kings wouldn’t be a problem."
"Thank you, Sword Dao." His smile bloomed.
He had a blast with the sword Dao, who Kent is sure would be cursing at him at the moment. Not only did he get the legacy of the True Sword Path, but he even extorted him.
That was just too daring.
However, his gamble paid off, and Kent knew in the long run, he would benefit more if he played his cards right.
"With the complete roadmap of the first form of Sword Dao inside my Sword Mind, I can practise it any day. Once I fully master Edge, I will see you again, Mr. Sword Dao."
Kent stood up and walked toward the stone, which now bore no markings.
But it wasn’t just there that all markings vanished. Out there in the universe, all markings relating to the sword Dao’s legacy were wiped, making Kent the only one to take on this legacy.
If he dies before accomplishing reaching the peak, the fourteen marks will reappear and choose a different person.
"I knew picking this mountain was a fortune and not a complete waste of time at all," Kent smiled and then walked away from the stone.
However, he only took a few steps when Lady Enzi appeared before him like a shattered glass. Following her is Princess Elowen, who, from the look of things, had undergone a makeover.
"Did you do something new to your hair?"
Kent asked, ignoring the glass lady whose gaze was focused on him.
Princess Elowen blushed but didn’t say anything, instead standing obediently behind her master, showing she had taken her side. Kent chuckled and looked at the glass lady.
"Lady Enzi, I didn’t know you had a twin sister. I could have sworn she said she wouldn’t give me any of her attention ever again, now that she has a disciple."
The smile at the end of the sentence made Lady Enzi grit her teeth, but in the end, she didn’t do anything to Kent. She knew he was messing with her.
"Are you alright?" She asked
"I am fine."
"Pack up, you are leaving this place." There was no suggestion in her tone. She spoke these words with authority, one that anyone other than Kent would have obeyed without question.
However, the brat didn’t only smile, he waved his hand, "I will be staying here, Lady Enzi. It is quiet and remote, I want the peace."

"I am not asking." Her voice rose a bit like a big sister speaking to her little brother, "It’s either you leave with me now in a quiet way, or I destroy the mountain and you leave with me. The choice is yours."
"Lead the way, big sister."
Kent smiles, knowing that if he wants to keep coming here to stay away from prying eyes, he cannot let the woman destroy the mountain.
"By the way, where are we going?"
To answer his question, the shattered portal opened, and he was tossed in. The next second, he appeared atop a small floating island with a grand mansion sitting on it.
It looks elegant.
"This is my dwelling. From today on, you will stay here. Since you don’t want to join the other cultivation peaks, you can stay here and still represent your peak if you want."
Kent looked around, and he could tell that staying here wouldn’t be too bad,
"Dont worry, I dont have time to spy on your affairs."
Kent smiled, "I wasn’t complaining."
"You can use this flying treasure to move from here to the sect. Without it, you wouldn’t be able to move through the formations."
Kent received the miniature flying ship and stored it inside his tower storage.
Though he had yet to see around the sect, he planned to do that before focusing on other things.
Lady Enzi left with Princess Elowen, who had started her training on becoming the next glass lady.
Long ago, when Lady Enzi received the Glass Cultivation manual from an unknown person, it came in two forms: the Earth Glass Path and the Cold Flame Path.
Lady Enzi has cultivated the Earth Glass Path, and now, she wants Princess Elowen to cultivate the Cold Flame Path.
It was her way of fulfilling the wishes of the mysterious person who had given her the technique.
It would take some time and a lot of hard work, but eventually, she would be able to make it, and when that day came, she would become an unstoppable force in the universe...both of them.
After they left, Kent chose to look around the floating island for a few hours before using the flying boat to speed off toward the sect where he planned to see what the sect life is all about."
[Elarion - Uncle Drake’s warning]
During the auction, when the sea race attacked, Uncle Drake killed 6 of them and sent the last one away with the bodies of the dead and a warning.

This warning wasn’t received well, and while he expected the true mastermind behind the first attack to appear the next day, he was shocked when an army of 5,000 sea beasts came two weeks after Kent left for the sect.
It was brutal, but it lasted for three minutes, leaving only one alive to deliver another message.
This time, the message was delivered well, and a few hours ago, Lord Leviathan arrived. To his shock, Uncle Drake was waiting for him at the shore.
There were no words exchanged.
The battle started immediately their gaze met. It lasted for three hours, but after they both took their beast forms, the battle ended with a winner.
Uncle Drake won, but Lord Leviathan received his respect because he had put up a fight.
Uncle Drake planned to look down on him, but after he won, he only gave Lord Leviathan a warning.
"Coming after Kent is not the way out, so learn from your mistake because even though he said I can’t kill you, next time, it won’t end with you keeping your life."
With that, he tossed him back into the ocean and left for Elarion. He will stay for a few months, just in case Lord Leviathan comes again.
After that, he will use the teleportation token and teleport to Elder Lance’s world.

chapters.title: Chapter 841: The Venom King, Xhan Wu [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Isn’t that the Kent guy who everyone keeps talking about?"
"That is him. I learned he dominated the entire outer and inner sect while we were away."
"Good for him. If we were around, he would have seen what true talent looks like."
Three inner disciples, each from the Lightning Peak, said smugly, staring at Kent, who had just landed in the Mutual space.
It was the only place in the sect where all disciples could meet and train.

Those who wanted to measure their strength against the disciples from other cultivation peaks mostly frequented this place. Kent, who was the only disciple to join the abandoned peak, was also there to see what he could get from there.
He hadn’t even landed when he started sensing gazes from almost everywhere.
"Should we test him?" one of the disciples asked.
"There is no need. I learned he has been offered a slot to join the selection trial; we will see his strength then."
"Good for him, I guess."
The more they looked at Kent, the hungrier they became to exchange blows with him. It pained them that during the duel, they werent around.
As the only three out of the many disciples from the Lightning Peak to be selected to participate in the selection trial, they saw themselves as superior to the others.

Kent, of course, was minding his business, exploring the many things the sect had to offer. A few minutes into his exploration, a voice called out from behind him, making him wish that lightning would fall from the heavens and strike the person.
"Big brother Kent, I miss you so much."

When Kent turned to face Nyss, he saw her lunging at him with her arms wide open for a hug. He contemplated dodging, but he didn’t have the heart to do that, so he let the troublemaker fall into his arms and hug him.
"Big brother Kent, where have you been all this time? I came here every single day to see you, but you were nowhere to be found. I even cried a few times, just missing you."
Nyss asked, Kent, holding her hand as they walked around.
"Don’t you have like a training or something important to do?" Kent asked, but Nyss just shrugged.
"Training is boring. I prefer to go about my day like a normal person instead of training like a maniac every single day."
Kent didn’t say anything but just focused his energy through her body and found out all she said was bullshit. She had improved, and Kent could feel it.
’Looks like her Soul Flame isn’t simple at all. Perhaps that was why it was sealed in the first place.’

Kent wanted to know more about that, but after a few moments of thought, he let it slide. There are other important things he can focus on, and this isn’t one of them. Perhaps in the future, he will know more.
"Have you tried the Perfect Chamber?" Kent instead chose to ask something he could learn from.
"I did, but I was defeated at 61%. It turns out my true potential is more talented than I am. But I learned a lot, and I am sure the next time I try, I will be able to push forward more."
"Maybe you should train more instead of obsessing over me. I dont even like your nosy and troublemaking"
"Well, I like your aloofness, and I can’t get enough of you, big brother. Perhaps if you spar with me, I will be forced to train more."
"I have no plans to spar with you and will never have such plans in the future," Kent smirked.
"Then I won’t train and keep following you around whenever I get the chance, like today."
"Go ahead. You will be the one slacking while the rest of your friends surpass you." Nyss didn’t answer him, but judging by the look on her face, she wasn’t going to slack off after today’s meeting.
She is no simple person, so Kent knew she would make something out of herself, and like she said, she will face the Perfect Chamber again.
Kent was about to say something new when he felt a sudden glare lock on him. This moved him, and turning sharply toward the gaze, his eyes met a pair of dangerous green eyes.
Those eyes belong to the Venom King.
He is slender and wiry, with ash-grey skin. His long, black hair is tied back with green silk, and judging by the look on his face, he doesn’t appear happy to see Kent holding hands with his sister.
Suddenly, the entire Mutual space turned quiet as everyone felt the poison in the air.
Xhan Wu, also known as the Venom King, was staring at Kent. That is not something anyone wanted to see, for it was not meant to happen this early.
However, it was happening: a Core disciple who had been seeded for the upcoming Interplanetary sect competition was inside the inner sect, and his demeanor wasn’t friendly.
Of course, the Venom King never smiled or looked friendly, but they all could feel the intensity of his gaze on Kent, and that alone made them take a few steps back.
Kent examined the fellow and then tapped Nyss on the shoulder, asking a question that made many gasp.
"Who is that weirdo?"
Nyss smiled, hearing Kent’s question like it was her morning tea.
"That is my brother, Xhan. But they call him the Venom King."
"Oh, I see. In any case, can you tell him to stop staring at me like I have stolen his wife?"
"Big brother Xhan, Kent said I should tell you to stop staring at him like he had stolen your wife."
Nyss, of course, was happy to comply, for while he calls Xhan his brother, they are, in fact, not from the same mother, and, well, they don’t get along like siblings should.
In a way, she was fanning the flames already, pouring more fuel into making him very mad.
Naturally, the torment worked.
Xhan frowned and moved, appearing before Kent in an instant with a palm strike.
However, while he aimed with all his heart to leave a poison imprint on Kent’s body for later use, his palm struck the air, for Kent saw him attack and evade even before his palm moved.
Hush sound spread everywhere again, this time not for Xhan but for Kent, who was the only one who managed to evade Xhan’s Poison Palm.
It had never happened before, so this was a shock to them.
Kent appeared 3 meters from Xhan, still holding Nyss’s hands.
"That was not cool, young man. I don’t suppose we know each other, so why attack me?" Kent asked with a frown.
He hadn’t expected an attack to come so early, especially not from a dignified Core disciple. So being attacked was random. However, it also gave him the platform to see where things go.
"Shouldn’t a Core disciple be more regal and appear above mere inner disciples like me, who hasn’t even formed his core yet?"
"Let go of her hand," Xhan said, locking his gaze on Kent. However, Kent remained unfazed. He shrugged off Xhan’s killing intent and pointed at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 842: Fatality [Bonus]
paragraphs: "I don’t take kindly to those who attack without a reason. Be sure never to repeat that mistake ever again."
The look on everyone’s face changed.
"Did Kent just threaten the Venom King?"
"Yes, he sure did, and I think he has a death wish."
"He is dead. There is no denying that."
Xhan narrowed his gaze at Kent for a few seconds before a green mist started spreading toward Kent.
"He had activated the poison mist ability... Kent is done for."
"He deserves it. Who does he think he is to threaten a core disciple? Not even the sect elders will do that."
Kent pushed Nyss away, making sure she was away from the poison mist. Then a grin appeared on his face.
"First question. What at all do you wish to achieve from doing this?" Kent asked, then he raised two fingers.
"And what is your plan to begin with? Do you think a little poison can harm me?
Lastly, aren’t you scared I will disgrace you in front of all your shameless fans?"
All the questions were ones Xhan ignored, for he was looking forward to seeing what Kent had under his sleeves.
So far, he had heard four shocking things about Kent, and each one pissed him off.

The first was Kent learning 12 Divine grade techniques. That was like a slap to his face, for had it not been for the sect, he wouldn’t have even had the chance to see what a divine-grade technique book looks like before learning one.
So, Kent learning 12 was something he didn’t take lightly. All five seeded core disciples shared this sentiment.

Then there was the part where Kent challenged the entire outer and inner sect and won, as if it were nothing. He even gained the recognition of Lady Enzi and Old Sword, two of the influential people in the sect.
But if that wasn’t enough, Kent even gained the chance to ask for Lady Enzi’s help twice, and will also experience Old Sword’s sword realm.
Though Xhan isn’t a true swordsman, he uses the sword and knows how the sword realm affects one’s understanding of the sword and combat power.
Having the chance to experience it was just too good for someone who had joined the sect less than 3 months ago.
Lastly, Kent was added to the selection trial for the interplanetary trial. That was what infuriated him to the core, prompting him to use the excuse of visiting his sister to test Kent.
He wants to disgrace him and show everyone Kent is a nobody.
However, the pan flipped on him, for the brat was not fazed at his provocation.
"Looks like you are still in the delusion that you are the top in this sect. That might be true to them, but not me." Kent smiled and took a deep breath, sucking the poison into his lungs.
Everyone left their jaws hanging when they saw that. Even Xhan widened his eyes. While many would try not to breathe in the toxin, Kent did so willingly.

"Your poison is nothing but air in front of me. I know a true Poison Queen, one whose aura can kill you a thousand times over. So if you came here thinking you can do anything with your poison, then please turn around and leave.

However, if you stay and try to do anything stupid, I will be forced to do what you wouldn’t want, which is to show the entire sect their best and brightest is beneath me, a mere level 4 Core Formation Inner disciple."
"Big brother Kent, kick his ass. Maybe that will knock some sense into his head," Nyss said from the side, causing her brother to glare at her, but she remained unfazed.
"Big brother Xhan used to be a prodigy until he joined the sect and defeated all the top geniuses, then he started to think he was undefeated.
However, I am sure with a few poison resistance pills, I will be able to wipe the floor with him."
Kent didn’t expect that, so the mysterious and angry character he put on cracked, causing him to burst out laughing.

"Nyss, dear, while I would love to see you wipe the floor with your brother, know that his mastery over poison is almost at the Super stage, which means not even Tier 9 poison resistance pills can help you.

But even if they did, I can see he had already broken two limits, unlike you, with only one limit broken. Aside from that, his foundation has been reformed three times already, whereas yours has only been reformed once.
So, strength-wise, he will shatter every bone in your body; speed-wise, he also surpasses you, thanks to his ability to move through the poison mist. He is more impressive than you in every aspect.
But don’t worry, when it comes to good looks, you surpass him, and your mouth is also louder than his, so perhaps you might be able to win when it comes to verbal battle."
Kent smiled and winked at Xhan, whose face hadn’t turned pale, but the look on his face was pale.
⟦Master, if the cultivation gig doesn’t work out, you can try your hand at becoming a lawyer. I am sure with just your words alone, you can keep criminals out of jail.⟧
’Whose fault is it?’
⟦Well, I grow stronger and more intelligent as you grow, so perhaps you should give yourself the credit, master.⟧
’I suppose I am impressive.’
After Kent visited the sword Dao and inherited its legacy, his perception had sharpened. While that was thanks to his sword gaze, it had also affected all his abilities that involved his eyes.
Now, his Enchanted eyes can see more than they used to.
At first, he couldn’t see how many limits one had broken or how many times they’d rebuilt their foundation.
But now he does, and that alone was enough for him to know more about his opponent before the battle even began.
"Big brother Kent, you are too cruel, but thanks for complimenting my good looks. I indeed have good genes, unlike this silver-skinned bastard brother of mine."
Kent smirked and focused on Xhan. "What you came for today won’t pan out well for you, so take my advice and leave.
The only reason I’m not attacking you now is that we’ll soon be teammates, and since we both want to win for the sect, let’s not become enemies.
That would be detrimental to our team and could lower our chances of winning. That said, if you still want to fight me, then we can take it to the arena."
Kent moved and appeared beside him and whispered into his ear, "You are close to breaking the next limit. Use your time training instead of coming after me.
Trust me, being my enemy is just stupid. If I were you, I would become friends with me instead."
With that, Kent moved away.
Nyss also moved but stopped beside her brother. "Not so tough now. Take my advice and focus on your training instead of looking for trouble with big brother Kent.
I might not have the means to beat you now, but one day, I will surpass you and wipe the floor with you."
With her chin high and shoulders held high like a kangaroo, she left.
Kent, who heard her words, just smiled, shaking his head.
Inwardly, he sent a message to Princess Lovina...

Somewhere in Fedora, Princess Lovina smiled before turning a hellhound into a carcass, draining all life from it.

Lastly, aren’t you scared I will disgrace you in front of all your shameless fans?"

He is more impressive than you in every aspect.
But don’t worry, when it comes to good looks, you surpass him, and your mouth is also louder than his, so perhaps you might be able to win when it comes to verbal battle."

chapters.title: Chapter 843: Refiner
paragraphs: "Big brother Kent, you really are amazing," Nyss said, retaking Kent’s hands as they resumed their tour of the Mutual space like he hadn’t just faced a Core Disciples.
Kent smiled, "Of course I am amazing. There is only one of my kind."
Nyss shook her head, hearing the self-praise. Of course, she knew Kent was indeed amazing, and he deserved to give himself all the praise.
"So, how did you do it?"
"Do what"𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝐰𝚎𝕓𝐧𝚘𝘃𝗲𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝕞
"How did you breathe in Big Brother Xhan’s poison mist?"
Kent smiled with a slight grin, tugging the side of his mouth, "I have high poison resistance."
"Really"
"Of course"
"How did you get it?" Nyss truly wanted to know, and even though Kent wished to tease her, he knew that some things are better taken seriously, so he gave her a genuine answer.
"I married a poison queen, and she gave it to me."
Nyss stopped and stared at Kent’s serious face, and for a moment she blinked and pounded his chest with her fist, "Cut the jokes, big brother, I am serious."

Kent laughed, "Who said I am joking. I indeed have a poison Queen as a wife. Of course, in reality, she is a princess, but when it comes to her profession, she is the queen of poison, and she gave me my resistance to poison."
Nyss studied Kent for a few minutes, noting his expression, "You are being serious."
"Dead Serious.

"Too bad, I wanted to learn poison resistance so that I can counter big brother Xhan’s poison and gain the advantage to beat the crap out of him." Nyss laughed, though Kent could sense the disappointment behind her laugh.
He may not understand why two siblings can’t get along, but he sure knows if Nyss were to have a counter for Xhans’s poison, she would indeed challenge her brother.
"Don’t worry, I will ask my poison queen wife if she can help you."
Nyss seems to lighten up a bit hearing Kent’s words.
Soon, they left the area where the altercation with Xhan had happened.
They made their way through the space, earning many scrutinizing gazes as the news of Kent’s face-off with Xhan started spreading.
Eventually, Kent and Nyss stopped in front of an Enlightenment Peak, one where an elder was refining a sword in front of hundreds of inner disciples.
Kent didn’t plan on coming there, nor even staying to look at someone refine a weapon. However, something in him made him stop when they reached there.
"Big brother, do you know weapon refining too?" Nyss asked, noticing where they had come to a stop.
"No, however, I want to observe this for a moment and see if I would like to stay." Nyss clearly didn’t want to stay, but seeing Kent wish to stay, she had to make a sacrifice.
So they walked closer, sat down, and started paying attention.
The space they were in was quiet, and despite the disciples making noise all over, they didn’t hear a single thing. The only noise, if heard by anyone, will be from inside the containment formation.
Hovering behind the elder is a soul flag, and before him is an ordinary sword spinning vertically. The elder was moving souls from the flag and using them to refine the sword.
’This is unreal’
Kent said inwardly, paying close attention to what the elder was doing. The more souls he takes from the soul flag, the more powerful the sword gets.
None of the disciples dared blink, for they feared even blinking once would cause them dearly.
’Tower, keep tracking the grade of the sword and update me whenever it goes up.’
A few hours later, the tower updated Kent on the grade of the sword.
⟦Current Grade: Legendary (Low)⟧
’Interesting. So, picking just a normal sword, he was able to refine it into a legendary grade sword.’
⟦That is the gist of it, but yes. As a refiner, he has the means to use souls to refine a mere sword into something worthy of being wielded.
That said, a refiner is just a basic form of the true refining path. To experience true refining, you must look into soul refining.
They don’t use scrap metal as a medium to refine souls. A true soul refiner is someone who can transform souls directly into weapons.

They can also refine soul flags and use them as a medium to hold prohibitions and other formations that naturally, all soul refiners can draw. In a way, what you are seeing now is but a small branch of refining⟧

’I see. Then I’d better find a soul refiner. Just looking at it is, in a way, helping me sharpen my gaze. I believe if I see more of this, I will be able to master the first form of the legacy much faster.’
⟦I will look into that for the master. But for now, you can watch this to the end. Every small progress is part of the journey.⟧
’You are right, tower...every small progress counts.’
Kent focused, and using his mental space, he isolated everyone, bringing the elder into the sword mind space, where only the two of them were.

This was an upgrade to his sword mind after he visited the Dao realm. Now, regardless of what he wanted to learn, he can take it to the sword mind, where it will be between him and the thing he is after.
Four hours later, the elder was done refining the sword, managing to raise its quality to High.
It wasn’t much compared to Mystical grade swords; however, it was already good enough considering the elder only uses 1,000 souls for the refining process.
⟦The master must know that although the outcome isn’t satisfactory, the weapon formed is not simple. It is capable of inflicting both physical and soul damage.⟧
Kent furrowed his brow, looking more closely at the sword hovering before the elder. It transformed from an ordinary, rusty sword to a sleek, silver sword pulsing with soul energy.
’I have a question, tower.’ Kent’s heartbeat quickened as he asked the question, ’Say I were to take this sword now, can I take it inside my soul universe?’

⟦Indeed, and nice job catching that master. I was waiting for you to think of that. But the master’s thinking is indeed spot on; this sword can be taken into the soul universe and further refined into a more deadly sword.
The best part, unlike the asteroid that can only be used once, the sword can be used multiple times. All you have to do is recharge it with soul essence after use.⟧

’Damn. What a nice plot twist. This means if I were to get, say, Mythic grade refined swords and other weapons, I can turn them into deadly weapons, which will cut my work short for me from having to create them from scratch.’
Kent was thrilled that every part of his body was screaming at him to snatch the sword and send it into his soul universe.
However, he held himself back and instead paid attention to what the elder had to say.
"Three months from today, there will be a weapon refining competition. Those of you confident that you can refine legendary-grade weapons are free to register.
The sect will provide all resources, and the winner gets to walk home with a hundred thousand soul flag with souls inside already."
’Put it on my schedule tower. For now, I have things to do, but in three months I must be ready to join the competition.’
Kent spent the next few hours with Nyss, going from one place to the next. When they had had enough, Kent went back to Lady Enzi’s dwelling and entered the tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 844: Back to The Tower
paragraphs: "How is Camilla doing?" Kent asked Vexthra, who was seated inside the love garden.
"She had woken up, but currently, she is in some form of enlightened state. It has been months now, but she has yet to wake up," Vexthra responded with a smile.
"I hope she wakes up feeling even more powerful," Kent, who can’t wait to talk to Camilla, said with a sigh.

Her ultimate attack, which brought down the walls of the unbreakable city, left an imprint on him. Later, finding out what makes the ladies thick made him want to have a heart-to-heart with Camilla the moment she wakes up.
It would be good if she knew he had seen her and was proud of her.

"Don’t worry, Kent, she is fine. I checked many times, and the tower even confirmed that she is fine, so relax." Vexthra took his hands. "Instead of worrying, why don’t you tell me about your life in the sect?"
Kent smiled and started narrating his life so far in the sect. It took a couple of hours, but he managed to narrate everything to her.
"First of all, what kind of monster are you?" Vexthra asked, and Kent smiled.
"The kind you fell in love with."
Looking at his smiling face, Vexthra couldn’t help shaking her head. "Why am I even shocked? You were Lord Genesis, so it is normal for you to talk to a Dao.
But to think you actually talk to the sword Dao. That is just too much for even a goddess to comprehend."
"No need to think too much about it, Vex, I am just too amazing."
"That you are, and I love you regardless. But sometimes tone it down a bit; some of us need to actually work for our strength, unlike you who just take it like a fruit in your garden."
Kent pulled Vexthra’s head back and kissed her cheek. "Is that jealousy I am sensing?"
"Of course, I am jealous. I recently learned how to be jealous, so I am being one now."
Kent laughed with her. "Well, jealousy looks good on you. It makes you look harmless and cute like a puppy."
Kent cupped Vexthra’s cheeks, making the goddess blush.
"So this glass lady you are talking about, how strong is she?"
"Well, she can give me a run for my money, and if she manages to trap me in her glass domain, then she can even kill me.
But aside from that, she had refined all seven cores, reformed her foundation five times, and broken three limits. She is also a Silver body cultivator and a Tier 14 soul cultivator.
She had also merged her glass with the void but could only use it for movement."
"I see. But how did you learn all this about her? Judging her character from what you told me, she wouldn’t have said all this to you."
Kent smiles and points at his eyes. "It turns out that inheriting the legacy of the sword Dao tends to make one see more than they wish."
Vexthra just shook her head.
"You are just impossible to even understand at this point. That said, this lady was clearly visited by the Glass Church."
"Glass Church," Kent asked with a raised brow.

"They are a cult of glass elemental cultivators, one of the major cults with unimaginable power in the universe. I don’t know how they do it, but they have a way of identifying talents and nurturing them from infancy.

One day, when she gets to the immortal world, they will definitely reach out. Joining them won’t be bad, but judging by what you just said, I think she needs to work extra hard, for her current talent is barely average.
If she doesn’t improve now, she will be but cannon fodder in the Glass Church."
"I see. Then I’d better make sure my big sister grows up into an amazing and terrifying cultivator."
"Your big sister," Vexthra looked at Kent weirdly. Kent just laughed.
"What, you think I chase just every skirt?"
"Yes," Vexthra responded, and Kent just shrugged.
"Well, I don’t. I now have a big sister who is a little uptight but will soften up soon. Aside from that, I even have an annoying little sister who is actually older than me, but well, she is weird."
"I need to tell the girls, they are going to be shocked," Vexthra laughed and then slipped her hands into Kent’s pants, finding her way to the Dragon rod.
"The fox princess asked of you the last time I was in Fedora," Vexthra said with a smile as she unzipped Kent’s trousers and pulled out the soft dragon.
"I will see her later. For now, she can wait for me while I get my affairs in order."
"I suppose that is for the best. That said, I think you should help the Old Sword guy, too. He will be a great addition to your force in the future.
In fact, help those you feel like helping. You never know what will happen in the future, and little gestures like this can go a long way."
With that, Vexthra was done talking as she took the dragon into her mouth and started working on it.
It took just a few moments to bring the dragon to full length; thus, inside the garden, the dragon and his goddess started a night of passion, one that lasted all night.
The next day, Kent went to check up on Gaia, Akira, and Dori, who still hadn’t woken up yet.
After checking up on them, he went to Gaiaville to visit Elaine’s parents to say hello. He did the same with Velyra’s family before retiring to the sword tower to start what he came there to do.

He stood at the first level of the sword bridge and gazed at level six, where he would be facing the next challenger. This time, Kent plans on clearing all 13 levels and becoming a Sword Saint before leaving the tower.
[Planet Hular - Dream Human Continent: Dream City. Emperor Yuval’s Palace]
It’s been months since the unbreakable city was destroyed.
In these past months, powerful cultivators from all over the Kevlar Planetary Alliance came to see what they had tried for years to break but couldn’t.
This was a shock to them.
They had tried all means to learn about who had the means to break the city that stood tall for years, but came out empty-handed.
Emperor Yuval was, in fact, the most concerned in the world of Hular.
He was the strongest yet, and an unknown group of people came to a part of his empire, killed everyone, and vanished without a trace.
The amusing part is that it all happened in under an hour.
He needed answers about who these people were.
However, that would have to wait for now, for something else has occurred, and that is of more importance than anything else.
He is seated in his throne room reading a scroll delivered to him by Meric, his trusted elder.𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶

"This is interesting, to think a whole Star Emperor will issue an order to all planetary heads to look into this mysterious Kent Madson... what has he done?" Emperor Yuval muttered, closing the scroll.
"I don’t know, Emperor, but the race to find something, anything about this Kent Madson will be rewarded greatly."
"Then we’d better get started. Use all our resources to locate this person."
Meric nodded and left.
"Kent Madson, what have you done to get the whole universe looking for you?"

"Don’t worry, Kent, she is fine.
I checked many times, and the tower even confirmed that she is fine, so relax." Vexthra took his hands.
"Instead of worrying, why don’t you tell me about your life in the sect?"
Kent smiled and started narrating his life so far in the sect.
It took a couple of hours, but he managed to narrate everything to her.
"First of all, what kind of monster are you?" Vexthra asked, and Kent smiled.
"The kind you fell in love with."
Looking at his smiling face, Vexthra couldn’t help shaking her head.
"Why am I even shocked?
You were Lord Genesis, so it is normal for you to talk to a Dao.
But to think you actually talk to the sword Dao.
That is just too much for even a goddess to comprehend."
"No need to think too much about it, Vex, I am just too amazing."
"That you are, and I love you regardless.
But sometimes tone it down a bit; some of us need to actually work for our strength, unlike you who just take it like a fruit in your garden."
Kent pulled Vexthra’s head back and kissed her cheek.
"Is that jealousy I am sensing?"
"Of course, I am jealous.
I recently learned how to be jealous, so I am being one now."
Kent laughed with her.
"Well, jealousy looks good on you.
It makes you look harmless and cute like a puppy."
Kent cupped Vexthra’s cheeks, making the goddess blush.
"So this glass lady you are talking about, how strong is she?"
"Well, she can give me a run for my money, and if she manages to trap me in her glass domain, then she can even kill me.
But aside from that, she had refined all seven cores, reformed her foundation five times, and broken three limits.
She is also a Silver body cultivator and a Tier 14 soul cultivator.
She had also merged her glass with the void but could only use it for movement."
"I see.
But how did you learn all this about her?
Judging her character from what you told me, she wouldn’t have said all this to you."
Kent smiles and points at his eyes.
"It turns out that inheriting the legacy of the sword Dao tends to make one see more than they wish."
Vexthra just shook her head.
"You are just impossible to even understand at this point.
That said, this lady was clearly visited by the Glass Church."
"Glass Church," Kent asked with a raised brow.
"They are a cult of glass elemental cultivators, one of the major cults with unimaginable power in the universe.
I don’t know how they do it, but they have a way of identifying talents and nurturing them from infancy.
One day, when she gets to the immortal world, they will definitely reach out.
Joining them won’t be bad, but judging by what you just said, I think she needs to work extra hard, for her current talent is barely average.
If she doesn’t improve now, she will be but cannon fodder in the Glass Church."
"I see.
Then I’d better make sure my big sister grows up into an amazing and terrifying cultivator."
"Your big sister," Vexthra looked at Kent weirdly.
Kent just laughed.
"What, you think I chase just every skirt?"
"Yes," Vexthra responded, and Kent just shrugged.
"Well, I don’t.
I now have a big sister who is a little uptight but will soften up soon.
Aside from that, I even have an annoying little sister who is actually older than me, but well, she is weird."
"I need to tell the girls, they are going to be shocked," Vexthra laughed and then slipped her hands into Kent’s pants, finding her way to the Dragon rod.
"The fox princess asked of you the last time I was in Fedora," Vexthra said with a smile as she unzipped Kent’s trousers and pulled out the soft dragon.
"I will see her later.
For now, she can wait for me while I get my affairs in order."
"I suppose that is for the best.
That said, I think you should help the Old Sword guy, too.
He will be a great addition to your force in the future.
In fact, help those you feel like helping.
You never know what will happen in the future, and little gestures like this can go a long way."
With that, Vexthra was done talking as she took the dragon into her mouth and started working on it.
It took just a few moments to bring the dragon to full length; thus, inside the garden, the dragon and his goddess started a night of passion, one that lasted all night.
The next day, Kent went to check up on Gaia, Akira, and Dori, who still hadn’t woken up yet.
After checking up on them, he went to Gaiaville to visit Elaine’s parents to say hello.
He did the same with Velyra’s family before retiring to the sword tower to start what he came there to do.
He stood at the first level of the sword bridge and gazed at level six, where he would be facing the next challenger.
This time, Kent plans on clearing all 13 levels and becoming a Sword Saint before leaving the tower.
[Planet Hular - Dream Human Continent: Dream City.
Emperor Yuval’s Palace]
It’s been months since the unbreakable city was destroyed.
In these past months, powerful cultivators from all over the Kevlar Planetary Alliance came to see what they had tried for years to break but couldn’t.
This was a shock to them.
They had tried all means to learn about who had the means to break the city that stood tall for years, but came out empty-handed.
Emperor Yuval was, in fact, the most concerned in the world of Hular.
He was the strongest yet, and an unknown group of people came to a part of his empire, killed everyone, and vanished without a trace.
The amusing part is that it all happened in under an hour.
He needed answers about who these people were.
However, that would have to wait for now, for something else has occurred, and that is of more importance than anything else.
He is seated in his throne room reading a scroll delivered to him by Meric, his trusted elder.𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶

"This is interesting, to think a whole Star Emperor will issue an order to all planetary heads to look into this mysterious Kent Madson... what has he done?" Emperor Yuval muttered, closing the scroll.
"I don’t know, Emperor, but the race to find something, anything about this Kent Madson will be rewarded greatly."
"Then we’d better get started.
Use all our resources to locate this person."
Meric nodded and left.
"Kent Madson, what have you done to get the whole universe looking for you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 845: Clearing The Sword Bridge [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Here we go again."
Kent said as he began walking toward the 6th level of the Sword Bridge.
The last time he challenged the sword bridge, he nearly died when he used an attack that he wasn’t meant to have or his body could handle.
Of course, back then, Kent was hungry to have finally managed to create a powerful sword attack capable of killing those several realms above him.
Safe to say he succeeded, but in the end, he couldn’t use it ever again until he became a Sword King. However, he managed to clear the 5th level.
However, he passed out immediately afterward.
This time, he plans on clearing all eight remaining levels.

The moment he stepped into the 6th level, the space around him changed. He appeared inside an empty arena where his opponent, a redskin copy of him clad in red armor, with a double sword sheathed behind, was waiting for him.
"Took you long enough." The redskin clone said as it started pulling out the two swords sheathed on its back.
"Oh, you can talk now," Kent asked with a slightly shocked expression. The previous clones he killed couldn’t talk, so this was a new one.
"Prepare, this won’t be like the previous ones." The clone didn’t answer his question; instead, it began to prepare.
Kent nodded, already aware of what had to be done.
He locked gaze with the red clone, and before long, they both moved.
Kent sped up and closed the gap between him and the clone.
Of course, like every good old-fashioned sword fight, they both took a big swing.
The clone brought both swords into a powerful slash against Kent’s neck and arm.
Kent also took a big swing, one filled with considerable strength.
However, just when the swords were about to meet and a cacophony of metal symphony, Kent grinned, and then he vanished. The next second, a sword appeared through the clone’s chest.
"Sorry, but I have become much faster since the last time we met." With that, he pulled out the sword, and the clone dissolved into sparks of golden light, entering Kent’s body.
All of a sudden, he felt his understanding of the sword deepen. However, that wasn’t all; his sharpness and decisiveness also showed some slight improvement.
That brought a smile to Kent’s face. "Looks like I will be seeing you again soon, Mr. Sword Dao."

The small growth in his ’Edge’ made him happy, as it showed he had already started making progress and would soon reach the point he was meant to achieve, unlocking the second form of the True Sword path legacy.
"This is amazing, I now have 10 split bodies." Kent shook his head and smiled. The tower then gave him an idea that made Kent want to try it immediately.
⟦Since the master has awakened Sword Body, why don’t you try merging the split bodies into the sword body?⟧
"That is genius, Tower. I never thought of that before, but I will try it now."
With time on his hands, Kent sat down and activated all ten split bodies and also activated his sword body.
⟦All the master has to do is channel the split bodies through the sword body. There will be some discomfort, but bear it and it will all be worth it in the end.⟧
Kent listened to the tower’s instructions and applied them.
He channeled the split bodies through his sword body.
Like passing one’s hand through water, Kent felt the split bodies enter his own and began to pass through.𝒇𝒓𝙚𝒆𝔀𝓮𝓫𝒏𝓸𝙫𝓮𝓵.𝓬𝙤𝙢
His body felt weird.
"It feels squishy," Kent said, feeling all the squishiness as he continued to channel more split bodies.
The first ten passed through, and the process repeated itself three more times, but no change happened. However, Kent never stopped.
He continued five more times.
Then, from the 6th time, he felt the weirdness in his body slowly start to die down until eventually, he felt nothing else.
Then, after a few more channelings, Kent felt it...
The change he had been waiting for happened, and at the very moment, a message appeared showing what he had gained.
⟦Congratulations. You have learned a new skill: Clone Body.⟧
⟦You can now split your sword body into clone bodies. All clone bodies can only use sword-related skills. Also, the clones can unleash only 70% of your total strength.⟧

"This is good enough. At least now, I can unleash ten clone bodies, and even though they will only be able to use 70% of my total strength, I have broken a limit on my body, so there will be more energy in them than one can expect."
Kent stood up and was already pumped to dive into the 7th level so he could test his new skill.
When he appeared on the 7th level, he was sent to the same arena. This time, his opponent was dark red and seemed even more formidable than the last one.
However, Kent had one thing the clone didn’t have, and that was his clone bodies.
When he unleashed his ten clone bodies, the battle ended in under five seconds.
The moment the clone bodies appeared, Kent felt his mind split into eleven parts, one for each clone and the 11th for his own true body.

The rest was merely him using two clones to attack and act as dummies for the 3rd clone. In fact, he didn’t even use any active skills. The clone just unleashed an attack using sword aura, but the outcome was immediate.
The only downside was that when the first two clones died, he felt some mental fatigue. But that washed away in the next couple of seconds.
He realized the fatigue would only weigh him down if more of the clones died during combat. So he did not let any of the clones die on the 9th and 10th levels.
However, he also saw the stress that goes into using the clone bodies.
Aside from the mental fatigue, he also saw that using more clones is stressful. So he adapted, and in the 11th battle, he used just one clone.
The opponent was powerful, and the battle lasted much longer, but with the clone aiding him, Kent was able to handle it.
Kent even went a step further and shortened the time it took to handle the 12th level.
By the time the 12th-level battle ended, he saw another use for the clone bodies.
This time, he discovered that, regardless of how many clones he used in combat, the outcome wouldn’t be much stressful if he used them the right way.
So when he finally reached the 13th level, he used three clones, and that was when he realized what a monstrous skill he had unlocked.
With the added ability to swap places with the clone bodies, Kent became unstoppable.
Not even one attack from the level 13 clone managed to land on him. It was as if his movement was enhanced, and the faster he moved, the quicker his instincts developed.
"I guess it was fun while it lasted. Now, I am a Sword Saint, and I have become much stronger," Kent smiled.
"But the grind still continues, and now, I must see what the tower has for me." Kent sat down on the Sword Bridge and accessed the tower interface.

chapters.title: Chapter 846: Sword Saint
paragraphs: ⟦Congratulations, you are now a Sword Saint⟧
⟦Your sword intent and sword Qi have been upgraded to Level 4⟧
⟦Your understanding of the sword will now be boosted by 3 times the normal speed⟧
"As expected, the rewards are worth the struggle." Kent smiled.
He had been through a lot, and finally, he managed to rise to the level he is at. Of course, the journey was rewarding, and he knew that, too. But finally becoming a Sword Saint felt good.
Though his understanding is almost on the level of a Sword King, he knew that when it comes to the path he is walking, which is the genesis path, there is nothing like limited understanding.
He is always learning, and that alone is a clear indication of the path he has set for himself. He walked it before, and now, he plans to improve on it even more.
"I didn’t awaken any new aspect, but with this breakthrough, my already awakened aspects have improved, and that alone is good enough.
My sword gaze has improved tremendously, and with my sword body already merged with 16 split bodies, my combat power will become much more powerful.
The only thing left now is to train my mind so I can use the Clone Bodies more actively."
Kent turns to the requirement he must fulfill before becoming a Sword Sage.
⟦Requirements to become a Sword Sage⟧
↠ Gain all 11 enlightenments and attain Heavenly Sword Intent/Aura.
↠ Defeat Sword King Maklin in a sword duel.
↠ Kill the Wandering Demon Swordsman and present his head to the Olive Sword Guild.
↠ Absorb the Jade Token and use the energy to refine your sword gaze.
↠ Comprehend the Grand Sword Aura Tablet.
Kent looked at the requirements and sighed.
He was already on the track of gaining all 11 enlightenments. Of course, according to the tower, seeing and talking to the sword Dao is worth more than any enlightenment.
But Kent knew that was plain exaggeration.
If he wanted to make it big, then he must gain all 11 enlightenments. He had already attained four, and thanks to the opportunities that will be opening for him soon, he might gain some more.
However, the process demands more from him, and Kent isn’t sure if he can handle all that while also managing other things.
He still needs to pay attention to other things like his Alchemy, Dragon side, and many more. So, focusing on the sword alone, this demand made her panic a little.
"Then again, I have the sword World, so things aren’t too complex yet. As for the second requirement, I am sure I will ask around when I get back to the sect."
Kent didn’t want to jinx it, but he hoped his second requirement could be found in the sect. The Pill Princess was almost in his reach, so he wanted this one to go smoothly, too.
However, Kent also knew he could only hope for now.
"As for the third through to the fifth, I will have to ask Old Sword about it. Something tells me none of the last three requirements will be a walk in the park."
Kent stood up and stretched his arms.
"The next phase of my path will be a wild one, and I can only hope the outcome will be worth it. I must at least become a Sword Sage before ascending."
Kent walked away from the sword bridge and appeared in the body tower.
He ignored the bridge and went straight to the tempering room, where he immediately took out a couple of herbs and prepared a herb bath.
"It will take 2 days, that is 48 hours inside here, to finish tempering my body. That will be the perfect time for me to return to the sect and try the Perfect Chamber."
Kent climbed in and closed his eyes as the tempering process began.
[Supreme Immortal Sect - Core Region - Lady Liora’s POV - 2 Days Later]
The past weeks for Lady Liora had been all about trying to understand Kent.
For some reason, from the day she saw him, she couldn’t get him out of her head. It was as if Kent had become part of her every thought, and that alone was driving her crazy.
At first, she tried to forget all about him, but she couldn’t, so she started trying her best to come to terms with what was wrong with her.
It took her some time, but after hearing of Kent’s altercation with Xhan, she understood why.
Two decades ago, when she heard about the genius alchemist discovered in Sonox, she became happy. She finally saw a chance to impart her knowledge to someone before she ascended.
Unlike the others, as an alchemist, she doesn’t require a level of combat mastery to make it in a high world.
In fact, even a ’Great’ High world had already shown interest in her and was only delaying her inevitable departure because of her disciple.
First, she was happy to have Princess Sylvara as her disciple. She was as brilliant as they said, and that alone made her very happy.
However, that all started to change when she began to improve.
At first, it was mere arrogance that everyone at her level and status would feel. However, as time went by, she started to get worse.
She became so competitive that she sought to destroy those who showed signs of surpassing her. She even went so far as to ensure that everybody knew her status and understood what she stood for.
Luckily for her, she is brilliant, so being arrogant suited her, but Lady Liora grew increasingly irritated to the point it started affecting her cultivation.
The calm, alchemist life she had built for herself was being disturbed, and that had been shaking her for years now.
She did all she could, but the more the Pill Princess improved, the more she proved arrogant and disobedient.
So Lady Liora had had enough, and now she came to realize that the only way to put her back in check was to shatter the bubble she was in, the one that made her think she was the best.
This was why something she had never thought of doing was now her only way out.
She left her floating island and made her way to Lady Enzi’s to talk to Kent and see if she could seek his help in straightening up her discipline.
Meanwhile, the Pill Princess, who had heard of Kent’s face-off with Xhan, had now become even angrier with Kent.
She is the second strongest, or so she sees herself, and as it stood, the only person standing in her way was Xhan, whose poison was something she wasn’t able to conquer yet.
So, hearing Kent faced Xhan, breathed in his poison like fresh air, and even went as far as to dominate him by threatening Xhan, she wanted nothing now more than ever to shut Kent up.
"Pill Princess, I learned he is now staying with Lady Enzi. Getting to him is not possible." A disciple said to the Pill Princess, who was meditating in front of her golden Pill cauldron.
Hearing the report, she gritted her teeth, looking very pissed.
"Tell me the moment he appears."
"Okay, Pill Princess." The disciple left.
"Kent Madson, soon, I will shut you up." With that, she went back to her business, hoping that the next time she received news, Kent would be within her grasp.
