She was as brilliant as they said, and that alone made her very happy.
However, that all started to change when she began to improve.
At first, it was mere arrogance that everyone at her level and status would feel.
However, as time went by, she started to get worse.
She became so competitive that she sought to destroy those who showed signs of surpassing her.
She even went so far as to ensure that everybody knew her status and understood what she stood for.
Luckily for her, she is brilliant, so being arrogant suited her, but Lady Liora grew increasingly irritated to the point it started affecting her cultivation.
The calm, alchemist life she had built for herself was being disturbed, and that had been shaking her for years now.
She did all she could, but the more the Pill Princess improved, the more she proved arrogant and disobedient.
So Lady Liora had had enough, and now she came to realize that the only way to put her back in check was to shatter the bubble she was in, the one that made her think she was the best.
This was why something she had never thought of doing was now her only way out.
She left her floating island and made her way to Lady Enzi’s to talk to Kent and see if she could seek his help in straightening up her discipline.
Meanwhile, the Pill Princess, who had heard of Kent’s face-off with Xhan, had now become even angrier with Kent.
She is the second strongest, or so she sees herself, and as it stood, the only person standing in her way was Xhan, whose poison was something she wasn’t able to conquer yet.
So, hearing Kent faced Xhan, breathed in his poison like fresh air, and even went as far as to dominate him by threatening Xhan, she wanted nothing now more than ever to shut Kent up.
"Pill Princess, I learned he is now staying with Lady Enzi.
Getting to him is not possible." A disciple said to the Pill Princess, who was meditating in front of her golden Pill cauldron.
Hearing the report, she gritted her teeth, looking very pissed.
"Tell me the moment he appears."
"Okay, Pill Princess." The disciple left.
"Kent Madson, soon, I will shut you up." With that, she went back to her business, hoping that the next time she received news, Kent would be within her grasp.

chapters.title: Chapter 847: The Request
paragraphs: [Body Tower - After 48 days]
Kent rose from the herbal bath after 48 days feeling refreshed and even more powerful.
"I should do this more often," Kent said as he stepped out of the bath and entered the bathroom to have a nice cold bath. It took him a few minutes, but he was ready to go back to the sect.
"After challenging the Perfect Chamber, I will face the Golden Titan stairway and see how far I can climb."
Kent went to say goodbye to Vexthra before leaving.
The moment he appeared outside in the room where he had entered the tower, he sensed two powerful presences nearby.
He quickly left the room to check who had come to visit.

Before entering the tower, he had only sensed Lady Enzi’s presence, and unless Princess Elowen had become much stronger in the two days he was away, it could only mean someone new had come to Lady Enzi’s dwelling.
Upon exiting the room, he walked toward the edge of the floating island, pretending not to sense the foreign presence.
Lady Enzi called out to him a few seconds after he left the room.
"Lady Enzi, I didn’t see you there," Kent said with a smile, causing the glass lady to want to smack the back of his head.
Of course, she didn’t act on her impulse.
Lady Liora, being a quick study, caught the calm and almost friendly air between Kent and the glass lady, whom every man seemed to fear and every lady was jealous of.
"Lady Liora," Kent said, approaching the two ladies seated in a small garden, drinking tea.
Lady Liora looked at Kent and slightly narrowed her eyes. ’There is something different about him.’
Kent noticed the intrigue that appeared in her eyes and smile. Of course, he said nothing more or did anything else.
"Lady Liora wants to talk to you." The glass lady had left to supervise her disciple, who had just started making headway with her training.
Kent turned to the Pill Emperor and raised his brow. "I suppose I am here now, Lady Liora."
"You can sit down."
Kent sat down and focused his attention on Lady Liora.
"I heard you and Xhan had an altercation two days ago. Are you all right?"
"I am fine, Lady Liora. It was a minor skirmish between fellow disciples."
"I suppose you will call it minor, but to all those who witnessed it, that was a great shock to them." Lady Liora smirked.
"Do you know the only way to counter Xhan’s poison is to take a Tier 11 Poison Resistance pill? And in case you are not aware, one Tier 11 pill sells for several million spirit stones.
And even if you manage to get such a Tier 11 pill, the longer the battle lasts, the weaker the pill’s effect wears off until you are no longer protected.
The sect recognizes him as one of the most powerful and promising disciples in the upcoming Interplanetary Sect competition. We are putting everything on him...
So, for you to handle his poison like it was nothing, can you believe what a shock that is?"
Kent laughed, shaking his head.
"I don’t know what to say, Lady Liora. I merely used my poison resistance to handle his poison.
But even so, I know he is talented and stronger, and, well, seeing him as the most promising candidate for this competition is probably for the best.
However, what about your disciple? I was told you have a talented disciple who is also seeded for the upcoming interplanetary competition.
From what I found when I did my research, she is also amazing and powerful."
Kent smiled with a touch of guilt, one that he knew using his enchanted eyes on Lady Liora was almost infringing on her privacy.
But then he could justify that and say it was public knowledge and that he already knew all there is to know about the Pill Princess.
"Looks like you did your homework on me."
"I guess I did."
"Not bad. But indeed, Sylvara is a powerful disciple; however, she pales in comparison to Xhan." Lady Liora studied Kent’s expression for a few seconds and asked,
"Do you perhaps have time to do something for me? I will reward you either in pills or supreme points if you accept the offer."
"I am listening." Kent sat upright to show the lady he was indeed ready to hear her.
"I want you to challenge my disciple to a duel and defeat her."
The request was simple, yet Kent knew she truly meant what she asked of him. This made him wonder why she would want something like that.
Of course, he planned to find out, but first, he wanted to check something.
"I am just an inner disciple, Lady Liora. Challenging a core disciple to a duel is not possible. But even if it is, how sure are you that I will win?"
"Please, I can tell you are much stronger than you let on.
You managed to comprehend twelve divine-grade flame arts, defeated the top-talented disciples in both the outer and inner sects, and even went ahead to face someone like Xhan and walked away.
That is enough for anyone to know you are perhaps the strongest disciple in the sect, so cut the pretense and let’s talk."
"I suppose when you put it that way, we can have a conversation. However, you should know that hiring my strength isn’t cheap... Are you ready to pay?"
Lady Liora didn’t answer; instead, she focused on Kent’s face for a few minutes before she nodded.
’Wow, she is really serious about me teaching her a lesson. I suppose doing her this favor will be a good step toward building a good relationship.’
"How do you want it?" Kent asked.

"I want it to be a battle fought using flame arts. The arena will seal all other skills that have nothing to do with flames. All you have to do is defeat her in the most humiliating way possible; then I will handle the rest."
Kent smiled. "I did not peg you to have a dark side, Lady Liora, but it looks good on you."
Lady Liora didn’t mind him, but Kent saw a redness appear on her cheek. This caused his smile to bloom.
However, a thought entered his mind, one that he knew might prevent him from becoming a Pill Saint anytime soon if he didn’t navigate things well.
’What if, after humiliating her, she chooses not to accept any challenge from me again?’ This thought made Kent hesitant, so he asked a question...
"How about defeating her in a Pill duel?"
"No. That isn’t something she can handle. I am passing a technique to her, and if she were to lose in alchemy against you, it would destroy her future.
She can only accept alchemy duels in perhaps two years. This means this challenge can only be a combat duel."
’Well, isn’t that great. Now I have to wait two more years to become a Pill Saint.’ Kent was a little sour when the reality sank in.
’I can’t reject her offer, and I also can’t wait two more years, so what should I do?’ Kent’s mind spun, but his thinking was cut short when a message flashed before his eyes.
⟦Update: The requirements to become a Pill Saint have been updated⟧

chapters.title: Chapter 848: Chilling Discovery
paragraphs: ⟦Update: The requirements to become a Pill Saint have been updated⟧
Kent opened the panel to see what had changed, for he knew this was a critical moment for him.
While he had plans to stay in the medium world for another three years, which is the maximum for him, he did not plan on being a Pill Grandmaster for long.
The plan is to become at least a Pill Sage or Pill King before ascending.
So this message was his last hope.
⟦To qualify to become a Pill Saint, you must complete the following requirements:⟧
↠ Concoct 10 Tier 5 Perfect Pills (Completed)
↠ Concoct a Tier 6 Perfect Pill (Completed)
↠ Concoct a Tier 7 Perfect Pill (Completed)
↠ Gain at least two enlightenments in the pill path (Completed)
↠ Defeat Pill Saint Flura in a Pill Duel - [Pill World] (Uncompleted)
’This is perfect.’ Kent sighed inwardly, reading the message.
This was something he could work with, for he had no idea how someone would accept his challenge after he had humiliated them and later challenged them to a duel, which he planned to defeat again.
This solution was one he received, even though he had no idea who Pill Saint Flura was.
Kent looked at Lady Liora and smiled.
He could tell she truly needed his help, so now that he was free to go all out, he would make sure the pill princess understood the error of her ways.
"I believe we can work something out, Lady Liora. However, I have some questions, and I would value your honest answer."
"Go ahead."
"Why didn’t you stop being her master if she had strayed off course and wasn’t taking your advice seriously anymore?"
Lady Liora sighed and pushed her mind back to the day she accepted the Pill Princess. A smile appeared on her lips.
"You know, the day I accepted her as my disciple was the happiest I have ever felt. Not only was she brilliant, but she was also amazing.
She manually awakened a powerful soul flame, awakened an Innate Pill Eye, and even managed to gain three pill enlightenment, all while living in a world like Sonox.
Don’t get me wrong, Sonox is a good world, but I think we can both say it doesn’t have the standards to house a sect like this.
So, for such a world to have this talent, you can only imagine.
This was why I took her in and groomed her, which was very easy considering she was already brilliant.
I invested so much in her with my ultimate dream of imparting a powerful technique my master gave me before she became an immortal."
Kent raised his brow.
The last sentence took him off guard, but Lady Liora just smiled and cleared his confusion...
"Don’t overthink it. I am not from a Medium world, as you already suspected. In fact, I am from a Great High world, one known about by only a few.
My master was a powerful Alchemist, one who could rival even the geniuses in the pill worlds, so you can only imagine how amazing a technique from her would be.
As a tradition, whenever a master becomes an immortal, their disciple must also take in a disciple and nurture them into an even better version of themselves.
My master nurtured me, and now it is my turn to nurture one. I can only have one disciple, and I picked her.
Of course, it wasn’t like failure wasn’t an option. I could abandon her and vanish back to my world today, but I didn’t because my master didn’t abandon me when I was struggling with my issues.
She found ways to help me overcome my issues, and now I am finding ways to make her into someone who will one day shake the alchemy world.
I could have abandoned her, but I didn’t. Instead, I am doing everything in my power to make her better, and perhaps one day, when I see my master, I will be able to face her."
Kent could tell the sincerity in her tone, and now that she had revealed her true intentions for coming for his help, the only reason for Kent to hold back was shattered.
"Looks like I will have to wreck your disciple so she can be rebuilt."
Lady Liora could already see that perhaps Kent was not the best choice for this mission. The grin on his face was sending a dangerous message.
But after looking around, the only person who could handle the mission for her was Kent, so it was better to hire the devil to do that dirty work for her.
’Tower, tell me her true cultivation base, and why wasn’t I able to see her actual cultivation base? I’ve seen things like that before.

⟦The master was able to see the true cultivation realms of his legions because they are connected to you. This person isn’t connected to you, and as such, you cannot see beyond what this world can see.
However, her actual cultivation base is level 4 Spirit Sovereign.⟧
’I see.’
⟦While we are on the same topic, you should also know she is a member of the Midnight Shadows.⟧
’So she is an assassin and even affiliated with the Midnight Shadows.’
⟦Yes, Master. She is a Shadow Emperor with a powerful Shadow Realm.⟧

’Damn, that means she is simple, and judging by the calm, quiet alchemist life she had going on, she had become even more dangerous. If you hadn’t said anything, Tower, I wouldn’t have pegged her as an assassin.’
⟦That is how dangerous the cultivation world is. You might be the strongest and the most talented, but a moment of carelessness will be the cause of your death.
The master should learn from this. The quieter and more harmless they look, the more dangerous they are.⟧
’I will, my dear tower. I will be careful next time.’

And just like that, Kent’s image of the pill emperor sitting before him had changed. If he had seen her as a weak woman and more friendly before, then now he saw her as the most dangerous person he had ever seen.
’If she meant to kill me, she would have succeeded quite easily.’
This thought sent chills down Kent’s body.
"Are you all right?" Lady Liora asked, looking concerned.
Kent smiled faintly and nodded, "I am fine, Lady Liora. Now, why don’t you tell me how to challenge your disciple?"
Instead of answering, she stood up and smiled, "That is for you to figure out. Just know that I will be nearby to step in and make it official."
Kent also stood up and walked around the small table housing the teapot, "Are you sure you trust me to handle this on my own?"
The question sounded funny because it was indeed funny. However, Lady Liora didn’t say anything and just started walking away.
"I guess I will handle it on my own, but don’t forget, you will owe me big time."
With a subtle shrug, she flew away, leaving Kent to ponder what that sudden exit was for. They were having a nice conversation, then all of a sudden, she left.
"I guess she had something to do." With that, Kent went back inside to rest for a few hours before going to challenge the Perfect Chamber.
Meanwhile, Lady Liora went back to her own floating island to rest. Being around Kent, for some reason, stirred her darker past, one she would love to let sleep for years to come.

chapters.title: Chapter 849: Perfect Chamber
paragraphs: "Isn’t that Kent?" a disciple said, standing in line in front of a pagoda.
Every last disciple turned and looked at Kent, who was now making his way to the Perfect Chamber.
"I guess he is coming to try out the Perfect Chamber."
"I think so. But to think he waited this long to give it a try."
"Tch, what do you expect? Do you think just because he has shown some abilities, he can be regarded as impressive? I even have a feeling he cheated somehow."
"I think so, too."
"Well, at least I’ll feel better knowing he will be joining the queue like a normal disciple. It is first come, first served after all."
As usual, more disciples started murmuring, saying all kinds of things about Kent.
Some praised him for his feats, while the jealous ones said all kinds of nasty stuff about him. However, he ignored them all and walked toward the front of the line.
"Why isn’t he joining the line?"
"Is he trying to jump ahead of us?"
The murmurs grew louder as the disciples started to shout at Kent’s behavior. However, he didn’t stop; instead, he continued walking until he was right in front of the pagoda, where an Elder stood.
"All disciples must join the line," the elder said, but Kent didn’t answer; instead, he took out the badge Lady Enzi had given him.
The moment the elder saw the badge, his heartbeat slowed down. "Everyone should quiet down." His tone was loud, laced with a touch of panic.
’It is good to have a powerful backing,’ Kent said in his head.
"Disciple Kent, be ready. The moment the current disciple exits, you will go next."
"Thank you." Kent nodded and stored the badge away. He then walked to one side and sat down. Turning to the disciples, he smiled, further infuriating them.
Of course, his fans were more than happy to see their idol get away with what everyone was protesting.
The elder looked at Kent and sighed inwardly.
’Lucky bastard. To think he has already gained the favor of someone like Lady Enzi, even going as far as receiving her Supreme Badge.’
It was safe to say the elder also didn’t like Kent, for he was one of the fair ones. He always does things by the book, so no matter one’s strength level, he would make them join the line.
However, against Lady Enzi’s Supreme Badge, he was powerless, and that alone was enough to tell everyone how powerful the person standing behind Kent was.
’I should probably take Vexthra’s idea and help those I want. After all, I have more than enough ways to help them without affecting myself or my legion.’
Far back in the long line, a disciple retrieved a device and spoke into it. Far in the core sect, a disciple moved toward the Pill Princess’s immortal cave to alert her of Kent’s presence.
She, after all, wants to get her hands on Kent, and, well, it turns out that the dragon also wants to get hold of her.
[30 minutes later – Time to enter the Perfect Chamber]
After waiting for 30 minutes, the disciple who had been in the chamber when Kent arrived came out, scoring only 54% in the challenge.
"Disciple Kent, you may enter now."
Kent stood up and stretched before walking toward the door leading to the Perfect Chamber. After a few steps, he reached the door.
He first turned and looked at the scoreboard, where the current strongest names in the inner sect were listed.
’Damian Dhark... 65%... It appears that there are still some tigers hidden within the sect.’
He sighed and then walked into the chamber.
"Wait a minute, isn’t this the sword bridge?" Kent almost shouted when he appeared on the sword bridge. It felt as if he were back inside the tower; however, the real tower cleared his doubts.
⟦This is how the Perfect Chamber has been designed, Master. It picks a random object from your memory and models it for the challenge.
Of course, it is not a perfect replica because this chamber is not perfect. However, I estimate its accuracy at 95%, which, in my opinion, is sufficient for a medium-sized world.⟧
’I see. Then I suppose Gaia would now have to build a True Perfect Chamber, huh?’
⟦Yes, Master.⟧
’Very well. One last question. How will I know how much stronger I am compared to my true potential?’
⟦I will be updating the Master.⟧

Kent smiled and took a few steps forward. A few steps in, the space cracked, and a replica of himself clad in dark leather armor and wielding a sword sheathed in a golden scabbard appeared through it.
’Damn it.’
Kent felt his body pressed down when his perfect self—or at least a 95% perfect version of him—appeared.
"Looks like you are still lacking," the perfect clone said, looking smugly at Kent.
’Is talking a thing for the clones in here?’ Kent asked the tower when his clone spoke.
⟦This clone is a version of you, Master, so of course, he can speak just like you.⟧
’Just great.’ Kent straightened his back, refusing to let his own clone dominate him.
’A peak Core Formation cultivator, huh? So that is how strong I will become one once I reach the peak... what a monster!’
It was safe to say the aura of even Spirit Kings in a High world like Fedora didn’t have much effect on Kent.
However, seeing his perfect clone self was affecting him with his aura, Kent could only smile.
"Just because you have a few upgrades doesn’t mean you are superior, Mr. I am still me, and you are a mere clone," Kent smirked. However, the next second, he felt a powerful force slam into his soul.
’The hell.’
⟦I forgot to tell the Master, but your soul immunity doesn’t work when fighting yourself.⟧
Kent wasn’t even done when another powerful attack slammed into his mind, causing him to nearly black out.
However, he didn’t; instead, he activated the clone bodies, immediately swapping places with one of them. If he had been a moment too late, he would have died before the battle even began.
The clone appeared behind him at his original position and drove his sword through his heart. Thankfully, Kent moved before it could happen.
’That was close.’ Kent swapped with another clone body and was about to lunge at his Perfect Clone when he also activated his clone bodies.
’Damn, this is not going to be an easy battle.’
Kent retreated and decided to approach the fight differently.
His legs lit up, forming two rings on both sides, and then his speed surged. He dashed at the Perfect Clone, who had already prepared before Kent even got there.
However, Kent didn’t stop in his tracks. Instead, he closed the distance, and just when he was about to attack, he vanished and appeared behind the perfect clone.𝒻𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝘯𝘰𝑣ℯ𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝘮
However, just when he expected his attack to connect, his stabbing attack was easily blocked by the clone, forcing Kent to retreat again.
’I suppose I need to see how brilliant I have become with the sword.’
Kent coated his sword with sword Qi and moved. This time, when he was near the Perfect Clone, his sword came down in a quick vertical slash—one that was deflected.
But Kent pressed on, and soon a close combat unlike any Kent had fought before began.

chapters.title: Chapter 850: Me, Myself and I
paragraphs: If there is one thing Kent understood about himself, it was his way of handling odds stacked against him.
As a computer engineering student back on Earth, thinking outside the box was one of his many notable qualities, among others.
So, facing himself in combat and being completely outclassed wasn’t too surprising.
The perfect clone, although merely 95% of Kent’s true potential if he were to reach the peak of the Core Formation stage, was far superior that his current self.
The main Kent, who was still at the 4th level, having yet to form his core before refining it seven times, was lacking greatly.
He was outclassed in speed, strength, and overall stamina.
But that wasn’t all.
Although Kent could tell the clone possessed the same combat knowledge as he, for some reason, the clone was superior in using it than he was.
They had already exchanged thousands of attacks in close combat, and while Kent gave it his all, he was outperformed at every turn.
In fact, he was like a disciple training with his master.
Now, panting 20 meters away from the perfect clone, Kent could only smile weakly, shaking his head.
"Although this is a good sign that I still have some potential in me yet to unlock, it is just too embarrassing to lose a duel against my own self."
The clone crossed his arms over his chest, looking at Kent with a smug expression.
"It happens to the best of us. But while you are still lacking and can never beat me, I have already seen enough to give you my analysis before we continue."
Though Kent had no idea how or why the clone was behaving this way, he knew the Tower had a hand in it, so he could only play along.
After all, he had already concluded that he wouldn’t be able to defeat his perfect clone, so he could only learn the errors of his ways and improve on them.
"Go ahead."

"First of all, you are fighting based on your current limit. Instead of going beyond what you can currently do, you were instead focused on what you can already do, and that is affecting your combat power.
So, if you want to have a shot at making me bleed, then it will be in your best interest to go above and beyond, for that is the only way for you to know your true potential.
Also, your speed is still lacking.
I estimate that, using your agility, you should be able to move at half the speed the [Flame Wheels] skill does. Instead of relying more on your techniques, focus on improving your speed.
I know we are smart, so we will find a way to do that soon enough. That said, your swordsmanship is impeccable, but without speed and endurance, you will never touch my skin with your sword."
Kent nodded thoughtfully at all the clone had said, and in the end, he could only say one thing: "I am still lacking, even at Level 4."

"Yes, dude, your current strength is worthy of a Level 5 Root Sovereign. You need to push yourself further, and while it will be hard to do that in a medium world, you can always count on the Tower to come through."
"Tch," Kent chuckled and laughed. "At this point, you are just being a shameless Tower."

⟦The master can indeed count on me. During these few minutes of combat, I have managed to gather a lot of data on the master’s strength, and using it, I will create ways for you to push your limits beyond what your body can currently handle. When you are done, you will know the word ’limit’ is but a basic form of limitless.
For now, the master can do all he can, but winning this duel is not an option. You are far from that.⟧
"Very well," Kent nodded, and thus the next phase of the close combat started.
Kent moved in, and this time, instead of using his clone bodies, he focused more on reading his opponent, which was funny considering his opponent was himself.
"Talk about Me, Myself, and I," Kent chuckled, sidestepping as a vertical slash from the clone narrowly missed him.
He responded with a sweeping attack, one that left a hum in the air, but the clone was several steps ahead. He jumped back and kicked with his left leg, catching Kent off guard.
However, like the clone said, while Kent knew that the kick would land on him, he didn’t allow it; instead, he moved back and twisted his body at an unnatural angle, narrowly evading the kick.
But it didn’t end there; the clone came in with a vertical slash, one that Kent had no way of evading. However, yet again, he did.
Using [Distorted Perception], one of the Sword Gaze skills he learned during his Gaze Enlightenment, he managed to overload the clone’s mind, or perhaps his vision, with a mirage of his images.
This gave him a chance to narrowly evade the attack again, leaving a deep cut in the ground.
"Smart," the clone said, but didn’t give Kent a moment of rest. He kept pressing on, and Kent was also doing his best not to give in too early.
Slowly, Kent began to notice some changes.
The way he moves had improved slightly.
Of course, while noticing this would be near impossible, he managed to spot it, and that was because attacks he struggled to block, dodge, or parry were now being made easily.
It was like his gaze had been sharpened, which, in Kent’s own thinking, he knew had something to do with the Sword Dao legacy.
’This is getting fun,’ Kent started to enjoy the combat.
An hour passed in the blink of an eye, but they each were going strong, none backing down anytime soon.
Meanwhile, on the outside, the disciples in line began complaining about Kent’s delay in emerging from the Perfect Chamber.
Of course, aside from hating Kent for cutting in line, they also envied his current standing within the sect, as well as the fact that he had already spent an hour and had yet to come out.
They were angry, and while murmurs weren’t cutting it, they started to make their frustrations much louder.
"This is just too frustrating. I have been standing in line for three days already, but a mere nobody came to cut the line like he owns the place."

"Too frustrating. I don’t even feel like remaining in line anymore. If anyone can just cut in and enter while we who have been standing in the queue for days remain standing, then where is the fairness this sect keeps preaching?"
The more statements people made, the more they started to amplify everything. Soon, the noise filled the place.
"Don’t tell me he has been fighting himself for an hour now and hasn’t even managed to lose."
The disciple who made the statement reexamined his words and seemed to have implied something that Kent’s fans could use against him.
As expected, his words were used against him.
"He is still in there because, unlike you, who can go for only five minutes, he is impressive even when facing a perfect version of himself."
The disciple who made the earlier comment gritted his teeth, feeling insulted. However, before he could respond, a sudden comment caused every head to turn...
"Look, it is the Pill Princess, she is also coming here."
